jobs.description:
Head of Marketing

OneAvant | Remote (EMEA)

About OneAvant

OneAvant is a Malta-based, AI-powered business management platform helping retail businesses, hotels, restaurants, and factories run smarter operations. We bring together inventory, staff, guest experience, production, and sales into one connected system, replacing scattered tools and spreadsheets with real-time visibility and automation that teams can actually trust. From automated purchase orders to AI-driven insights, OneAvant gives operators the full picture of their business, tailored to the industry they work in.

Our platform is built around four core products, each solving a different piece of the operations puzzle:

Hospitality Guest Management: automated check-in, keyless rooms, unified housekeeping, and concierge-level service requests that make every guest feel remembered

ERP – Manufacturing: production automation and full traceability, from raw material to finished product, with automated ordering and CRM built in

Business Intelligence: real-time data aggregated across platforms, with an AI query builder that lets anyone ask questions and get instant answers

Retail & Sales: live inventory tracking, automated purchasing and deliveries, and seamless e-commerce integration

Today, OneAvant powers businesses across Europe and beyond, giving them the confidence to move faster and grow without operational blind spots. As we scale, we're looking for people who want to help more businesses trade the chaos of disconnected tools for one platform that just works.

About the Role

As our Head of Marketing, you'll be the bridge between Product, Sales, and Partnerships, translating what we build into why it wins in the market, reporting directly to the CEO. That includes growing our distribution network, finding new partners across our product lines and giving each one the positioning, pricing guidance, and materials they need to start selling with confidence You'll own GTM strategy end to end, shape our competitive positioning, and turn complex product capabilities into stories that make buyers lean in, across both direct sales and channel partnerships

We need someone who can move fluidly between pricing strategy, buyer psychology, and technical depth. A strategic, hands-on marketer who treats ambiguity as a starting point, not a blocker, and is just as comfortable in a pricing model as in a positioning workshop. You'll play a key role in taking ownership and articulating our category as we carve out new market territory, bringing fluency in pricing models to help shape how we package and monetize our product.

This is a high-ownership, individual-contributor role: no direct reports, no budget ownership, and no external agency to lean on. What you build, you build yourself.

This role can be held remotely from anywhere within EMEA, provided you can work within CET/CEST (GMT+1) business hours.

Key Responsibilities

Take full ownership of defining and continuously evolving our category positioning, crafting a sharp, differentiated story and proving why it matters as we push into new markets. Lead demand generation strategy end-to-end.

Define and update personas and buyer journeys, with a focus on mid-market and enterprise.

Advise on pricing and packaging strategy, ensuring messaging aligns with how each customer segment buys across our full product suite.

Craft compelling narratives that translate product capabilities into clear, story-driven value propositions for buyers and users alike.

Own product launches end-to-end: positioning, messaging, collateral, and internal enablement.

Partner with Product to ensure roadmap items are translated into customer-friendly narratives and value propositions.

Redefine our website as a growth channel, driving conversion rate optimization, messaging tests, and funnel improvements that directly support pipeline goals.

Own pipeline generation and health, working closely with CEO to ensure marketing-driven pipeline consistently converts into revenue, including shipping campaigns, pages, or content to hit pipeline targets.

Identify, onboard, and enable new distribution partners across our product lines, building the positioning, pricing guidance, and collateral each new distributor needs to ramp quickly.

Equip partners with co-marketing decks, playbooks, and enablement guides, working closely with the CEO to support partner-sourced revenue.

About You

  • 5+ years of B2B SaaS product marketing experience, including building marketing plans and executing go-to-market (GTM) strategies for web-based solutions.
  • Proven experience in e-commerce, ERP, hospitality, or Business Intelligence platforms (or related applications) is strongly preferred.
  • Experience shaping category positioning or narrative for a product entering a new or emerging market category.
  • Experience launching and positioning products in enterprise or mid-market environments, with a full-stack marketer mindset.
  • A strong track record building sales enablement content and supporting enterprise campaigns.
  • Excellent research and analytical skills, with the ability to pull insights from customers, competitors, and markets.
  • Strong collaboration skills, with experience working cross-functionally across product, engineering, and revenue teams.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English; additional European languages are a plus.
  • Frequent travel to client destinations across Malta and EMEA (including on-site visits to hotel clients) is a core part of this role, along with availability aligned to CET/CEST (GMT+1) working hours.

Compensation

This role offers a fixed annual salary of €40,000, but that's just the floor. We've built a generous incentive and bonus plan around revenue impact, with commission ranging from 5% to 25% on the revenue you bring in. There's no ceiling on what a strong marketer (revenue driver) can earn here. This role also offers the flexibility of working remotely from anywhere within EMEA.

How We Work

We operate as one unified team with a shared objective. Our goal is to build a cross-functional, self-managed team that works effectively from anywhere in the world, with strong representation across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. We foster open, collaborative communication and bring together global talent based on capability and strong communication.

OneAvant is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team.

Salary: €40,000 / year

jobs.description:
Strategic Advisor – Airport & Airfield Pavement Infrastructure

Location: Independent Contractor - Remote

About us

At Niricson, we are redefining the future of civil infrastructure maintenance. Using proprietary sensing technology and AI-powered analytics, we help asset owners make smarter, faster, and safer decisions for critical infrastructure such as bridges, dams and spillways, tunnels, airfields, and more.

As we scale across North America and beyond, we are seeking experienced, well-connected industry advisors to guide our growth, validate our approach, and connect us with the people and problems that matter most.

About the role

We are looking for a Strategic Advisor with deep expertise in airport or airfield infrastructure management. Ideally, someone with experience in asset ownership, engineering leadership, or large-scale infrastructure portfolios.

This is a flexible, advisory engagement. You will work closely with Niricson’s Chief Sales Officer and leadership team to provide strategic insights, industry credibility, and introductions that accelerate our market penetration and alignment with customer needs. The advisor will be expected to provide information on how specific clients make decisions, who the key decision makers are, and when key opportunities are expected to be announced. The advisor may also provide information on proper positioning and messaging to key decision-makers.

This role is perfect for someone semi-retired, transitioning from public service or consulting independently, who wants to remain engaged in the industry in a meaningful, non-operational capacity.

Key Contributions

  • Provide strategic information on proper messaging, decision-makers, and bidding opportunities for clients
  • Advise on engagement strategies with aviation authorities or airport operators
  • Offer industry insights on market trends, procurement processes, and regulatory considerations for positioning Niricson’s Product
  • Support credibility-building with potential clients (e.g., participate in key meetings, webinars, and white papers)
  • Introduce Niricson to relevant stakeholders and potential partners, including airport authorities, government aviation bodies, and airfield operations executives
  • Collaborate on industry events, speaking opportunities, or roundtables where relevant
  • Offer independent feedback on product-market fit and key customer pain points
  • Provide introductions to key decision makers and leadership

Who You Are

  • 15+ years of experience in airport operations, airfield engineering, aviation infrastructure, asset management, or public sector leadership
  • Former Director, Executive, or Asset Owner in a relevant agency or organization
  • Deep understanding of government procurement processes and operational realities of asset management
  • Respected in the industry, with an established professional network
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to act as a trusted advisor
  • Comfortable working independently under a services agreement (not as an employee)

Engagement Structure

This is an independent contractor role and is not considered employment under Canadian law.

As such:

  • You will enter into a subcontract for services with Niricson
  • You will invoice for your time collaborating with the team
  • You are responsible for your own tax filings, business registration, and applicable insurance

What We Offer

  • A chance to influence the future of civil infrastructure and condition maintenance
  • A collaborative and respectful leadership team that values your expertise
  • Flexible, remote engagement
  • Competitive advisory compensation structure
  • Opportunity to help shape safer, longer-lasting infrastructure around the world

Diversity and Inclusion

Niricson values the unique experience of professionals from all backgrounds. We strongly encourage expressions of interest from equity-deserving groups, including indigenous peoples, racialized individuals, women, persons with disabilities, and 2SLGBTQIA+ communities.

We’re a close-knit, mission-driven team that celebrates curiosity, diversity, and excellence.

jobs.description:
At Sunrun, we’re on a mission to change the way the world interacts with energy, and we’re building a company and brand that puts power at the center of life. To do it, we’re designing a dynamic culture where employee development, well-being, and safety come first. It’s why we’ve become the #1 home solar and battery company in America. We’re unlike any other residential energy company. Our vertically integrated model gives us total control over every part of the energy lifecycle – from sale through installation and beyond – so you can find endless opportunities for growth. Come join a career you can grow in and a culture you can run with.

Who We Are

We’re on a mission to make energy more reliable and affordable for more people. We provide an opportunity with storage and solar to help people access greater energy independence without the big upfront costs. Sunrun is the largest dedicated residential solar and storage company in the country and has a mission to bring stably priced resilient power to the masses.


Overview

The Manufacturing & Quality Engineer is responsible for ensuring SnapNrack products are designed for manufacturability, meet quality expectations and continuously improve throughout their lifecycle. The role serves as the bridge between Product Development and Operations, owning Product Quality, manufacturing readiness and continuous improvement initiatives.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead Product Quality investigations, root cause analysis and corrective actions for customer, field and manufacturing issues.

  • Drive Design for Manufacturability (DFM) reviews throughout product development to improve manufacturability, assembly efficiency and product robustness.

  • Partner with Operations and Supply Chain to improve manufacturing processes, supplier quality and production readiness.

  • Develop quality plans, inspection criteria, validation requirements and engineering documentation supporting production releases.

  • Analyze warranty data, customer feedback and field performance to identify trends and prioritize product improvements.

  • Support Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), drawings, manufacturing documentation and release management.

  • Coordinate cross-functional quality reviews while tracking corrective actions to closure.

  • Assist in the launch of new products, including first article inspections, and the design or refinement of packaging solutions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing or Industrial Engineering.

  • 5+ years in Product Quality, Manufacturing Engineering or related discipline.

  • Experience with CAPA, DFMEA/PFMEA, root cause analysis and product validation.

  • Strong analytical, communication and cross-functional leadership skills.

Success Measures

  • Reduced warranty claims and field failures.

  • Improved DFM and manufacturing readiness.

  • Timely ECO implementation.

  • Improved product quality KPIs.

  • Effective cross-functional quality ownership.

jobs.description:
Senior Solutions Engineer, Pre-Sales (East Coast)
Sales Engineering | United States (Remote)

You'll be the technical lead in Alkira's largest enterprise deals — in the room with network architects and infrastructure directors, owning the technical side of the deal from first conversation through POC to close.

This is a pre-sales engineering role. You'll partner directly with an Account Manager on strategy and carry real influence over what we build next — our Product team treats SE field feedback as a primary input to the roadmap.

Location: Remote, US. Candidates should reside in East Coast, USA

Travel: approximately 25%, including regional air travel as needed. Please discuss the specifics for this position with the recruiter.

What you'll do

  • Present and demo the Alkira platform to technical decision makers, from engineer to CIO
  • Clearly articulate the Alkira value proposition and have a sound understanding of market, industry and competitive landscape
  • Partner with Alkira Account Managers to understand customer requirements and pain points. Assist with any technical asks from customers and help respond to RFP/RFIs
  • Scope, run and win Proof of Concepts end to end
  • Assist customers with design and deployment based on best practices
  • Work with Alkira Product Management team to provide feedback on upcoming features from the customer's lens
  • Track and drive key customer features/asks with Alkira Product Management to implementation

What you need

  • 8+ years in a customer-facing pre-sales engineering role — Sales Engineer, Systems Engineer, Solutions Consultant or Solutions Architect — ideally at a networking or security vendor, cloud provider, channel partner, or consultancy
  • Strong networking fundamentals – Everything below builds on this, and it is not negotiable
  • Deep expertise in routing protocols and technologies, including BGP, OSPF, and static routing, with hands-on experience in route policy design, route redistribution, filtering, and traffic engineering
  • Understanding of network virtualization and software-defined networking, including VRFs, multi-tenant network architectures, SD-WAN, and the encapsulation protocols used to build overlays at scale (GRE, VXLAN, GENEVE and similar)
  • Hands-on experience with IPsec VPNs, encryption standards, NAT, and secure connectivity architectures
  • Good understanding of how enterprises extend cloud connectivity using a variety of Networking Technologies (i.e. Cloud On-Ramps, SD-WAN and IPsec)
  • Experience in large-scale enterprise network design and deployment experience across data center, WAN and hybrid/multi-cloud
  • A deep understanding of network services — DNS, DHCP, load balancing, traffic inspection and similar
  • The ability to troubleshoot live, in front of a customer, across routing, security and cloud domains
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and comfort presenting and demoing to customers in person – In this role you are the technical credibility of the company

Strongly preferred

  • Understanding of cloud networking constructs across AWS, Azure, and GCP (e.g., VPCs/VNets, Transit Gateway, Virtual WAN, Cloud Router, peering, and hybrid connectivity such as Direct Connect and ExpressRoute)
  • Network security expertise, including firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet, Check Point), firewall policy design, service insertion/chaining, and Zero Trust principles
  • Relevant technical certifications (e.g., CCNP/CCIE, AWS Advanced Networking, Azure Network Engineer, PCNSE)
  • Familiarity with Terraform or infrastructure-as-code for network automation
  • BA/BS/MS in a technical field
  • Strong passion for sales and creating long-lasting professional relationships

About Alkira

Alkira, a Lumen Connect® solution, is building the future of enterprise networking: one programmable platform to connect, secure, and operate every cloud, site, partner, data center, and AI workload.

Founded by Amir and Atif Khan, the creators of Viptela and pioneers of the SD-WAN market, Alkira was built to radically simplify how enterprises deploy and manage network infrastructure. Today, as part of Lumen, we are bringing that cloud-native operating model to a global network foundation trusted by the world's largest enterprises.

Our platform helps customers move faster without managing hardware, stitching together providers, or operating fragmented cloud networks. Teams can build and scale connectivity on demand, apply consistent security and segmentation, and gain visibility across distributed environments from one place.

At Alkira, you'll help shape the next chapter of networking: cloud-like consumption, private-network performance, and total control across the enterprise. We move fast, solve hard problems, and build technology that changes how global businesses connect.

Join us and help build the future of networking.

jobs.description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

About The Role:

We’re hiring an Associate SEO and AEO Manager to build the foundation of YipitData’s discoverability and organic growth engine.

Buyers increasingly find answers through search engines and AI assistants before they ever talk to a vendor. YipitData sits on a limitless engine of proprietary insight, and this role is about pointing that engine at the market so prospects find us on their own, engage with our content, and raise their hands to talk to us. You’ll own our SEO and AEO strategy for the YipitData organization end to end: mapping the questions our buyers ask across their journey, turning that map into a content roadmap designed to be the definitive answer, and building the systems that track whether it’s working. You’ll partner closely with the YipitAgent team to produce and verify content at scale, and with marketing, product, and sales to connect organic traffic to pipeline.

This is a builder’s role. You’ll bring bleeding-edge, AI-informed tactics to a program you get to shape from the ground up, with the data, tooling, and support to move quickly.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Non-branded organic sessions and AI-sourced sessions grow quarter over quarter.
  • YipitData is cited as a source in AI-generated answers for the questions our buyers ask.
  • Content ships at a consistent, measurable velocity and gets refreshed when performance slips.
  • Organic becomes a reliable, attributable source of conversions and pipeline.

jobs.title: Senior Content Marketer, Campaigns/Enterprise
jobs.excerpt: About AnimalzAnimalz is a content marketing agency that partners with B2B SaaS companies, venture capital firms, and other tech organizations to drive long-term, sustainable growth through high-quality content.
jobs.description:
About Animalz

Animalz is a content marketing agency that partners with B2B SaaS companies, venture capital firms, and other tech organizations to drive long-term, sustainable growth through high-quality content.

Our fully remote team of experienced content marketers delivers strategies and content tailored to each customer's goals and context. We pride ourselves on our deep interest and understanding of software products and audiences, our commitment to thought leadership, and our relentless pursuit of mastering our craft.

Our customers include industry leaders like Amplitude, Ramp, and Wistia, as well as high-growth early-stage startups.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Content Marketer: an exceptional writer with the editorial judgment to own content quality for the customers they serve.

This is a writing-first role. About 70% of your time will be spent researching and writing content yourself—work that calls for real research, original thinking, and craft.

On the Enterprise & Campaigns team, that writing spans various formats: thought leadership that gives leaders a point of view worth repeating, along with the blog posts, guides, landing pages, and email sequences that carry a campaign from first touch to conversion. You'll write for some of our largest customers, whose audiences (and internal reviewers) expect work that holds up under scrutiny.

The rest of your time goes to making sure everything else your accounts publish is just as good as what you write. You'll manage the freelance writers who contribute to your accounts, keep the content calendar on track, review every piece before it reaches the customer, and ensure customer feedback is acted on and remembered.

You won't do any of this alone. Every account is served by a small team, and you'll work alongside teammates who own the overall strategy and the customer relationship. Your ownership is the content itself: writing much of it, and standing behind all of it.

What You'll Do

  • Write high-quality content (blog posts, guides, landing pages, and more) that's genuinely worth reading, grounded in a real understanding of each customer's product and audience
  • Write across the full range of campaign formats: thought leadership, blog posts, guides, landing pages, and email nurtures
  • Move between registers with ease, from a long-form piece in an executive's voice to tight conversion copy on a landing page
  • Review every piece your accounts deliver before it reaches the customer, whether you wrote it, a freelancer wrote it, or it started as an AI-assisted draft. (Note: we have separate Editors who edit pieces in production for feedback. Your role is the final review)
  • Turn a campaign plan into a coordinated set of assets that tell one story
  • Help manage the freelance writers on your accounts, write briefs they can succeed with, and maintain customer brand guides and other assets for reference.
  • Work smoothly with larger marketing teams, keeping quality and momentum through multiple reviewers and longer approval cycles
  • Act on customer feedback quickly and thoroughly, and keep track of it, so a customer never has to give the same note twice
  • Communicate directly with customers about deliverables, timelines, and revisions, and join customer calls as a trusted voice on the work
  • Contribute to performance reporting, helping show customers what shipped, how it's performing, and what we're learning
  • Use AI tools thoughtfully, taking advantage of them where they genuinely help, and applying your own judgment and craft where they don't
  • Contribute to team knowledge-sharing and internal initiatives, learning from teammates and sharing what you know

What We're Looking For

  • 4–6 years of experience in content marketing, with at least 2 of those years in B2B SaaS. Agency experience can be a plus
  • Exceptional writing ability: You're first and foremost a writer. You produce publication-ready content with minimal revisions, writing with clarity, precision, and strategic insight, and you adapt your voice to different brands while keeping your standards high
  • Campaign thinking: You see how individual pieces of content connect into a larger arc, and you write each one with its place in that arc in mind
  • Range as a writer: You're as comfortable with in-depth thought leadership as with concise, conversion-focused copy, and you can switch between them without losing quality
  • Strong editorial judgment: You can read someone else's draft, explain clearly why it does or doesn't work. You catch quality problems before customers do
  • Experience working with other writers: You've briefed, edited, or managed freelancers or teammates
  • Customer communication skills: You're clear, responsive, and trustworthy with customers, and you build confidence through the quality and reliability of your work
  • Experience with larger customers: You've worked with enterprise companies or bigger marketing teams, and you handle multiple stakeholders and review rounds with patience and grace
  • Strong organizational skills: You can manage multiple accounts, contributors, and deadlines at once without letting quality or dates slip
  • AI fluency: You use AI tools to support your workflow responsibly and effectively, you can edit AI-assisted drafts to publication quality, and you stay current on emerging best practices
  • Technical curiosity: You genuinely enjoy learning how software products and businesses work so you can write about them with authority
  • Ownership and adaptability: You take initiative, navigate ambiguity, and raise problems early, while they're still easy to solve

Room to Grow

Senior Content Marketers at Animalz have real room to grow. You'll start by taking ownership of content for a small set of customers, then take on bigger and more complex accounts as you're ready. From there, many people grow into leading content strategy or managing customer relationships—first alongside a senior teammate, then independently—which is the path to our Associate Head of Content role. Others go deep instead: our most experienced Senior Content Marketers lead content for our most demanding customers and mentor newer teammates, and that's a career here in its own right.

Whichever direction you grow, you'll keep writing. Even our most senior people do; it's the heart of what we sell.

Your First Few Months

You'll spend your first weeks learning our processes and editorial standards and getting to know your accounts, writing your first pieces with plenty of editorial support. Over your first few months, you'll step into full content ownership of your first account (with your Head of Content close by as a backstop) and grow from there at a pace that matches your experience.

Our Values

At Animalz, our values guide how we show up for our customers, our teammates, and the content we create.

  • Value Over Vanity: Success isn't measured in customer praise, but in the growth outcomes we deliver for them.
  • Two Steps Ahead: Great service means addressing a need or issue before it becomes notable.
  • Power Source, Not Power Trip: We find our greatest impact in being in service to others—our customers, our customers' customers, and one another. True power comes not from authority but from influence.
  • Pursue Mastery: Through deliberate practice and open collaboration, we build expertise that elevates both our work and our ability to deliver transformative results for our clients.
  • Left Brain, Right Brain, Robot Brain: We create extraordinary outcomes by combining empathy and creativity, data and research, and algorithms and AI.
  • In the Arena: We don't advise from the sidelines – we're active practitioners who shape the future of our industry through bold experimentation and continuous learning.

Working Arrangements

Location: Fully remote (Americas or EMEA)

Timezone Requirements: At least 4 hours of overlap with US timezones (EST/PST) to collaborate effectively with our team and customers

Compensation & Benefits

Salary Range: $70,000 – $85,000 USD annually

Placement within the range is based on experience, skills, and demonstrated impact in previous content marketing roles.

  • Unlimited PTO policy
  • Flexible working schedule
  • Technology stipend
  • Learning stipend
  • Health & wellness stipend
  • Team lunch stipend
  • Health & vision insurance (US only)
  • 401(k) retirement plan (US only)

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Animalz, we believe diverse perspectives make us stronger. We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities can thrive. We particularly encourage applications from historically underrepresented groups in tech and marketing.

Equal Opportunity

Animalz is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Salary: $70,000 – $85,000 USD annually

jobs.description:
National Technologies (NTI), a Network Connex Company, is a premier turnkey installer of fiber optic and data center infrastructure. Working on our team puts you on the leading edge of innovation in the digital communications space.

If being a part of a tight-knit organization that operates in some of the most advanced technology environments around the world sounds like a dream job, NTI might be the right fit for you! With the perks of a large organization, NTI remains true to its roots as a home-grown company with an open door culture that welcomes new ideas and encourages professional growth. We set you on the right path with careful onboarding and thorough training programs that prepare you for success in your role and beyond.

THE OPPORTUNITY

National Technologies is seeking a Director of National Labor Coordination to lead enterprise-wide planning, visibility, and allocation of field labor resources. This leader will create a national view of current and future labor demand and ensure the right people are positioned on the right projects at the right time.

Serving as the central coordination point for traveling field labor, this role works across programs, markets, project teams, and operations leadership to anticipate manpower needs before they become project emergencies. The role brings labor demand, employee capabilities, leadership needs, timing, geography, and future assignments together into one national strategy.

WHAT YOU WILL LEAD

  • Maintain a forward-looking national labor-demand forecast across active and upcoming projects.
  • Maintain visibility into available and committed field resources, including employees approaching demobilization and their next assignments.
  • Coordinate mobilizations, demobilizations, transfers, and future assignments across projects, programs, markets, and geographic regions.
  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive field skills registry covering employee experience, certifications, technical strengths, leadership capability, customer experience, travel availability, and project history.
  • Match employee capabilities to project requirements, looking beyond job classifications alone.
  • Identify future labor shortages, surpluses, and capability gaps before they affect project execution.
  • Coordinate staffing requirements with project, program, and operations leadership.
  • Manage critical traveling personnel as national organizational resources rather than isolated market resources.
  • Forecast future recruiting and manpower requirements and coordinate leadership succession needs with National Labor Development.
  • Provide executive leadership with labor forecasts, utilization information, risk assessments, and resource recommendations.
  • Develop standardized manpower-request and forecasting processes, and challenge unsupported or excessive requests.
  • Reduce unnecessary dependence on external labor through stronger internal resource planning.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Success in this role will be reflected in:

  • Accurate national labor forecasts.
  • Critical positions filled when required.
  • Fewer emergency staffing requests.
  • Improved utilization of internal employees.
  • Reduced unnecessary use of external labor.
  • Stronger skill-to-project matching.
  • Greater visibility into future labor demand.
  • Fewer resource conflicts between markets and programs.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Significant experience in construction operations, workforce planning, field operations, labor coordination, or large-project staffing.

  • Experience coordinating labor across multiple projects, markets, or geographic regions.
  • The ability to evaluate employee capabilities beyond job classifications alone.
  • Strong planning, forecasting, organizational, and analytical skills.
  • The ability to manage competing priorities and resolve resource conflicts.
  • Strong communication skills and credibility with both field and office leadership.
  • Experience in union construction environments is strongly preferred.
  • Telecommunications, data center, mission-critical, electrical, or related construction experience is preferred.

THE LEADER WE ARE LOOKING FOR

You understand that manpower planning is more than filling names into open positions. You can evaluate individual capabilities, project requirements, leadership needs, timing, geography, and future demand, then turn those variables into an objective national labor strategy. You make difficult resource recommendations based on the needs of the entire organization, balance project requirements against broader portfolio priorities, and prevent valuable resources from becoming unnecessarily siloed.

jobs.excerpt: Overview Thank you for considering IT Concepts dba Kentro, where innovation drives opportunity and collaboration leads to success.
jobs.description:
Overview

Thank you for considering IT Concepts dba Kentro, where innovation drives opportunity and collaboration leads to success. Our dynamic community of experts is fully committed to advancing our customers' missions, fostering professional growth, and making a positive impact on our communities.

By joining our supportive community, you will find that Kentro is dedicated to your personal and professional development. Together, we can drive meaningful change, spark innovation, and achieve extraordinary milestones.

Kentro is hiring a Back-End Developer IV to serve as lead back-end developer on the Federal Aviation Administration’s (FAA) Accelerated Transformation of Legacy Applications and Systems (ATLAS) program — one of the largest civilian IT modernization efforts in the federal government. ATLAS covers a mission-support portfolio of more than 200 applications and roughly 3,000 databases, moving the agency off legacy sustainment and onto cloud-native architectures, automated workflows, DevSecOps delivery, and integrated AI capability.

In this role you translate portfolio architecture into server-side engineering patterns that back-end teams across the portfolio build against. You bring mastery of multiple back-end technologies, messaging systems, and integration patterns, and you apply it where the work is hardest: decomposing legacy monoliths, untangling point-to-point integrations built over decades, and standing up the enterprise APIs and services that replace them.

You lead complex system integrations, design portfolio and application service/API layers in alignment with the enterprise integration and API strategy, drive microservices adoption as a disciplined practice rather than a default, and provide technical leadership for large-scale back-end transformation across multiple delivery teams.

Location: Remote - This position can be performed remotely within the United States and will support Eastern Time working hours.

Compensation Range: The anticipated base salary range for this position is $149,000–$165,000 annually and reflects Kentro’s good-faith expectations at the time of posting. Final compensation is determined based on the role’s requirements, relevant skills, experience, education, certifications, work location, applicable security clearance requirements, market conditions, internal equity, and contract requirements.

This Job Description reflects the primary duties of the role; however, it is not intended to be all‑inclusive. Team members may be asked to take on additional responsibilities in alignment with customer expectations, business needs, and Kentro’s culture of collaboration and adaptability.

*This position is contingent upon contract award*


Responsibilities

  • Define and implement server-side engineering patterns within established enterprise architecture and platform standards: runtime platforms, frameworks, service boundaries, data access patterns, and reusable service conventions
  • Establish and maintain back-end implementation patterns — microservices, event-driven, API-first, domain decomposition — and apply the architectural criteria that determine when each is the right call
  • Lead complex system integrations across legacy and modernized systems, including protocol translation, data reconciliation, and cutover sequencing on systems that cannot go down
  • Design portfolio and application service/API layers in alignment with the enterprise API and integration strategy: RESTful and event-based interfaces, API contracts and versioning, gateway integration, authentication and authorization patterns, and developer-facing documentation
  • Architect and implement messaging and streaming infrastructure (Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, or cloud-native equivalents), including delivery guarantees, idempotency, ordering, and failure handling
  • Design the serverless and event-driven processing built around that infrastructure — AWS Lambda, Azure Functions, or equivalent for ingestion, transformation, and event handling — and determine where serverless is the right fit against containerized services on cost, latency, and sustainment grounds
  • Drive decomposition of legacy monoliths into services: define bounded contexts, sequence the strangler-pattern migration, and manage the interim state where old and new run side by side
  • Lead database modernization work on the back end — schema evolution, data migration, dual-write and sync strategies, and the transition off legacy data stores
  • Set and enforce back-end engineering standards: coding standards, service templates, error handling, observability, resilience patterns, and performance budgets
  • Own non-functional outcomes for back-end services: availability, latency, throughput, scalability, and cost efficiency in a cloud environment
  • Integrate security into back-end design — secrets management, encryption in transit and at rest, least-privilege service identity, and controls aligned to FISMA, NIST SP 800-53, and applicable FAA and DOT policy
  • Build and maintain the reusable back-end assets that make a modernization factory model work: service scaffolds, shared libraries, integration accelerators, and reference implementations
  • Provide technical leadership, design review, and code review to back-end engineers across multiple teams; mentor mid-level and senior developers
  • Partner with enterprise architecture, front-end, data, and cybersecurity leads to ensure back-end designs fit the target-state architecture
  • Have the ability to write production code on the highest-complexity components as necessary — this is a hands-on lead role, not a purely advisory one

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline
  • 8–10 years of progressive back-end development experience, including demonstrated technical leadership across multiple teams or a large system
  • Expert-level proficiency in one or more major server-side stacks, with working command of a second (e.g., Java/Spring Boot, .NET/C#, Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go)
  • Deep experience designing and operating enterprise APIs: REST, API contracts and versioning, gateway and management tooling, and API security patterns
  • Hands-on expertise with messaging and event-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, SQS/SNS, or equivalent), including production experience with delivery semantics and failure modes
  • Proven experience leading complex system integrations across heterogeneous legacy and modern systems
  • Demonstrated experience decomposing monolithic applications into microservices, including the migration strategy — not just greenfield service development
  • Strong database expertise across relational and non-relational stores: data modeling, query performance, transactions, and large-scale data migration
  • Cloud-native back-end experience in a major cloud environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including containers, orchestration, and managed services
  • Practical DevSecOps experience: CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and observability instrumented into services
  • Ability to set standards other teams adopt, and to communicate technical trade-offs to program leadership and government stakeholders
  • Experience implementing observability, resilience, and performance engineering for distributed services, including tracing, metrics, fault handling, and capacity/performance testing
  • Experience implementing shared engineering standards and reference patterns across multiple delivery teams
  • Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to advise senior government and corporate stakeholders and to justify architectural decisions
  • Working proficiency with approved AI-assisted development tools for code analysis, refactoring, test generation, and documentation

 Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Experience supporting FAA, DOT, or comparable federal civilian modernization programs
  • Experience modernizing mainframe or COBOL-era back ends, or integrating with them during transition
  • Specification-first API development using OpenAPI, including contract-driven design, generated clients and servers, and automated contract testing
  • Production experience designing and operating GraphQL APIs, including schema design, federation, resolver performance, and query cost control
  • Experience building Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or comparable interfaces that expose enterprise services and data to AI systems and agents
  • Hands-on experience with NoSQL data stores — document databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cosmos DB) and graph databases (Neo4j, Neptune, or equivalent) — including knowing when each is the right choice over a relational store
  • Large-scale database modernization experience (Oracle, SQL Server, or mainframe data stores to cloud-native or open-source targets)
  • Experience with service mesh, distributed tracing, and advanced observability in a microservices estate
  • Familiarity with FAA enterprise architecture, security engineering, and Authority to Operate (ATO) processes
  • Experience applying AI/ML or automated code transformation tooling to back-end legacy modernization
  • Relevant certifications: AWS or Azure Solutions Architect / Developer, Kubernetes (CKA/CKAD), or equivalent
  • Prior experience in a modernization factory, delivery center, or platform engineering organization

Clearance Requirement:

  • US Citizen
  • Existing FAA suitability determination or transferable federal background investigation strongly preferred

Benefits

The Company

jobs.description:
We are recruiting highly skilled linguists and creative thinkers for an exclusive content development project. Our goal is to evaluate and push the boundaries of advanced linguistic and reasoning capabilities by creating original, highly complex reasoning puzzles in various target languages. These puzzles must be solvable by a smart, educated native speaker, but resistant to standard automated solving techniques or web searches.

As a Puzzle Designer, you will write original reasoning prompts in your native language. You will focus on deep structural, cultural, and logical nuances that only a true native speaker can navigate.

You will create puzzles across three primary categories:

  • Linguistic Reasoning: Puzzles based on complex grammar rules, syntactic structures, or linguistic ambiguities unique to your language.

  • Cultural Reasoning: Logic puzzles grounded in deep cultural context, local traditions, or culturally-grounded mathematics that AI lacks the lived experience to understand.

  • Wordplay & Riddles: Advanced, original riddles, puns, or double-meanings that do not exist on the internet and cannot be easily translated word-for-word.

Deliverables per item:

For every puzzle you create, you will be required to submit the following:

  1. Native-Language Prompt: The original puzzle written flawlessly in the target language.

  2. Gold Answer: The definitive, correct solution.

  3. Rationale: A logical breakdown of why the answer is correct and how a native speaker arrives at it.

  4. English Translation: A high-quality English translation of the prompt, answer, and rationale for project managers to review.

  5. Difficulty Rating: An assessment of how challenging the puzzle is for a native speaker.

Who We Are Looking For

  • Native-level fluency in the target language with exceptional writing skills.

  • High proficiency in English to provide clear, accurate translations and rationales.

  • Background in Linguistics, Creative Writing, Translation, or Logic/Mathematics: You understand the mechanics of your language deeply.

  • Creative & Analytical Thinker: You can design problems that require lateral thinking, cultural context, and multi-step reasoning rather than memorized facts.

  • Advanced Problem-Solving Awareness: You understand how automated and computational systems process language, enabling you to design highly resistant, complex prompts.

What to Avoid (Disqualifiers)

  • Trivia questions or historical facts that can be Googled.

  • Translating existing English riddles or math problems into your native language.

  • Copying puzzles from books, websites, or existing online databases.

About us

At Niricson, we are redefining the future of civil infrastructure maintenance. Using proprietary sensing technology and AI-powered analytics, we help asset owners make smarter, faster, and safer decisions for critical infrastructure such as bridges, dams and spillways, tunnels, airfields, and more.

As we scale across North America and beyond, we are seeking experienced, well-connected industry advisors to guide our growth, validate our approach, and connect us with the people and problems that matter most.

About the role

We are looking for a Strategic Advisor with deep expertise in bridge asset management or transportation infrastructure management. Ideally, someone with experience in asset ownership, engineering leadership, public works, or large-scale infrastructure portfolios. The advisor will be expected to provide information on how specific clients make decisions, who the key decision makers are, and when key opportunities are expected to be announced. The advisor may also provide information on proper positioning and messaging to key decision-makers.

This is a flexible, advisory engagement. You will work closely with Niricson’s Chief Sales Officer and leadership team to provide strategic insights, industry credibility, and introductions that accelerate our market penetration and alignment with customer needs.

This role is perfect for someone semi-retired, transitioning from public service, or consulting independently, who wants to remain engaged in the industry in a meaningful capacity.

Key Contributions

  • Provide strategic information on proper messaging, decision-makers, and bidding opportunities for clients
  • Advise on engagement strategies with municipal, provincial, and federal infrastructure bodies
  • Offer industry insights on market trends, procurement processes, and regulatory considerations for positioning Niricson’s Product
  • Support credibility-building with potential clients (e.g., participate in key meetings, webinars, and white papers)
  • Introduce Niricson to relevant stakeholders and potential partners, including public works departments, ministries of transportation, and engineering consultants
  • Collaborate on industry events, speaking opportunities, or roundtables where relevant
  • Offer independent feedback on product-market fit and key customer pain points
  • Provide introductions to key decision makers and leadership

Who You Are

  • 15+ years of experience in bridge inspection, transportation infrastructure, public works infrastructure, asset management, or public sector leadership
  • Former Director, Executive, or Asset Owner in a relevant agency or organization
  • Deep understanding of government procurement processes and operational realities of asset management
  • Respected in the industry, with an established professional network
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to act as a trusted advisor
  • Comfortable working independently under a services agreement (not as an employee)

Engagement Structure

This is an independent contractor role and is not considered employment under Canadian law.

As such:

  • You will enter into a subcontract for services with Niricson
  • You will invoice for your time collaborating with the team
  • You are responsible for your own tax filings, business registration, and applicable insurance

What We Offer

  • A chance to influence the future of civil infrastructure and condition maintenance
  • A collaborative and respectful leadership team that values your expertise
  • Flexible, remote engagement
  • Competitive advisory compensation structure
  • Opportunity to help shape safer, longer-lasting infrastructure around the world

Diversity and Inclusion

Niricson values the unique experience of professionals from all backgrounds. We strongly encourage expressions of interest from equity-deserving groups, including indigenous peoples, racialized individuals, women, persons with disabilities, and 2SLGBTQIA+ communities.

We’re a close-knit, mission-driven team that celebrates curiosity, diversity, and excellence.

jobs.excerpt: Knowt is the study app about 8 million high schoolers use to get through AP classes, the SAT and ACT, finals, and college apps.
jobs.description:
Knowt is the study app about 8 million high schoolers use to get through AP classes, the SAT and ACT, finals, and college apps. We’re looking for someone to be the face and voice of Knowt’s high school social presence. You’ll own our TikTok and Instagram (@getknowt) end to end and make them the account students actually want to follow: funny, relatable, and useful.

This isn’t a brand marketing job. You’re not talking at high schoolers. You’re one of them, or close enough that you still speak the language. You know the 2am cram sessions, the group chat panic before an AP exam, the SAT score reveal, and the Common App essay spiral, and you know how to turn all of it into content that hits.

The basics

  • Part-time, 15–20 hrs/week

  • Fully remote

  • Base pay plus performance bonuses tied to account growth

  • You’ll report to our Student Marketing Manager and work with her every day

  • You’ll start with an established account: 476K followers, backed by a platform 8 million students use. You’re not building from zero.

What you’ll do

Create

  • Post one talk-to-camera video every day to TikTok and Instagram. You’re on screen.

  • Take each video from idea to posted: hook, script, filming, editing, caption.

  • Make content about what high schoolers are actually dealing with (AP exams, the SAT and ACT, finals, college apps, test stress) and make it feel like it came from a friend, not a company.

  • Work Knowt into content naturally, so students want to watch it and then use the app.

  • Keep every post native to the platform and to high school culture: current sounds, formats, humor, and slang that’s actually in use, not cringe.

Grow

  • Keep testing hooks, formats, storytelling angles, and CTAs to find winning formulas you can repeat.

  • Plan content around the school calendar so you reach students exactly when they need Knowt: AP season, SAT and ACT test dates, finals, application deadlines.

  • Turn trends, comment sections, and performance data into new content ideas.

Own the results

  • Send a weekly recap: what performed, what didn’t, and what you’re changing next.

  • Track views, watch time, saves, shares, comments, and signups, and make the call on what to scale, fix, or drop.

  • Stay ahead of the schedule. Film in batches so the account never misses a day.

How we work together

Every post is reviewed by our Student Marketing Manager before it goes live. That’s not a committee rewriting your hooks. It’s a fast feedback loop with someone who knows this audience and this account inside out. Expect notes on most videos early on, fewer as you find your rhythm. You’ll need to build time into your week for revisions and turn feedback around within 24 hours.

What we’re looking for

You need:

  • Experience running and growing an account, your own or a brand’s. Show us the numbers.

  • Real comfort on camera. You’ll be on screen every day, so this is non-negotiable.

  • Fluency in high school culture. You’ve lived AP classes, standardized tests, and application season recently enough that it still feels like your world.

  • An instinct for what goes viral on TikTok and Instagram, and the ability to explain why.

  • Reliability. You hit deadlines, respond to feedback quickly, and treat the account like it’s yours.

  • A data-driven approach. Your creative calls are backed by views and conversion data.

Nice to have:

  • Experience making content for edtech, test prep, or student audiences

  • Experience scripting for other creators

  • Strong AP, SAT, or ACT results of your own (credibility goes a long way with this audience)

Why this one’s worth it

  • A real audience from day one. Growing an account this size is something you can point to for years.

  • Real ownership. You set the creative direction, and your ideas don’t get lost in layers of approval. You get direct feedback from one person who wants you to win.

  • A small team that moves fast. You’ll work directly with our Student Marketing Manager, with access to our CMO.

  • Flexible hours, plus room to grow the role if it’s working.

How to apply and what happens next

Apply through the link. If you look like a fit:

  1. Interview with our Student Marketing Manager

  2. Skills screen: a short practical exercise (think scripting and filming a sample video)

  3. Final interview with our Student Marketing Manager and CMO

jobs.excerpt: Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a detail-oriented and execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Creative Designer (DTC, Direct-to-Consumer) opening.
jobs.description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a detail-oriented and execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Creative Designer (DTC, Direct-to-Consumer) opening.

As the Creative Designer (DTC), you will execute DTC creatives (video editing & graphic design) for ads, web, email, and organic content by translating clear creative direction into fast, consistent, and high-quality outputs. You will contribute to the growth of the company's DTC channel by creating and iterating new creatives based on feedback, while keeping all assets organized and properly stored.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Execute DTC Ad Creatives for Meta Ads

  • Edit UGC videos and branded videos following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create static creatives following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create and iterate on variations of top-performing creatives based on DTC Lead feedback and performance insights.

Execute Web and Funnel Creative Assets

  • Design visuals for website pages and landing pages (images, banners, sections, etc.), ensuring designs are clean, clear, and aligned with brand and conversion goals.

Execute Email Creative Design

  • Design and update email creatives in Figma (or similar platform) for email flows and campaigns based on provided copy and direction, ensuring clear structure, strong visual quality, and alignment with brand and campaign needs.

Execute Organic Content Editing for Instagram

  • Edit and prepare video and photo content for Instagram (posts, reels, and stories), ensuring clear structure, strong pacing, and a clean, professional, and consistent visual style aligned with brand guidelines.

Maintain Creative Asset Organization & Hygiene

  • Maintain all creative assets organized, properly named, and stored within the defined folder structure, ensuring easy access, version control, and complete, ready-to-use deliverables.

Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of experience creating video and image creatives for ads, social media, or e-commerce, with a basic understanding of Meta Ads (hooks, pacing, clarity).
  • 1–3 years of experience using tools such as Figma, Adobe Suite, CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar, including AI tools for image and video creation.
  • 1+ years of experience following creative direction and brand guidelines and translating them into clear and consistent designs.
  • 1+ years of experience creating ads, UGC videos, or social content, or a portfolio showcasing real client or brand work, with an emphasis on clear and effective creatives rather than polished perfection.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to detail: does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Commitment (Work ethic): possesses a strong willingness to work hard and sometimes long hours to get the job done. Has a track record of working hard.
  • Consistency (Persistency): demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Growth (Strategic thinking & Visioning): able to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way (determine opportunities and threats through comprehensive analysis of current and future trends).
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do. Brings new ideas to the company.
  • Trust (Honesty/integrity): does not cut corners ethically, earns trust and maintains confidences. Speaks plainly and truthfully.
  • Efficiency: produces a high volume of creative assets quickly while maintaining quality and minimizing wasted effort.
  • Flexibility/adaptability: adjusts quickly to changes in creative direction, feedback, and priorities without friction.
  • Openness to criticism and ideas: often solicits feedback and reacts calmly to criticism or negative feedback.
  • Organization & Planning: keeps files, assets, and tasks well organized, ensuring easy access and clear structure.
  • Creativity / Innovation: develops variations and new ideas from top-performing creatives and DTC Lead feedback, improving and expanding existing concepts.
  • Teamwork: collaborates closely with the DTC team to stay aligned on creative direction, priorities, and execution.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct impact on DTC growth through creative execution.
  • High ownership and autonomy in day-to-day work.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored company trips.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a creative professional who thrives in a fast-paced DTC environment, combines speed with consistency, and is motivated by clear creative direction, performance feedback, and continuous improvement.

Rumble Wellness Group | Independent Contractor | Remote, Canada

You create content. You build community. You bring brands to life.

You know what makes people stop scrolling, share a post, and want to be part of something.

You’re creative, organized, and hands-on. You can plan a content calendar, create engaging social content, capture the personality of a brand, and keep things moving without constant direction.

You understand that great social media is about more than posting consistently — it’s about building a recognizable brand and an engaged community.

WHO WE ARE

Rumble Wellness Group brings together two experience-driven brands: Rumble Boxing and PRML Social.

Rumble combines high-energy boxing and strength training with music, culture, and community. PRML Social brings together sauna, cold plunge, music, and social connection to create a different kind of wellness experience.

We're looking for someone who can bring both brands to life online while helping build meaningful local partnerships and community connections.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Social Media & Content Creation — Primary Focus

  • Own and manage the social media content calendar across Rumble Boxing and PRML Social.
  • Create, write, schedule, and publish engaging content that reflects each brand's personality.
  • Capture and edit short-form video, Reels, Stories, and other social-first content.
  • Turn classes, events, customer experiences, promotions, and behind-the-scenes moments into compelling stories.
  • Stay current on social trends, formats, and opportunities to keep our content fresh and relevant.
  • Coordinate with location teams to gather content and highlight local communities.
  • Monitor engagement and use performance insights to improve content and inform future calendars.

Partnerships & Community — Secondary Focus

  • Identify and coordinate local partnerships with businesses, creators, influencers, and community organizations.
  • Support collaborations, events, and activations that introduce new audiences to our brands.
  • Coordinate partnership deliverables, content collaborations, and social media promotion.
  • Build relationships that strengthen brand awareness and community engagement.

Collaboration & Execution

  • Work independently while collaborating with senior leadership and location teams.
  • Manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and keep projects moving.
  • Bring forward creative ideas and take ownership of execution from planning through delivery.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Creative: You have a strong eye for content, storytelling, and what works on social media.
  • Hands-on: You're comfortable filming, editing, writing copy, and publishing content yourself.
  • Organized: You can manage multiple content calendars, deadlines, and projects.
  • Social-savvy: You understand Instagram, TikTok, Reels, Stories, and emerging content trends.
  • Proactive: You take initiative, work independently, and don't need constant direction.
  • Collaborative: You're comfortable working with different teams, creators, and external partners.

Experience in social media management, content creation, fitness, wellness, hospitality, or lifestyle brands is an asset. Experience with tools such as Canva, CapCut, and social media scheduling platforms is a plus.

THE DETAILS

  • Location: Remote; with ability to get to site in Toronto.
  • Engagement: Independent contractor.
  • Hours: Approximately 15–20 hours per week, depending on business needs and agreed scope.
  • Compensation: Hourly contract rate based on experience.
  • Schedule: Flexible, with occasional evening or weekend availability for content capture and events.

THE BOTTOM LINE

We're looking for someone who can keep our brands visible, relevant, and connected to their communities — someone who can turn ideas into great content and consistently bring our social channels to life.

If you're creative, plugged into social culture, and love building brands through content, we'd love to meet you.

Salary: $25 – $30 / hour

About the Role

A US-based medical practice specializing in sleep medicine is seeking an experienced Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) Care Coordinator to support patients on CPAP therapy. This role is central to the practice's remote monitoring program: you will review patient data daily, conduct outbound calls to patients who need encouragement or troubleshooting, document interactions accurately for billing compliance, and coordinate with the clinical and DME teams to ensure patients remain on therapy and progressing well.

This is a clinically adjacent role that requires a warm phone presence, strong organizational habits, and comfort working with data in a remote monitoring platform. A clinical background — nursing, medical assisting, respiratory therapy, or similar — is preferred and carries weight for billing purposes as well as patient care quality. Training will be provided on all internal workflows. The practice is looking for a coordinator who can be ready to contribute by November 1, 2026.

Key Responsibilities

Daily Data Review and Patient Flagging

  • Review patients' CPAP usage data in Sanusom daily, including usage hours, mask leak rates, AHI scores, and missed nights
  • Identify patients who fall below therapy thresholds or show concerning trends and prioritize them for outreach
  • Download compliance reports, upload them to the appropriate patient chart in Athena, and assign them to the correct provider for review

Patient Outreach and Coaching

  • Conduct outbound calls to patients with low usage, elevated mask leaks, or other therapy concerns, using established call scripts and intervention protocols
  • Troubleshoot common CPAP issues including mask fit problems, pressure discomfort, dry mouth, and air leaks, and guide patients toward solutions
  • Encourage and motivate patients to remain on therapy in a warm, supportive manner — the goal is to help patients succeed, not to pressure them
  • Handle a daily outbound call volume of approximately 60 patient calls
  • Schedule follow-up calls and ensure no patient is lost to follow-up

Documentation and Billing Support

  • Use Sanusom's call timer to record monitoring time accurately for each patient interaction, in compliance with RPM billing requirements
  • Document every call in both Sanusom and Athena using standard clinical templates, ensuring records are complete, timely, and accurate
  • Respond to patient messages via Klara within established response time standards

Care Coordination

  • Coordinate with the DME and CPAP supply team on mask refits, equipment issues, and supply needs identified during patient calls
  • Coordinate with scheduling for follow-up provider appointments when clinically indicated
  • Escalate clinical concerns to the provider promptly and in accordance with established protocols

Systems

The practice uses Sanusom (remote monitoring platform), Athena (EHR), and Klara (patient messaging). Full training on internal workflows will be provided. Prior experience with RPM, RTM, or CPAP compliance platforms is a strong advantage.

Qualifications

Required

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in remote patient monitoring, chronic care management, or patient outreach — ideally with sleep medicine, CPAP therapy, or DME patients
  • Solid understanding of CPAP therapy, including common patient challenges such as mask fit issues, pressure intolerance, dry mouth, and air leaks
  • Warm, patient, and encouraging phone presence — you know how to motivate a patient who is struggling without making them feel pressured or judged
  • Organized and detail-oriented, with a consistent habit of accurate and timely documentation
  • Comfortable reviewing data dashboards and identifying patients who need follow-up based on usage trends
  • Strong understanding of HIPAA and patient confidentiality requirements, particularly in a remote work environment
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection and a quiet, private workspace suitable for clinical patient calls

Preferred

  • Clinical background such as a nursing degree (RN or LPN), medical assistant certification, respiratory therapist (RT) credential, or equivalent — this matters for both patient care quality and RPM billing compliance
  • Experience with Sanusom, Athena, or Klara
  • Prior experience in a sleep medicine practice, DME company, or CPAP compliance program
  • Familiarity with RPM and RTM billing codes and documentation requirements

What We Are Looking For

CPAP therapy is only effective when patients actually use it — and many patients struggle in silence without the right support. The RPM Care Coordinator is the bridge between the data and the patient: you see that someone has not been using their equipment, and you pick up the phone. The quality of that call matters. Patients need to feel heard, not lectured. They need practical help, not a checklist. And they need to know that someone at their practice actually noticed.

The right candidate for this role combines clinical awareness with genuine interpersonal warmth. You are organized enough to manage a high daily call volume without losing track of anyone, disciplined enough to document every interaction correctly for billing, and motivated by the knowledge that your work directly improves patient health outcomes.

jobs.description:
About the team

Zillow has the richest housing market data in the industry. You help us build out a foundational model that leverages a representation of who is in the market, what they’ll pay, and how that demand clears against supply.

The Agentic Foundations team is a focused group of 15–20 applied scientists within Zillow’s broader Agentic AI organization, building the foundational AI technologies that power the next generation of home shopping experiences. This Principal Applied Scientist will help build the Zillow World Model: a single, uncertainty-aware model of the housing market that ties together supply, demand and macro conditions such as mortgage rates and policy. Today, bespoke models like Zestimate, Time-to-Pending and Listing Soon each answer one question well. The foundational “World” Model aims to answer the multi-step “what if” questions consumers actually ask, such as “If I list at $500K, when will it sell?” or “I want at least $800K; what should I list at?”, as consistent projections of one market state, and to serve those answers to Voyager, Zillow’s AI Mode, as a tool.

This is a very new field and an open-ended research effort. You will partner with the World Model working group (listing-state modeling, market simulation and evaluation) and with product, engineering, platform and data teams. Zillow observes both sides of the housing market at a depth no one else can, so this work can directly help guide users toward their goals.

About the role

  • Build the demand layer of the World Model: turn large-scale shopper behavior (search, engagement, session trajectories) into structured demand representations, including explicit attention-to-demand conversion.
  • Design and train latent state-space, multi-tower and/or sequential dynamics models with calibrated uncertainty that support multi-step rollouts, forward planning (“if I do X, what happens?”) and backward planning (“I want X; what should I do?”).
  • Estimate willingness-to-pay, per-home demand curves and market clearing dynamics, connecting learned representations to economic quantities.
  • Apply causal identification in observational data and define where the model must abstain because a correlation does not support a “what-if” claim.
  • Contribute to the World Model evaluation battery: state probes, calibrated multi-target forecasts, rollout drift, causal checks and out-of-regime replays.
  • Independently drive ambiguous research end-to-end, and provide technical leadership and mentorship in translating state-of-the-art research into production impact.

Who you are

Must-haves

  • PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
  • Hands-on experience building latent state-space or world models (RSSM/Dreamer-family, JEPA-style latent prediction, or event-sequence transformers): belief-state representations, stochastic transition models with calibrated uncertainty, and evaluation of multi-step rollouts, not just single-target forecasting.
  • Demonstrated ability to turn large-scale user behavior data into structured demand representations (utility or willingness-to-pay estimation, funnel/conversion modeling) while correcting for selection bias in platform-observed populations.
  • Practical causal inference in observational settings (quasi-experiments, instruments, policy discontinuities), and judgment about when a learned correlation does and does not support a counterfactual claim.
  • Proven record of delivering on open-ended research projects, with the ability to scope ambiguous problems and provide technical leadership to scientists and MLEs.
  • Strong programming skills, especially Python, plus experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
