Title:Business Development Manager(Utilities and Critical Infrastructure)

Location:(Unites States) - Remote role

Hanwha Vision America (HVA), formerly known as Hanwha Techwin America (HTA), is an affiliate of the Hanwha Group, a Fortune Global 500 company. HVA is an industry-leading provider of advanced network video surveillance products, including IP cameras, storage devices, and video management systems founded on world-class technologies. We offer end-to-end security solutions and have achieved global success across various industry verticals, including retail, transportation, education, banking, healthcare, hospitality, and airports.

We are seeking a Business Development Manager (BDM) for the Utilities & Critical Infrastructure Vertical that drives new-logo growth, brand preference and revenue for Hanwha Vision's intelligent video surveillance and edge-AI solutions across electric, water/wastewater and natural gas utilities.

Target environments include transmission and distribution substations, generation sites, utility control centers, water and wastewater treatment plants, pump stations, reservoirs and dams, and gas distribution facilities. Target customers include investor-owned utilities, public power and municipal utilities, and electric cooperatives.

As the vertical's subject matter expert, the BDM builds senior relationships with utility security directors, compliance (NERC CIP) managers, operations and engineering leaders, and the system integrators and engineering firms that serve them. The role positions Hanwha's thermal, AI analytics, PTZ and ruggedized camera portfolio against the sector's core problems: physical attacks on substations, copper theft and vandalism at unmanned sites, regulatory compliance, and lean operations staff.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • New-Logo Hunting & Vertical Strategy:Build and run a national plan to win net-new utility accounts. Prioritize target lists of investor-owned utilities, public power and municipal utilities, electric co-ops and large water/wastewater systems.
  • End-User Relationship Management:Build trust-based relationships with utility corporate security directors, NERC CIP compliance managers, substation and T&D engineering, water/wastewater operations leaders, and risk and emergency management teams.
  • Partner & Channel Alignment:Work with Hanwha regional sales, the A&E team, utility-focused system integrators, engineering firms (EPCs and consulting engineers that write substation and treatment-plant specs), and distribution partners to identify, register and win multi-site and system-wide rollouts.
  • Specification & Standards Influence:Get Hanwha written into utility security standards, substation design standards and engineer-of-record specifications, which govern purchasing.
  • Solution Selling & Technical Advocacy:Deliver presentations and demonstrations of Hanwha's value for utilities, such as:
    • Substation & Remote-Site Perimeter Protection:Radiometric thermal and AI-based perimeter intrusion detection, PTZ auto-tracking and long-range coverage for unmanned substations, pump stations and reservoirs. Covers ballistic-attack, intrusion, copper-theft and vandalism scenarios.
    • Compliance Support:Positioning video, analytics and audit trails to support customers' NERC CIP-014 security plans, CIP-006 physical access monitoring, and water-sector risk and resilience assessments.
    • Operational Thermal Monitoring:Temperature monitoring of transformers, breakers and other critical assets for early fault detection and preventive maintenance.
    • Supply-Chain Trust:Leading with Hanwha's trusted supply chain and cybersecurity posture with utility security, IT/OT and procurement teams.
    • Enterprise Integration:Interoperability with enterprise VMS, PSIM and utility SOC platforms over constrained substation and remote networks.
  • Funding & Procurement Navigation:Help customers and partners align projects with public bids, rate-case capital plans and grant programs, including the federal-funding rules attached to them.
  • Market Intelligence & Feedback:Communicate Voice of the Customer insights to Product Management to shape utility-specific products, such as substation-hardened and long-range thermal hardware.
  • Pipeline & Forecast Management:Keep an accurate CRM pipeline that reflects utility capital-planning and budget cycles, RFP timelines and multi-year rollouts.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Experience:5–7+ years of business development or enterprise sales in physical security, video surveillance, utility technology or industrial automation. Must have a track record of winning net-new accounts, not only growing existing ones.
  • Vertical Expertise:Deep, verifiable knowledge of the utility ecosystem. That includes public procurement and RFPs, rate-case and capital-budget timing, and the differences between investor-owned utilities, public power and co-ops.
  • Regulatory Fluency:Working knowledge of the regulations that drive utility security spending, especially NERC CIP-014 and CIP-006 for electric utilities and AWIA risk and resilience assessments for water.
  • Technical Proficiency:Strong understanding of IP video networks, OT and substation network topologies, bandwidth-constrained remote sites, enterprise VMS architectures, and thermal and AI analytics.
  • Relationship Network:An existing network among utility security and compliance leaders, utility-focused integrators, and engineering firms that design substations and treatment plants is a significant plus.
  • Communication Skills:Excellent presentation and writing skills. Must be able to translate technical and compliance concepts into clear risk-reduction and operating benefits for utilities.
  • Clearance to Access Sites:Able to pass a utility personnel risk assessment for unescorted access, which under NERC CIP-004 includes identity verification and a seven-year criminal history check.
  • Travel:Up to 50% regional and national travel for meetings, substation and plant site surveys, and utility trade events.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Frequent travel via commercial airlines and/or driving is required.
  • Must be able to enter energized substations, treatment plants and remote utility sites for site surveys. Must follow all utility safety rules and escort requirements and wear required PPE (hard hat, safety glasses, steel-toe boots, FR clothing where required).
  • Must be able to pass utility background screening for site access.
  • Standard office conditions when working from a home office.

College Board – Technology – Information Security Office

Location: This is a fully remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office).

Type: This is a full-time position


About the Team 

The Cyber Security Operations team is critical to the strategic foundation of our products, most notably the secure delivery of our Digital SAT and AP programs. We are a highly motivated group of cyber security professionals who take a proactive approach to ensuring a strong security posture. We partner across the organization to mature our Threat Management and Incident Response procedures and are constantly seeking and experimenting with new technologies. We are currently using a variety of cutting-edge tools that provide comprehensive cyber security operations for the College Board’s critical infrastructure in support of the College Board’s mission to connect students to college success and opportunity.


We learn by doing. The team experiments with different ideas, works out solutions together, and encourages each person to pursue what they are passionate about, whether that is building a new capability, automating threat hunts, or creating new internal tools. A strong managed detection and response partnership and a deliberately balanced on-call model keep alert fatigue low, so the team can focus on meaningful threat hunting and the investigations that matter.


About the Opportunity  

As a Cyber Threat Hunter, you will play a hands-on role in defending the cloud and enterprise environments that power the Digital SAT, AP, and other high-stakes programs. You will work in an AWS-heavy environment at national scale, where proactive, hypothesis-driven threat hunting, careful investigation, and clear documentation directly support exam integrity and student trust.


This is an early-career role for someone with strong cyber defense foundations who is eager to learn fast. You will start by getting to know our environment and tools, then move into threat hunts paired with senior engineers, help build and tune detections, support incident investigations, and bring a fresh perspective to our playbooks. Over time, you will help validate controls through purple team exercises and use automation to make our workflows faster and more reliable.


You will partner closely with engineers, architects, product security, GRC, and product teams to close visibility gaps and reduce risk in practical, measurable ways. Success in this role means fewer blind spots, higher fidelity alerts, and a cyber defense program that is proactive rather than reactive.


In this role, you will:

Threat Hunting & Detection Engineering (45%)

  • Execute hypothesis-driven threat hunts across AWS, identity, endpoint, and network telemetry, starting alongside senior engineers, and document findings and recommended control or detection improvements.
  • Help build, tune, and maintain detections focused on high-risk behaviors such as IAM misuse, persistence, privilege escalation, and data access or exfiltration.
  • Reduce alert noise through structured tuning, baselining, and enrichment while preserving meaningful coverage.
  • Map detections and hunts to MITRE ATT&CK techniques to identify and close visibility gaps.

Incident Response & Investigation (30%)

  • Support investigation and containment of security incidents by performing log analysis, helping scope impact, and documenting findings.
  • Contribute to the development and refinement of incident response playbooks for common cloud and identity-based scenarios.
  • Contribute clear after-action reports that identify root cause, control gaps, and prioritized remediation steps.
  • Participate in periodic tabletop or fire drill exercises to validate readiness and improve response coordination.

Purple Teaming & Continuous Improvement (15%)

  • Participate in purple team exercises to validate detection effectiveness and help prioritize remediation of identified gaps.

jobs.description:
Company Overview:Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody. Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients.

BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma-to-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world-class support on this first-of-its-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock.

We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!

Hours: Full-time, salaried (40hrs/week), Mon-Fri, 7:30am-9pm ET rotating shifts and rotating Saturdays 7:00am-5pm ET

The Opportunity:

As a BlinkRx Pharmacist, you are the clinical backbone of our closed-door facility. You will verify prescriptions with speed and precision, provide proactive phone-based patient counseling, and collaborate with prescribers to keep medications moving without compromising safety. This role is ideal for pharmacists who thrive in a structured, high-throughput environment and are passionate about improving patient outcomes at scale.

Responsibilities:

Prescription Verification and Dispensing

  • Review and clinically verify new and refill prescriptions for therapeutic appropriateness, drug-drug interactions, contraindications, and dosing accuracy
  • Validate prescription data entry performed by pharmacy technicians, ensuring transcription accuracy from provider orders and transfer records
  • Perform pharmacist verification of filled prescriptions in a closed-door fulfillment environment, confirming accuracy of drug, dose, quantity, NDC, and labeling prior to release for shipment
  • Perform daily prospective drug utilization review (DUR) to identify and resolve clinical flags before fulfillment
  • Manage specialty medication handling requirements including cold-chain verification

Patient Care

All patient interaction at BlinkRx is conducted by phone or digital platforms. Our pharmacists are the primary clinical contact for patients and must deliver a high standard of care in every call.

  • Provide proactive outbound patient counseling calls for new prescriptions, addressing drug education, expected side effects, dosing instructions, storage requirements, and adherence strategies
  • Handle inbound clinical patient calls related to counseling and clinical inquiries, while directing non-clinical inquiries, such as refill status and delivery questions, to the patient support team.
  • Document all patient interactions thoroughly in the patient profile within the pharmacy management system
  • Support Spanish-speaking patients with bilingual counseling where applicable

Prescriber Collaboration and Clinical Outreach

  • Contact prescriber offices via phone and electronic messaging to clarify incomplete, ambiguous, or clinically inappropriate prescriptions prior to dispensing
  • Partner with prescribers on therapeutic substitutions, DAW overrides, and formulary alternatives to reduce dispensing delays

Pharmacy Technician Supervision and Workflow Management

  • Supervise pharmacy technicians across data entry, prescription processing, packaging, and fulfillment workflows in accordance with state board regulations and in collaboration with technician management
  • Conduct real-time quality checks on technician work product, providing immediate corrective feedback to maintain accuracy standards
  • Identify and escalate technician performance trends to pharmacy leadership; participate in coaching and training as directed

Compliance, Safety and Quality

  • Ensure strict compliance with HIPAA, state pharmacy practice acts, federal DEA regulations, and all BlinkRx corporate policies
  • Oversee proper handling, documentation, and destruction of PHI-containing records and materials in alignment with privacy protocols
  • Participate in quality assurance activities including internal audits, prescription error tracking, and near-miss reporting
  • Report adverse drug events and medication errors through established pharmacovigilance channels, when applicable
  • Maintain fulfillment area compliance standards, including proper storage of temperature-sensitive medications

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with pharmacy leadership, patient services, clinical, compliance, and technology teams to drive operational and clinical improvements
  • Coordinate with the shipping and fulfillment team to resolve packaging errors, return-to-sender issues, and delivery failures affecting patient medication access
  • Provide clinical input on technology enhancements, workflow tools, and software configurations that affect the pharmacist verification or patient counseling experience
  • Participate in team huddles, quality reviews, and department meetings to support continuous improvement initiatives

Qualifications:

Required

  • Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) degree from an ACPE-accredited College of Pharmacy
  • Active Missouri Pharmacy License in good standing with the Missouri Board of Pharmacy
  • Strong command of the English language (written and verbal); bilingual Spanish preferred for phone-based patient counseling
  • Demonstrated ability to perform high-volume prescription verification with strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to learn pharmacy management systems, verification platforms, and internal workflow tools

Preferred

  • 3+ years of experience in a mail order, specialty, retail or closed-door fulfillment pharmacy
  • Active pharmacy licensure required in home state; candidates must obtain licensure in 3 additional states from the list below within the first 9 months of hire (prior licensure in any of the following states is a plus):
    • AK, AL, AR, CA, ID, IL, KS, KY, LA, MA, MD, MI, MS, NE, NV, OK, OR, TN, TX, VA, WV
  • Familiarity with pharmacovigilance or adverse drug event reporting protocols

What Success Looks Like:

  • Prescription verification queues are processed accurately and on time without sacrificing clinical quality
  • Every patient who receives a counseling call feels informed, supported, and confident in their therapy
  • Prescriber outreach is proactive and efficient, minimizing dispensing delays caused by incomplete or unclear orders
  • Compliance and quality standards are upheld without exception in a fast-paced environment
  • You are a trusted clinical partner within the BlinkRx team — shaping the patient experience from behind the scenes

#blinkindeed

Why Join Us:It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population. At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year. Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer II to own and ship one of the team's most complex multi-quarter work-streams — at the seam of omnichannel identity, international storefront search expansions, and partner-owned integrations that we ultimately operate ourselves. You'll be the technical DRI for your area: framing the problem, designing the systems, driving the rollout, and codifying the patterns so the rest of Enterprise Platform can adopt them without your direct involvement. You'll work closely with Staff engineers on the team who set the team-wide architectural thesis, and partner across Connected Stores, Professional Services, Commerce, Search, Data Engineering, and ML to land integrations that hold up across organizational boundaries.

About the Job

  • Own a multi-quarter integration workstream end to end — for example, unified customer identity across FoodStorm and Storefront Pro, international storefront and search expansion for enterprise retailers, or consolidation of bespoke retailer-vertical services onto shared Instacart platform rails — from problem framing through design, implementation, rollout, and deprecation of legacy paths.
  • Drive the technical direction for your area: write the ERDs, propose the options, make and defend the trade-off calls, and bring partner teams along through design reviews and written artifacts that read clearly for first-time readers.
  • Lead vendor and cross-team integrations where Instacart will eventually own the system — push for the right observability, fallback behavior, and cost/latency guardrails up front, and challenge partner designs early rather than inheriting them at handoff.
  • Build reusable patterns, frameworks, and templates that other engineers across Enterprise Foundations and adjacent teams adopt with minimal hand-holding; treat "system at a glance" docs and migration runbooks as first-class deliverables.
  • Operate hands-on as a senior individual contributor on the highest-leverage technical work in your area; raise the bar on design quality, code quality, observability, and operational rigor.
  • Mentor more junior engineers in your area, delegate well-defined implementation pieces while retaining overall technical ownership, and act as a credible technical peer to senior and staff engineers in adjacent organizations.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7+ years of backend software engineering experience, with a track record of owning complex, multi-quarter projects end to end as a senior individual contributor.
  • Demonstrated ability to act as the technical DRI for cross-team workstreams — framing problems proactively, proposing options with clear recommendations, identifying risks early, and driving execution through to adoption.
  • Experience designing and shipping distributed systems and integrations that span multiple services, teams, or external partners in a production environment with real customers.
  • Strong proficiency with backend technologies in production environments (e.g., Ruby/Rails, Python, Go, or similar), along with relational databases, distributed data systems, and cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS or GCP).
  • Track record of producing durable technical artifacts — ERDs, design docs, runbooks, and reusable patterns — that other engineers can build on without ongoing direct support.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in ambiguous, high-growth environments where partner roadmaps and integration commitments are still maturing, with a record of driving clarity and forward motion through that ambiguity.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct domain experience in commerce platforms, omnichannel retail, OMS, POS, catering systems, or connected-store / in-store technology.
  • Experience with customer identity, account linking, or SSO integrations across multiple consumer-facing surfaces.
  • Experience building or scaling search, retrieval, or ranking systems, including integrations with third-party search providers.
  • Background working on international expansion — localization, data residency, multi-region infrastructure, or in-country compliance requirements.
  • Experience leading vendor or partner-owned integrations where the system is ultimately operated and owned by the integrating team.
  • Experience designing per-tenant configuration, isolation, and extensibility for multi-tenant enterprise platforms.

jobs.description:
Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Admin & Client Support Coordinator

Compensation range: $1,400 AUD - $1,800 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type: Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: Split shift

Morning window: 7:00 AM-11:00 AM Sydney Time (4:00 AM–8:00 AM Philippine Time)

Afternoon window: 3:00 PM-7:00 PM Sydney Time (12:00 PM–4:00 PM Philippine Time)

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: An established Australian in-home care provider and federally funded community delivering services through aged care, NDIS, Department of Veterans’ Affairs, and Hospital Transition Care programs.

Role Overview: We’re seeking a calm, mature and organised Admin & Client Support Coordinator to be the first point of contact for clients, Care Workers and partners. You will answer calls, understand what each caller needs, and make sure every matter reaches the right person and gets resolved.

Alongside the phones, you will support the business with transactional roster updates, vendor follow-ups and agreements, appointment booking and general administration. This role suits someone who brings warmth to difficult conversations, keeps meticulous notes and takes ownership of follow-through.

Key Responsibilities:

Call Handling and Client Support

  • Answer incoming calls from clients, families, Care Workers, vendors and prospective clients.
  • Listen carefully, calm distressed callers and work with them towards a resolution.
  • Record accurate call notes: caller details, request, urgency and required action.
  • Direct each matter to the right team (Care Management, HR, Sales or Management) and confirm urgent items are received.
  • Resolve routine enquiries directly once trained on the relevant process.

Roster Support

  • Record client cancellations, Care Worker sick calls and other short-term changes.
  • Update approved systems and notify affected staff and the coordination team.
  • Confirm each change has been handed over and actioned.

Vendor, Documentation and Follow-up

  • Follow up vendors and support the preparation and tracking of vendor agreements.
  • Track documents awaiting signature, approval or information and chase them to completion.
  • Keep files organised, version-controlled and stored in the approved location.
  • Maintain a task tracker so every request is followed through to completion.

Sales, HR and General Admin

  • Record new enquiries and book sales calls, consultations and follow-ups.
  • Assist with recruitment admin, candidate scheduling and HR record keeping.
  • Manage calendars, prepare correspondence and provide regular progress updates.

Requirements

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • 2+ years in administration, client service, call handling or a similar role.
  • Experience supporting Australian clients or businesses.
  • Excellent spoken and written English with a warm, clear and professional phone manner.
  • High emotional intelligence and composure with distressed or demanding callers.
  • Strong note-taking, organisation and follow-up skills.
  • Confident across multiple systems, including cloud phone platforms, CRMs and shared drives.
  • Good judgement on when to act and when to escalate.
  • Highly trustworthy with confidential client and staff information.

Highly Regarded:

  • Experience in home care, aged care, disability (NDIS), health or community services.
  • Familiarity with RingCentral or similar cloud telephony.
  • Experience with rostering or care management software.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Callers feel heard, reassured and confident their matter is in hand.
  • Every call, referral and roster change is recorded accurately and promptly.
  • Urgent and sensitive matters reach the right person quickly.
  • Follow-ups are closed out and the business owner is kept informed.
  • Consistent, reliable availability across both call windows.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

jobs.excerpt: Request for Proposals: User Experience (UX) Review and Redesign Recommendations for asiapacific.
jobs.description:
Request for Proposals: User Experience (UX) Review and Redesign Recommendations for asiapacific.ca

Issued byAsia Pacific Foundation of Canada (APF Canada)RFP reference no.APFC-2026-UX-01Date issuedOctober 22, 2026Questions dueNovember 2, 5:00 p.m. PTProposals dueNovember 23, 5:00 p.m. PTSubmit to[]

1. About APF Canada

The Asia Pacific Foundation of Canada is Canada’s only national public‑purpose institution dedicated exclusively to Canada‑Asia engagement. Our vision is a prosperous, secure Canada shaping its future through high‑impact engagement with Asia, and our mission is to enable Canadians to understand, connect with, and succeed in Asia.

2. Background and Purpose

APF Canada is seeking a qualified UX consultant or firm to conduct an independent, evidence-based review of asiapacific.ca and to deliver clear, prioritized, and implementable recommendations for modernizing the site’s structure, usability, and visual design – without diminishing the visibility of our core research outputs, programs, and networks.

This engagement is a strategic re-design engagement. It is not an implementation contract (see Section 6).

3. Objectives
The successful proponent will help APF Canada achieve the following:

  1. Understand our audiences. Establish who actually uses asiapacific.ca, what they come for, and where the current experience fails them – grounded in analytics and primary user research, not assumption.
  2. Simplify the information architecture. Recommend a navigation and content taxonomy that is intelligible to a first-time visitor while still surfacing the full breadth of our research, programs, and networks.
  3. Make our research findable. Recommend search, filtering, and browsing patterns appropriate to a large and growing publications archive.
  4. Modernize the visual design. Recommend a contemporary, credible, distinctly APF Canada visual direction appropriate to a national policy institution – clean, readable, and confident rather than decorative.
  5. Clarify the digital ecosystem. Advise on the relationship between asiapacific.ca and our satellite properties.

4. Timeline

RFP issuedOctober 22, 2026Deadline for written questionsNovember 2, 2026Answers posted to all proponentsNovember 6, 2026

Proposals due

November 23, 2026, 5:00 p.m. PT

Anticipated engagement duration is [14–18] weeks from kickoff. Proponents should propose a schedule aligned to their methodology and flag any dependencies on APF Canada staff availability.

5. Budget

The total budget for this engagement is not to exceed C$30,000, inclusive of all professional fees, participant incentives, software and research tool costs, travel, and applicable taxes.

Proponents must provide a detailed cost breakdown by phase and by deliverable. Where a proponent believes the objectives cannot be fully met within this budget, they should identify which elements they would recommend prioritizing and price optional components separately.

6. Proposal Requirements
Proposals must not exceed 20 pages excluding appendices, CVs, and portfolio samples, and must include:

  1. Cover letter (1 page) – primary contact, firm overview, and a statement of interest.

Page of

  1. Understanding of the assignment – your reading of APF Canada’s challenge, based on your own review of asiapacific.ca. We are particularly interested in what you observe that we may not have.
  2. Proposed approach and methodology – including research methods, participant recruitment strategy, and how you will balance modernization against preservation of our core content.
  3. Work plan and schedule – phases, milestones, deliverables, and dependencies.
  4. Team – named individuals, roles, time allocation, and relevant experience. Identify who will lead the engagement and who will conduct research and design. Note any subcontractors.
  5. Relevant experience – three comparable projects, ideally involving content-heavy, research-driven, mission-based, bilingual, or public-sector organizations. Include client references with contact information (references contacted only for shortlisted proponents).
  6. Portfolio – samples demonstrating both research rigour and design quality. Where possible, include evidence of measured outcomes.
  7. Bilingual and accessibility capability – describe your French-language research capacity and your accessibility expertise, including relevant certifications or auditing experience.
  8. Detailed budget – as described in Section 5.
  9. Assumptions, exclusions, and requirements of APF Canada.

7. Submission Instructions

Submit proposals as a single PDF to [] with the subject line “APFC-2026-UX-01 – [Proponent Name]” no later than November 23, 2026, 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time. Late submissions will not be considered.

Written questions may be submitted to the same address until November 2, 2026. Questions and answers will be compiled, anonymized, and circulated to all registered proponents to ensure fairness.

Contact: Michael Roberts, Communications Director, Asia Pacific Foundation of Canada,

Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.

What You’ll Do:

  • Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.
  • Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.
  • Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.
  • Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have:

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.
  • Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.
  • Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.
  • Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture

Role

The Platform Quality Engineer is a hands-on engineering role within StarCompliance’s centralised Platform Quality Engineering function, responsible for ensuring platform-level quality assurance across the enterprise SaaS platform.
Reporting to the Lead Quality Architect, the Platform Quality Engineer contributes directly to the design, implementation, and maintenance of automated quality controls that validate cross-service integration, core enterprise user journeys, and non-functional platform characteristics. The role is focused primarily on integration and API-level testing across a distributed, cloud-native system, including asynchronous and event-driven workflows.
StarCompliance’s enterprise platform is built on distributed services and cloud infrastructure, including messaging and integration components such as Azure Service Bus. The Platform Quality Engineer is expected to understand how these systems behave under load, failure, and recovery conditions, and how to test them to ensure reliability, resilience, and performance at scale.
The role places strong emphasis on validating failure modes, resilience, and recovery behaviour across distributed services, diagnosing complex system failures using logs, telemetry, and test data, and contributing to enterprise performance testing.
The Platform Quality Engineer works closely with Product Owners and engineering teams to understand upcoming platform changes and integrations, ensuring the enterprise platform is validated under realistic functional and load scenarios ahead of release

  • Design, implement, and maintain automated tests primarily at the integration and API layers to validate behaviour across distributed services.
  • Develop tests that validate asynchronous and event-driven workflows, including messaging, retries, ordering, and failure scenarios (e.g. Azure Service Bus–based integrations).
  • Contribute production-quality code to shared automation frameworks and quality tooling used across the enterprise platform.
  • Design and execute performance and scalability tests for the enterprise SaaS platform
  • Build and maintain performance test data, scenarios, and workloads that reflect real-world usage patterns, including message throughput and concurrency.
  • Integrate automated functional and performance tests into CI/CD pipelines, contributing to reliable, high-signal quality gates.

POS-20140

The Legal Team

HubSpot's Legal team is a proactive, business-enabling partner — not a back-office function. We help our teams move fast, smart, and responsibly, balancing innovation with rigor so HubSpot can scale as a publicly traded, AI-native company while maintaining trust, compliance, and clarity.

Role Summary

This is a role for a senior governance attorney who has earned the confidence of boards and committees, not just supported them. You will be HubSpot's primary governance lawyer — owning the company's governance policy framework, the NG&S Committee, the operational backbone for all three Board committees, proxy governance and annual meeting, and governance-focused investor engagement.

The governance attorney who succeeds here doesn't just maintain recurring programs — they actively improve how those programs work, bringing the same rigor to process design as to legal advice.

HubSpot is building an AI-first legal function, and we want someone who sees that as an opportunity to do governance work at a higher level of quality and scale, not as an obligation to satisfy.

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director of Corporate Legal.

What You'll Do

1. Lead HubSpot's Governance Policy Framework

  • Own HubSpot's governance policy framework, including committee charters, governance practices, director independence analysis, related-party frameworks, and Board refresh and skills matrix legal analysis.
  • Lead the annual governance policy refresh, ensuring HubSpot's practices remain aligned with evolving NYSE requirements and governance best practices — and anticipating changes before they arrive.

2. Own the Nominating, Governance & Sustainability Committee

  • Serve as the substantive legal owner for the NG&S Committee, preparing materials, advising on agenda items, translating legal and governance requirements into practical recommendations, and supporting the committee chair.
  • Advise on director independence, related-party considerations, Board refresh, and skills matrix analysis, with the judgment to resolve most questions independently.

3. Run Board and Committee Operations

  • Own the operational backbone for the Board and its Audit, Compensation, and NG&S Committees as a shared service across all three committees.
  • Own the governance sections of HubSpot's annual proxy statement, including director biographies, skills matrix, committee descriptions, governance policy disclosures, and ESG and sustainability content, and lead the annual meeting process and logistics end-to-end.

4. Lead Governance-Focused Investor Engagement

  • Lead governance-focused investor engagement, including proxy advisor outreach related to Board composition and governance practices, and partner with Investor Relations on shareholder communications and proxy season strategy.
  • Engage directly with ISS, Glass Lewis, and significant shareholders on governance matters with the preparation and credibility to represent HubSpot's positions authoritatively.

5. Own Corporate Governance Programs

  • Own recurring corporate governance programs (governance filings, D&O questionnaires, governance surveys, and related compliance obligations) with disciplined execution and strong records practice.

6. Build an AI-First Governance Function

  • You have a point of view on how AI and automation can raise the quality and efficiency of recurring governance work, and you act on it. You will identify and implement process improvements (including AI-enabled workflows) that reduce friction, strengthen governance operations, and increase the team's operating leverage.
  • Build templates, playbooks, and governance infrastructure that make this function more scalable and resilient over time.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • 8-10+ years of corporate and securities law experience at top law firms and/or in-house, with at least 3-4 years of meaningful in-house experience advising a U.S. public company on corporate governance matters.
  • Deep knowledge of public company governance (Board and committee practices, director independence, governance policies, stock exchange requirements, and related-party frameworks) with the judgment to own governance calls independently.
  • Extensive experience supporting Boards and Board committees, with the credibility to advise on governance matters directly and translate legal requirements into practical, boardroom-ready recommendations.
  • Meaningful ownership of, or a senior role in, annual proxy statement preparation and annual shareholder meeting processes.
  • Demonstrated track record of governance-related investor and proxy advisor engagement; able to partner with Investor Relations and senior stakeholders as a peer, not a process manager.
  • Track record of independently managing complex, recurring governance programs with strong attention to legal judgment, execution, and records discipline — and a drive to continuously improve how those programs run.
  • JD from an accredited law school and active bar membership in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Experience working in-house at a publicly traded technology or SaaS company.
  • Experience engaging directly with proxy advisors, including ISS and Glass Lewis, on governance matters.
  • Experience advising on ESG or sustainability-related governance and public disclosures.
  • Hands-on experience using or building AI-enabled workflows in legal or governance contexts, with a clear point of view on where AI adds real leverage in governance work.

Pay & Benefits

The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot’s bonus plan for eligible roles. jobs.description:
Overview: Scalability and Speed Optimization

The Performance Tester is dedicated to ensuring the speed, stability, and scalability of our entire supply chain e-commerce platform. You will plan, design, and execute rigorous load, stress, and endurance tests on the core e-commerce storefront, the performance-critical internal SaaS tools (OMS, WMS, MES), and the emerging AI agent services to identify and eliminate performance bottlenecks.

Internship Details

Duration: 3 months

Start Date: Immediate

Location: Remote

Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE.

Key Responsibilities & Core Projects

You will be the expert in pushing the platform to its limits, guaranteeing optimal user experience even under peak load.

  • Test Strategy & Design: Design comprehensive load, stress, and endurance testing strategies for critical systems, focusing on the high-volume e-commerce checkout funnels, payment gateway integrations, and API responsiveness across the modular monolith.

  • Execution & Analysis: Execute tests using industry-standard tools (e.g., JMeter, Gatling) and cloud-based load testing services. Analyze results to accurately identify performance bottlenecks in the Node.js/NestJS services, database queries (PostgreSQL/Redis), and infrastructure components.

  • Critical Flow Testing: Specifically test the performance and throughput of key supply chain APIs and user flows, including real-time inventory checks (WMS integration), order placement (OMS), and search functionality (Meilisearch).

  • Optimization Recommendations: Collaborate closely with the SRE and development teams to translate performance data into clear, actionable optimization strategies for code, database indices, caching (Redis), and infrastructure (auto-scaling).

  • CI/CD Integration: Work with the DevSecOps team to integrate performance testing as a mandatory quality gate within the CI/CD pipeline to prevent performance regressions in new deployments.

Required Technologies & Tools

Candidates must possess deep experience in performance testing methodology, execution, and analysis:

  • Testing Tools: Expert proficiency in JMeter, Gatling, or similar high-scale load generation tools.

  • Monitoring & Analysis: Hands-on experience using the observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) to monitor system metrics, latency, and resource utilization during test execution.

  • Programming/Scripting: Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., JavaScript/Python) for test scenario creation and data generation.

  • Backend Knowledge: Strong understanding of database performance tuning (PostgreSQL), caching, and API behavior (REST/JSON).

  • Cloud/Infra: Familiarity with cloud-based load testing services and containerized environments (Docker).

AI Agent Focus

You will validate the capacity and latency of our AI services.

  • Load Testing AI: Conduct stress and load tests on the AI agent systems, measuring latency and throughput under concurrent user requests, especially concerning the processing power required for LLM interactions (e.g., prompt processing, RAG retrieval).

  • Resource Impact: Analyze the impact of AI compute demands on shared infrastructure resources, providing data for cloud capacity planning.

Success Metrics & Career Path

Performance will be measured by:

  • Latency Reduction: Measurable improvements in API response times (e.g., 95th percentile latency) for critical services.

  • Throughput: Successful validation of system throughput capabilities against business-defined peak load targets.

  • Bottleneck Identification: Accuracy and impact of identified performance bottlenecks and recommended solutions.

Mentorship Structure: Reports to the Automation QA Lead or Technical Architect, working directly with the SRE and Backend Engineering teams to ensure performance is a core product feature.

jobs.excerpt: We’re looking for a Senior Director, Product Design to join our team.
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Director, Product Design to join our team. In this role, you’ll lead and actively contribute to the creation of customer-centered concepts, prototypes, and front-end experiences across the full spectrum of design – from low-fidelity exploration through to high-fidelity, production-ready outputs – and be expected to work fluidly across that range.

At Runyon, Product Design is evolving – not just in what we make, but in how we make it. We’re moving closer to build, bringing design into implementation, and exploring how AI and emerging tools can accelerate how ideas are generated, tested, and brought to life. This role will play a key part in shaping that direction – both through the work itself and in how we continue to evolve our craft.

You’ll operate as part of a cross-disciplinary leadership team, with shared ownership over the work and its direction – shaping decisions, setting the bar for craft, and bringing new products and experiences to life alongside peers across research, strategy, and product.

You bring a strong point of view on product design, grounded in deep empathy for user needs and behaviors, and a clear understanding of how to leverage research to inform design decisions. You are able to translate insights into thoughtful, well-crafted experiences that reflect business model considerations, brand expression, and growth strategy within the user flows you shape.

About Runyon

We are a product design and venture studio that helps companies grow.

  • We're prototyping-led. We lead with tangible assumptions in the form of prototypes and test them with real stakeholders to validate and refine our strategy and design. Regardless of discipline, we think and communicate in concepts, and use those to move further, faster.
  • We're detailed and intentional. We always back up our design decisions with sound reasoning—be it user research, market research, or both. We make things that make sense and that have a clear through line.
  • We're fast. We work almost exclusively in sprints, and with lean teams. We need folks who like to run.
  • We're collaborative. We jam as a multidisciplinary team of specialists who collectively contribute to the full spectrum of work across user research, strategy and design to arrive at high quality outcomes.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead projects through the lens of product design – ensuring alignment across design, strategy, business, and operational objectives, with project management support as needed
  • Translate insights from qualitative research and strategic design into clear, engaging, and actionable product design – actively shaping user-centered concepts, systems, and interaction models that bring clarity to complex problem spaces
  • Generate and evolve concepts through hands-on design – crafting early hypotheses, low- to high-fidelity concepts, functional prototypes, and exploring multiple paths forward, while guiding the team through iteration and validation
  • Design and deliver strategically grounded, high-quality user flows and interactive prototypes that articulate a compelling vision and demonstrate tangible impact
  • Lead by example in craft – owning and contributing to high-impact product moments, setting the bar for quality through direct design contribution
  • Partner closely with cross-disciplinary teammates (research, strategy, product, engineering) to shape work from initial framing through design delivery and (more recently) build – balancing desirability, viability, and feasibility at every stage
  • Create clear, persuasive narratives and visual storytelling artifacts that communicate the work in an impactful way to both internal teams and senior client partner stakeholders
  • Contribute to the evolution of Product Design at Runyon – exploring and implementing tools, systems, and methodologies that strengthen the craft and improve how we work
  • Mentor and support designers across levels – providing direction, feedback, and hands-on collaboration to elevate both individual growth and team output
  • Help build and shape the team – attracting and engaging top design talent, while reinforcing Runyon’s culture and standards
  • Foster strong, trust-based partnerships across teams – encouraging open dialogue, shared ownership, and a highly collaborative, iterative working style
  • Communicate clearly and persuasively – tailoring design rationale and storytelling to a range of audiences, including senior and executive stakeholders

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 15+ years of experience in product / UX design (or equivalent), with significant experience on an in-house product team; experience within a design studio or agency environment is a strong complement
  • A portfolio that demonstrates exceptional craft across the full design spectrum – from early concepting through to high-fidelity, production-ready outputs – with a clear ability to simplify complex systems into intuitive, elegant experiences
  • Demonstrated strength in both zero-to-one product/service design and/or design systems creation and implementation, with the ability to move fluidly between exploratory and production-ready work
  • Proven ability to rapidly generate and iterate on concepts – translating ideas into tangible artifacts quickly, and refining them into detailed, high-quality design
  • Deep proficiency with contemporary design and prototyping tools and methods (e.g., Figma), including structuring files for wireframes, visual design, interactive prototypes, and scalable design systems
  • Demonstrated depth using AI-powered design and coding tools
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills – able to clearly and persuasively articulate design rationale to a range of audiences, including senior and executive stakeholders
  • A strong point of view on product design, grounded in user empathy, with the ability to connect user needs to business strategy, brand expression, and growth opportunities
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity – with a bias toward action, experimentation, and generating multiple paths to arrive at innovative, differentiated solutions
  • Fluency in emerging tools and technologies – including a growing literacy in AI-enabled design workflows and a working understanding of how products are built (code, systems, and technical constraints)
  • Equally comfortable leading and contributing, with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and drive the work forward through direct execution
  • Nice to have: Experience working in financial services, fintech, payments, or other complex, regulated domains

This is a remote role open to U.S.-based candidates, with the option to work from our DUMBO studio for those in NYC. This role may require up to 25% travel.

ABOUT ADDIGY

Addigy is a fast-growing SaaS company empowering IT professionals to manage Apple devices at scale. Our platform enables organizations and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) to monitor, secure, and manage macOS, iOS, and iPadOS devices in real time through a single, intuitive interface. We are guided by three core values: Humble – outcomes over ego, every time; Hungry – relentless in our pursuit of progress; and Smart – we're curious, we dig, we never stop learning.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Account Managers at Addigy are responsible for driving revenue growth and retention within a portfolio of assigned accounts. This role combines proactive account management with a keen focus on maximizing customer lifetime value through high-impact engagements and tailored growth strategies.

This is a revenue-carrying role — you own expansion, renewals, and long-term relationship health across your book of business. You'll also be expected to lean into AI-powered workflows, actively using tools like Claude and others to work smarter and move faster every day.

WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

  • Own a real book of business – You'll drive expansion and renewal revenue with a portfolio of accounts, with a clear path to impact from day one.
  • AI-forward team – Addigy actively encourages using AI tools in everyday workflows — this isn't optional, it's part of how we work.
  • Strategic, not transactional – You'll build trusted, long-term partnerships and shape how customers grow with Addigy over time.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Revenue & Expansion

  • Identify and pursue upsell and cross-sell opportunities through a deep understanding of each customer's goals and needs
  • Build compelling cases for product extensions or enhancements, driving adoption and revenue growth within your accounts
  • Successfully renew customer contracts and consistently meet or exceed expansion revenue targets

Relationship Management

  • Maintain high-touch, strategic relationships with key stakeholders, ensuring Addigy's solutions remain integral to their success
  • Act as an advocate for the customer within Addigy, collaborating cross-functionally to align resources that support growth initiatives
  • Build long-term, trust-based relationships that consistently reinforce Addigy's value proposition

Strategic Account Planning

  • Develop targeted account plans with specific actions and timelines for growth
  • Use data-driven insights to identify high-potential accounts and tailor engagement strategies that maximize lifetime value
  • Establish a structured cadence of check-ins and strategic reviews to drive engagement, expansion, and retention

Customer Engagement

  • Regularly showcase Addigy's impact through QBRs and routine calls, keeping a consistent focus on measurable outcomes
  • Anticipate potential challenges and proactively manage risks to maintain customer satisfaction and loyalty
  • Leverage AI tools (Claude and others) to enhance research, personalization, and workflow efficiency

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In the first 90 days, you will:

  • Develop and execute strategic account plans focused on identifying and achieving expansion revenue targets
  • Prioritize high-impact onboarding and relationship-building activities that position Addigy as a trusted partner
  • Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities early in the customer journey
  • Establish a structured cadence of check-ins and strategic reviews across your portfolio

WHAT YOU BRING

Required

  • Experience selling MDM, Apple device management, or RMM solutions, or strong familiarity with these technologies from a closely related role.
  • Proven success growing an existing SaaS customer base or acquiring new customers, with a track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships with key stakeholders that drive expansion, renewals, and retention.Proactive problem-solver who spots risks early and works across teams to resolve them.
  • Skilled at building data-driven account plans that find expansion opportunities and secure renewals.
  • Proven success growing an existing SaaS customer base or acquiring new customers, with a track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.

Preferred

  • Comfortable using AI tools (Claude or similar) in day-to-day workflows.
  • Experience with Salesforce (including Quote-to-Cash) or similar CRM/CS tools.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Revenue-Minded – You think like an owner, consistently looking for ways to grow accounts and demonstrate value
  • Relationship-Driven – You build genuine, long-term partnerships — not just transactional check-ins
  • Strategic Communicator – Skilled at aligning conversations and presentations with customer goals and clearly demonstrating the value of expanding their investment
  • Proactive & Analytical – You anticipate challenges before they escalate and use data to guide your account strategy

COMPENSATION

Compensation includes a competitive base salary and commission structure commensurate with experience. Full details will be shared during the interview process.

Critically, this person must be able to perform the below duties showing credibility and industry knowledge to the customers and to internal stakeholders.

CORE DUTIES:

Duty 1: Develop Go-to-Market Strategies for the Pharmaceutical Market Segment
Independently develop comprehensive go-to-market strategies for the pharmaceutical industry segment. This requires deep knowledge of how pharmaceutical companies operate, make purchasing decisions, and allocate budget. The strategy must address:
• Growth projections and realistic revenue targets for the segment.
• Target company identification (which pharmaceutical companies and which therapeutic areas represent the best growth opportunities).
• Product area prioritization (e.g., small molecules, biologics, cell and gene therapy, etc.).
• Value positioning and competitive differentiation for each product area.
• Tactical approaches and marketing initiatives aligned with pharma customer needs.

Duty 2: Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration and Field Engagement
Lead close collaboration with internal product management groups (PDA for new products, CES for established products), R&D, Marketing Services, SCMT, and Sales to execute marketing initiatives and campaigns. This duty includes two distinct directions:

Direction 1 – Marketing Execution:

  • Take an active role in generating customer-facing materials and promotional campaigns.
    • Drive marketing initiatives that support company focus areas.
    • Lead the development of campaigns, collateral, and promotional programs in partnership with internal stakeholders.

    Direction 2 – Market Intelligence:
    • Attend industry conferences and conduct customer visits to identify emerging trends and unmet needs.
    • Monitor pharmaceutical industry activity, particularly new biotech acquisitions and market shifts.
    • Gather field insights into customer priorities and competitive threats.
    • Co-travel with SCMT to strengthen market understanding and drive strategy refinement.

    Duty 3: Provide Global Leadership and Regional Guidance
    Operate with a global mindset and serve as the strategic leader for the pharmaceutical segment across all regions. Act as the authoritative voice on pharmaceutical segment strategy and market positioning across the organization. This includes:
    • Work with global branches and regional marketing teams to develop tactics that are both strategically aligned and regionally appropriate.
    • Provide guidance and support to branches, other Segment Marketing Managers, and business units on segment strategy and best practices.
    • Ensure consistent execution of global strategy while enabling regional flexibility where appropriate.
    • Monitor and measure the effectiveness of marketing strategies and initiatives across regions and business units.
    • Maintain extensive and effective communication across the organization—from core product management teams to global colleagues—to ensure alignment and accountability.

    Duty 4: Train, Coach, and Mentor Colleagues
    Build marketing capability across the organization by training, coaching, and mentoring colleagues on pharmaceutical segment marketing strategies, tactics, and best practices. Develop a culture of continuous learning and strategic rigor within the segment marketing function.
    This includes:
    • Mentor other Segment Marketing Managers and business unit colleagues on go-to-market approaches.
    • Coach team members on market analysis, competitive positioning, and strategic thinking.
    • Share industry knowledge and pharmaceutical customer insights with colleagues.
    • May include direct management responsibility for junior marketers or team members as needed.

    Duty 5: Compliance and Integrate into Promega Culture
    • Demonstrates inclusion through their own words and actions and is accountable for a safe workspace. Acts with kindness, curiosity, and respect for others.
    • Embracing and being open to incorporating Promega’s 6 Emotional & Social Intelligence (ESI) core principles in daily work.
    • Understands and complies with ethical, legal and regulatory requirements applicable to our business.

    KEY QUALIFICATIONS:

    1. PhD in life sciences or chemistry + 5+ years of pharmaceutical R&D experience, with clear progression in the scientific career ladder, demonstrating strategic thinking, cross-functional influence, and deep knowledge of pharmaceutical customer workflows.

    2. Ability to comprehend, present, and discuss scientific content at an advanced level.

    3. Demonstrated success with a variety of marketing functions including strategic and tactical marketing, marketing communications, market research, distribution channels, competitive intelligence, and customer communications.

    4. Strong public speaking skills needed to represent Promega at external meetings, conferences, and organizations. Able to present high-level information for multiple audiences ranging from scientists to marketers.

    5. Attend industry trainings, workshops, conferences, focus groups and other activities associated with marketing tactics as a presenter or Promega representative.

    6. Proven ability to analyze issues, think strategically and creatively and execute innovative ideas for the portfolio in target market and customer segments.

    7. Demonstrated effective written and verbal communication skills.

    8. Demonstrated ability to work on multiple detailed projects and assignments simultaneously and independently.

    10. Demonstrated proficiency in digital tools and technology, including Microsoft applications and mobile platforms, with the ability to adapt and leverage emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence, to improve efficiency, automation, and collaboration.

1. PhD or MBA preferred.

Mastery: We hunt knowledge relentlessly and build expertise into every engagement.

Support: No one goes it alone; collaboration is our default setting.

Ownership: We celebrate wins and own slip-ups with equal conviction.

Overview: Quality and Test Automation

The Automation QA Engineer is vital for ensuring the reliability, performance, and correctness of our entire supply chain e-commerce platform. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining comprehensive automated test suites across the e-commerce user interface, complex internal business workflows (MES, WMS, OMS), and the logic governing our next-generation AI agents.

Internship Details

Duration: 3 months

Start Date: Immediate

Location: Remote

Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE.

Key Responsibilities & Core Projects

You will embed quality assurance directly into the development and deployment lifecycle, serving as the gatekeeper for production releases.

  • Test Suite Development: Develop and maintain robust, end-to-end automated test suites covering critical e-commerce flows (catalog navigation, checkout, payments, invoicing) and complex internal tool workflows (OMS/WMS operations).

  • Quality Gates (CI/CD): Integrate automated test suites into the CI/CD pipeline (managed via Makefile) to enforce quality gates, ensuring no regressions are introduced and the platform adheres to performance standards before deployment.

  • Performance & Load Testing: Implement and execute performance testing and load testing protocols to validate the scalability and resilience of the NestJS modular monolith, especially for high-traffic scenarios and intensive SCM transactions.

  • API Integration Testing: Design and execute automated tests for API integrations between the core supply chain modules (e.g., testing the data contract integrity between WMS and OMS) and external payment services.

  • Test Data Management: Create and maintain reliable test data factories to simulate complex multi-tenant and domain-specific scenarios (e.g., various HS codes, tenant feature flags).

  • Regression Management: Continuously maintain and optimize the regression test suite to provide fast, reliable feedback to development teams operating within the Monorepo structure.

Required Technologies & Tools

Candidates must possess strong expertise in automated testing frameworks, CI/CD integration, and performance validation:

  • Automation Frameworks: Experience selecting, building, and maintaining E2E (e.g., Playwright, Cypress) and API testing frameworks.

  • Programming: Strong proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js for writing high-quality, maintainable test code.

  • Performance/Load: Experience with tools for performance and load testing (e.g., JMeter, K6).

  • CI/CD: Practical experience integrating tests into automated pipelines and working within a Monorepo environment.

  • Data & Database: Ability to query PostgreSQL 15 directly to validate data integrity.

AI Agent Focus

You will be responsible for validating the behavior and accuracy of our AI systems.

  • Agent Behavior Testing: Develop tests to validate the deterministic and non-deterministic behaviors of AI agents, ensuring they accurately process inputs, access data securely, and perform their intended functions (e.g., workflow optimization, customer support responses).

  • Integration Validation: Verify the quality of data retrieval and the security of the API layers connecting AI agents (using LangChain/LlamaIndex) to the core WMS/OMS data.

Success Metrics & Career Path

Performance will be measured by:

  • Test Coverage: Measurable increase in automated functional and regression test coverage across critical application paths.

  • Defect Escape Rate: Reduction in the number of critical and high-severity defects escaping to production.

  • Pipeline Reliability: Maintenance of stable, non-flaky test runs within the CI/CD pipeline.

Mentorship Structure: Reports to the Technical Architect or Engineering Lead, working directly with development teams across the Catalog, OMS, and WMS modules.

About Trideca

Trideca is Australia's trusted strategy, AI, and digital transformation partner, helping some of the nation's largest enterprises (including NAB, Suncorp, Optus, Medibank, and AGL) drive meaningful business impact through technology.

With offices in Melbourne and Sydney and projects spanning multiple industries, we thrive on solving complex challenges, delivering cutting-edge solutions, and pushing the boundaries of what's possible.

About the opportunity

Trideca is delivering the implementation phase of a large customer identity transformation for one of Australia's best known regulated enterprises. The program moves customer identity from Okta to Auth0 across web, mobile, API and IVR channels, serving millions of customers. Design is complete, and the Auth0 platform is now ready to be built. That means tenancies, token services, security configuration and CI/CD. We are looking for an Identity Platform Lead who has built Auth0 at enterprise, customer scale before and can lead that build from the first day.

What you will do

  • You will design and stand up Auth0 tenancies across development, test, staging and production.
  • You will build the token issuance and validation services and define the token and session architecture for every channel.
  • You will set the WAF rules, rate limiting and security hardening around each tenancy, and build a CI/CD pipeline that deploys Auth0 configuration as code.
  • You will also define a blue/green cutover approach so the new Auth0 flows can run alongside Okta without disrupting live traffic.
  • You will own the technical migration path from Okta to Auth0, including how existing sessions and credentials move across.
  • You will work closely with the established API, iOS and Android squads to define the contract each channel builds against, and make sure machine to machine traffic stays correctly scoped on Okta during the transition.
  • You will be the senior technical voice on identity. That means resolving the remaining platform level questions, making the key technical calls, documenting the build so it can be operated and extended after handover, and raising go live risk early, given that some cutover changes cannot be rolled back.

What you bring

  • You have stood up Auth0 tenancies at enterprise, customer facing scale, not only integrated applications against an existing tenancy.
  • You have migrated an identity platform from Okta or a comparable enterprise IAM product to Auth0.
  • You know OAuth2, OIDC, token services and Auth0 Actions in depth from hands on work.
  • You have defined WAF and security configuration for a customer identity platform, and applied Terraform or an equivalent infrastructure as code tool to identity configuration.
  • You work well in ambiguity and can find the questions nobody has asked yet.
  • Experience in financial services, healthcare or another regulated industry is highly regarded.

What success looks like

A working Auth0 authorizer in a lower environment that unblocks API testing. Clear, documented ownership of the identity platform. A pipeline that deploys Auth0 configuration reliably and repeatably. A cutover plan in which outage and rollback risk is understood and mitigated. Delivery squads building against a stable, tested platform rather than mocked outputs.

Business is a team sport, and we are here to win. We respect, value, and inspire each other to bring our best to raise the bar. We will high-five you when you've nailed it and have honest discussions when you don't.

We are stronger and more successful when we include and appreciate different backgrounds, ideas, and experiences. Diversity helps us be more creative, solve problems better, and achieve more. Debate, Agree, Commit

We champion open dialogue where every voice matters and ideas are rigorously challenged to create stronger solutions. Once we reach alignment, we commit fully as one team and execute with excellence and accountability.

Have Fun, Go Nuts

No explanation is required, have fun, go nuts.

We also believe that the unique contributions of everyone at Trideca is the driver of our success.
