jobs.description:
About the Company

Correlation One is the largest provider of AI and data workforce development programs globally, having trained over 500,000 professionals across 11 countries. As the largest training provider for Amazon Career Choice, and a growing partner to state governments building registered apprenticeship programs, Correlation One sits at the intersection of employer talent needs and scalable workforce training.

We work with Fortune 500 enterprises, federal and state government agencies, and leading employers to close skills gaps in AI, data analytics, cybersecurity, and operations leadership. Our programs produce job-ready graduates who are prepared to contribute from day one.

About the Role

Graduates of our Amazon Career Choice programs receive up to 18 months of post-program support: career coaching, an alumni community of roughly 9,000 members, and connections to employer partners. This role owns the systems that make that support work. That includes how alumni hear from us, how they move through our community, how coaches are deployed, and how outcomes data moves from our warehouse into decisions. The role is part communicator, part builder, part analyst, with AI built into how you do all three. It suits someone who writes a warm launch post in the morning and debugs an Apps Script trigger in the afternoon.

What You'll Do

Alumni Engagement & Communications

  • Own the alumni communications calendar, planning multi-channel outreach (Slack, email, SMS, LinkedIn) for cohort graduations, coaching milestones, events, and support-window reminders.
  • Write and launch campaigns end to end: copy, audience segmentation, cadence, forms, and follow-up tracking. This includes welcome campaigns for new cohorts and promotion of live programming such as mock interview labs and career co-working sessions. Use AI tools to draft, personalize, and translate messaging at scale, with human review before anything goes out.
  • Manage the alumni Slack community, including tenure-based channels, invite links and their limits, welcome messaging, and the alumni LinkedIn network. Keep these spaces accurate, active, and limited to eligible members.
  • Run outcomes and profile-update campaigns that collect placement data, resumes, and LinkedIn profiles from alumni. Use Typeform logic (e.g., hidden fields) so one message can serve several eligibility groups.
  • Partner with coaches on newly placed alumni and contributor stories to strengthen peer-to-peer engagement.

Automation & Workflow Systems

  • Design, build, and maintain automations that remove manual work from alumni and coach operations. Examples include channel lifecycle automation that moves alumni between tenure-based Slack channels, welcome bots, personalized coach-to-alumni DM tools, coach assignment, and welcome email sequences.
  • Build with Google Apps Script, the Slack API, Connected Sheets, and no-code tools, working within platform constraints such as plan limits, rate limits, and execution timeouts.
  • Engineer for reliability: dry-run and test modes, validation before writes, run logs, safe-failure logic, and manual override paths.
  • Write clear maintainer documentation so each system can be supported by someone other than its builder.
  • Build and own the AI-powered steps in these workflows, such as LLM-based resume review, message drafting, and response triage, including the prompts, quality checks, and human-review points that keep output accurate.

Data Warehouse & Reporting

  • Maintain BigQuery datasets and views that feed alumni operations, including rosters, program and tenure dates, and email matching across systems.
  • Connect warehouse data to Sheets, Tableau, and Hex, and own dashboards for outcomes (by country, month, and transition type) and coach performance.
  • Own data quality across the alumni record: validate form ingestion, resolve duplicates, and keep resume, LinkedIn, and profile updates in sync across the admin app, Recruit CRM, Airtable, and the warehouse. Use AI-assisted methods to speed up record matching, deduplication, and cleanup, validating results against source data.
  • Produce recurring and ad hoc analyses, such as half-year alumni support reviews and placement trend lines. Clearly lay out methodology tradeoffs, such as reporting by processed date versus reporting date.

Coach & Program Operations

  • Manage day-to-day operations for a contracted bench of career coaches: learner assignments, onboarding and offboarding, booking links, coverage during transitions, tracking sheets, and the coach operational guide.
  • Coordinate professional development session facilitation for active cohorts, including scheduling presenters and confirming sessions with program teams.
  • Build employer-partner candidate pipelines. Match alumni and learners to partner role requirements, confirm interest, and deliver clean shortlists with resumes and LinkedIn profiles.
  • Maintain the PD Ops project tracker and team playbooks so priorities, owners, and status stay visible.

What You Bring

Required

  • 2+ years in program operations, alumni relations, career services, community operations, or operations analytics, ideally in education, workforce development, or a high-volume learner environment.
  • Strong SQL and hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery preferred).
  • Scripting ability in Google Apps Script/JavaScript or Python, and comfort working with REST APIs (Slack API experience is a plus).
  • Excellent written communication, with a track record of messaging that drives action, and judgment about tone, timing, and audience fatigue.
  • Ability to manage many concurrent workstreams across internal teams, contracted coaches, and external partners.
  • A builder's mindset: you notice repetitive work and propose a system for it, then document it so others can run it.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini) to real operational work, such as drafting communications, cleaning data, or automating reviews, and the judgment to know where human review is needed.

Preferred

  • Experience with Tableau or Hex, Typeform, Airtable, Notion, and an ATS/CRM such as Recruit CRM.
  • Familiarity with Amazon Career Choice or similar employer-funded upskilling programs.
  • Experience coordinating contractor or vendor teams.

Tools You'll Use

  • Slack (admin and API), Google Workspace and Apps Script, BigQuery, Tableau, Hex, Typeform, Airtable, Recruit CRM, Notion, Calendly, Zoom, Canva, and AI tools such as Claude

Where you are

  • This role is remote and can be located anywhere in MENA. Working hours must be compatiblewith the EST time zone.

How we support our people

  • Insurance or subsidies based on country
  • Unlimited Time Off
  • Company-paid holidays
  • Official company-wide week long holiday for the last week in December
  • Access to free data skills training through our programs
  • A company culture that empowers individuals and embraces diversity through its core mission

jobs.title: Senior Financial Planner
jobs.excerpt: About the Role﻿Our client ﻿is a fee-only Registered Investment Advisor and multi-family office.
jobs.description:
About the Role

﻿Our client ﻿is a fee-only Registered Investment Advisor and multi-family office. They work with a select group of households on the whole picture — investments, financial planning, estate, retirement and tax coordination — and they do it with a small, senior team rather than a large one.

The Senior Financial Planner works directly with the Founder/Lead Advisor and carries genuine client ownership early on. You will be trusted with households to run rather than assigned to shadow someone else's. For a planner who has been one of many at a larger firm, that is the appeal: your judgment matters here, and clients feel it.

Where This Role Leads

﻿They ﻿are building a bench rather than filling a seat — paraplanner, to planner, to advisor. This is the planner rung, and for the right person, it is a defined path to a full advisory role with your own client relationships. They ﻿ promote from within because they would rather develop an advisor who already knows their clients and their standards than recruit one who doesn't. The planners who make that step there are the ones who have mastered the craft first — they can run the trade, close the estate file, and see an outstanding document all the way in. If that is the path you want, this role is built to take you there.

Hours & Location

Fully remote, open to candidates anywhere in the United States. The firm runs on Pacific time, with client meetings concentrated in the Pacific morning and early afternoon.

  • Standard schedule: 8:00am–4:00pm Pacific.

  • East Coast: 7:00am–3:00pm Pacific (10:00am–6:00pm Eastern). We are flexible on the exact shift.

The first part of the day is largely uninterrupted heads-down time, and the day finishes early by Pacific standards — one of the quieter benefits of working here. Candidates in Pacific and Mountain time find the rhythm most natural. If you are further east, we would simply encourage you to look at the local hours and feel confident they suit you; we want this to work well for the long run.

You Team and You Support

You will not carry all of this alone. Their operations team handles account opening, custodial paperwork, notary coordination and document filing. One of their Directors of Operations is studying for the CFP® and moving toward a paraplanning role — data collection, entry into Right Capital, estate plan summaries, and follow-up on tax and insurance items.

Where exactly that division falls is something you and she will shape together over your first ninety days. We would rather you draw that line from experience than have us guess at it now. Helping her develop is part of this role and one we value highly: a planner who can teach is a planner who scales, and it is the clearest signal we have that someone is ready for an advisory seat.

Ownership stays with you. You can hand off the work; the outcome remains yours. Every open item on your household is yours to track, including the ones someone else is executing. That accountability is what makes delegation work — and it is what their clients feel.

How They Work Together

  • Weekly one-on-ones with the Lead Advisor through your first sixty days, moving to every other week as you settle in.
  • Substantive feedback happens on video rather than over email — it is faster, clearer, and recorded so you can revisit it.
  • Put time on the Lead Advisor's calendar whenever you need it. Fifteen minutes of am I on the right track beats two hours of rework, and no one there has ever been unwelcome for asking.

What You Will Own

1. Client Ownership & Follow-Through

Nothing falls through. Every open item has a name and a date on it.

An active week generates a lot of open items, and keeping them moving is central to the role. You will have support on the collection work, and the judgment about what matters stays with you.

  • Track every open item to completion in Wealthbox, with clear ownership, a defined next action and a due date.

  • Pursue documents and data from clients, custodians, insurance carriers, third-party administrators and tax preparers until they arrive.

  • Escalate anything stalled before it becomes visible to the client. When something doesn't get implemented, the client looks to us regardless of where the delay sat.

  • Conduct proactive outreach and field client questions through to resolution.

  • Maintain client records in Wealthbox and connected systems.

  • Help onboard new clients and households alongside operations.

2. Planning & Advice

The plan is right, the client understands it, and the recommendations get implemented.

  • Complete data collection and request supporting documents ahead of annual review meetings.

  • Enter and maintain financial details in Right Capital.

  • Fact-check and present financial plans fluently to clients over Zoom, without reading from a script.

  • Prepare recommendations using their Recommendations Template and present them to the client.

  • Prepare the full financial plan and recommendations to send after the annual planning meeting.

  • Email recommendations and action items after meetings, and document them in Wealthbox with client, assignee, and due date.

  • Complete planning analyses as assigned — real estate, home affordability, and health insurance.

  • Prepare the Lead Advisor for in-person meetings and handle the follow-up.

  • Lead year-end tax planning: request reports and retirement plan estimates, prepare tax projections, and shape strategy.

  • Handle tax document collection and support Business Management through the high-volume tax seasons (March/April and September/October).

  • Manage company retirement plans: beginning-of-year data requests, year-end projections through the TPA, and liaison between the client, the TPA and the tax preparer.

3. Trading & Portfolio

Trades are right the first time. This is where an operational mind pays off.

  • Master the trading process and serve as backup to the primary trader through iRebal.

  • Identify trades, build the trade blotter, review for accuracy, execute and document.

  • Handle non-routine trading independently: allocating a newly funded account, and raising cash from a concentrated or tax-sensitive portfolio where the obvious sale is the wrong one.

  • Assist with asset allocation reviews.

  • Maintain margin balance oversight on applicable client accounts.

4. Estate & Specialty Projects

Estate files get finished, not just opened.

  • Manage the estate planning process end to end: schedule time with clients to create, update, and review their plans, and produce clear summaries.

  • See documents through processing, notary and execution, with originals filed in the client record.

  • Conduct beneficiary, estate and insurance reviews.

  • Coordinate with clients and insurance companies for in-force illustrations, and obtain 401(k) information to facilitate rollovers.

  • Lead planning projects with defined deadlines, and prepare market updates and the Periodic Table of Investment Returns for clients and prospects.

5. Efficiency & Automation

The repetitive parts of the work get lighter every quarter.

They intend to stay small and still grow, and thoughtful use of technology is how that works. This is a genuine part of the role, not an afterthought.

  • Identify the recurring, low-judgment parts of the planning workflow and reduce them — meeting notes into

    Wealthbox, document requests, data collection prep, first-draft recommendations, and client correspondence.
  • Build repeatable, documented processes rather than personal shortcuts: prompt libraries, templates, and workflow automations the whole team can use.
  • Work within the firm's compliance boundaries. No client PII goes into consumer AI tools, and anything touching client communication or advice stays under human review and is retained per our books-and-records obligations.

﻿What They're Looking For

  • Certified Financial Planner (CFP®) designation, with at least five years of client-facing experience.

  • Comprehensive planning experience at a fee-only Registered Investment Advisor.

  • Practical, day-to-day use of AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude in professional work — processes you have genuinely put into practice — along with sound judgment about their compliance limits in a regulated advisory setting.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and follow-through. This is the single most predictive trait for success in this role.
  • A thoughtful approach to delegation — you can describe how you keep ownership of work you have handed to someone else.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, and comfort representing the brand with clients.

  • The ability to work effectively and independently in a fully remote setting, on the schedule described above.

We would rather hire the right person and teach the software than screen on platform names. If you have several of these, please tell us:

  • Hands-on experience with iRebal, Black Diamond, Wealthbox CRM, Right Capital or Charles Schwab Advisor Center.

  • A background in investment operations, portfolio administration or on a trading desk.

  • Experience building workflow automations with ChatGPT, Claude, Zapier or similar tools.

  • Tax preparation or tax planning experience.

  • Estate planning knowledge and experience.

  • Experience mentoring or developing a junior planner or paraplanner.

This role suits someone who enjoys getting into the details and takes real satisfaction in a clean file; who wants to grow into an advisory role and is glad to earn it through the technical work; who would rather be trusted with responsibility than eased into it; who looks at a repetitive task and wonders whether it could run itself; who enjoys bringing someone else along; and for whom a day anchored to Pacific hours fits well.

It is a less natural fit for someone whose primary strength and interest is business development and building a book, or who would prefer a role with a fixed, narrowly defined scope. At a firm our size, scope moves — and we would rather say so now than have it surprise you later.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary $120,000–$140,000, depending on experience, plus a target annual bonus of 15–20% of base. Total target compensation $140,000–$165,000.

The bonus is based on an individual scorecard and has been paid at target in the last year.

Benefits include a monthly health stipend, 401k, Defined benefit plan, unlimited PTO, and full support for continuing education and CFP® renewal.

Financial Planner Recruiting, LLC and Firm ﻿﻿is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital or familial status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

AI is rewriting how every company works, and everyone is racing to figure out how to secure it. We have, and we need someone to take it to market.

Every security vendor is staking a claim in AI security. Team Overview

The Media and Telecommunications team is focused on expanding TransUnion’s presence across media markets, including social media, video and music streaming, publishing, traditional media, paid content and advertising. The team also supports growth within the telecommunications portfolio by developing new client relationships and increasing the adoption of TransUnion’s data, analytics, fraud, identity and risk capabilities. The Account Director – Telco & Media reports to Head of Utilities & Telco.This is a remote position which may require occasional in-person attendance at work-related events at the discretion of management.

Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

We’re looking for a Strategic Account Director to join our growing team as we look to expand into Media Markets: social media, content / video streaming, music streaming, publishers, traditional, paid-for and potentially advertising.

This role is primarily geared towards a Senior New Business hunter to make industry buyer connections, understand client CBI’s, gather Voice of Customer (VOC) to help TransUnion with proposition building and ultimately drive new business growth in the Media space. There is also an ambition to grow the client base within our Telecommunications portfolio which again will be powered by net-new business wins with logos not currently engaged with us. Day to Day You’ll Be:

  • Develop and convert new-business opportunities across target Media and Telecommunications organisations, building relationships with relevant buyer groups and senior decision-makers.

jobs.excerpt: At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences.
jobs.description:
At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences.

OneSpan is seeking a Marketing Automation & Campaign Operations Manager to build and operate the automation and campaign infrastructure that allows OneSpan Marketing to execute sophisticated, measurable, and increasingly personalized programs globally with greater speed, quality, and scale. You will own global campaign delivery and the health and evolution of our Marketo Engage instance across our Digital Agreements and Security businesses, manage campaigns from intake through launch, own platform quality and governance, and build the repeatable processes and automations that make this possible.

This is a hands-on role with growing strategic scope. You will partner with Demand Generation, Field Marketing, Product Marketing, Creative Services, Sales Enablement, Analytics, GTM Systems, Web Operations, and IT. You will contribute to quarterly planning, assess capacity and readiness, and bring data-backed recommendations on priorities and investments. The Director of Marketing Operations sets the overall roadmap and prioritization framework; you help shape both and own delivery against them.

This role is a strong fit for an experienced Marketo practitioner who has led campaign operations and is ready to own a global platform, expand their cross-functional influence, and drive AI and automation work.

Key Responsibilities:

Planning and prioritization

  • Contribute to quarterly planning with Demand Generation, Field Marketing, and Product Marketing; assess operational capacity, dependencies, and readiness for planned campaigns and launches, and flag risks early.
  • Analyze campaign and operational performance to identify trends, gaps, and bottlenecks, and turn findings into practical recommendations for the Director and Marketing leadership.

Marketo administration and platform quality

  • Own the day-to-day health of the Marketo Engage instance, including users, roles, permissions, integrations, and processing performance; troubleshoot issues with the appropriate technical owners.
  • Maintain and improve global program templates, tokens, folder structure, engagement programs, nurture streams, triggered and batch smart campaigns, dynamic content, and segmentations. Use Velocity scripting and webhooks where appropriate.
  • Lead execution of prioritized instance audit and remediation work, including asset retirement, smart campaign cleanup, and technical debt reduction, and recommend architecture improvements that reduce build time and errors.
  • Monitor email deliverability, bounce trends, and communication limits; partner with IT on domain authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and mailbox provider requirements, and escalate issues promptly.

Campaign planning and delivery

  • Own campaign intake, workback schedules, and delivery for webinars, events, email, nurture, product launches, and customer communications. Estimate effort and dependencies, manage stakeholder expectations, and escalate capacity or priority conflicts early.
  • Build and launch Marketo programs, emails, landing pages, forms, and smart campaigns using standardized templates and tokens, with aligned Salesforce campaign records, membership, and statuses.
  • Translate targeting requirements into validated audiences, including installed-base segments that require subscription or other related-record data; document definitions for reuse.
  • Own launch QA and coordinate end-to-end testing with Web Operations, GTM Systems, and IT. Validate audiences, links, registration flows, Litmus email rendering, consent and suppressions, tracking, and Marketo to Salesforce synchronization.

Preference center, consent, and database management

  • Own the marketing email preference center and related workflows, including subscriptions, language preferences, opt-ins, unsubscribes, and consent history. Implement approved consent policies with Privacy and Legal, aligned with GDPR, CASL, and CAN-SPAM.
  • Own day-to-day Marketo database quality, including field completeness, email verification with Validity BriteVerify, deduplication, enrichment checks, list import standards, and reusable exclusions for ineligible audiences.
  • Build and maintain reusable audience segments; analyze segment size, reachability, overlap, and fatigue to recommend targeting improvements and reduce conflicting communications.

Workflow automation and AI enablement

  • Partner with the Marketing AI lead to identify and operationalize automation and AI opportunities within campaign operations, including campaign setup, content variation, QA, audience operations, and intake.
  • Design and maintain structured intake and approval workflows using Microsoft Forms, SharePoint, and Power Automate; make request status, ownership, and delivery expectations visible to stakeholders.
  • Prototype and test automations and agents using approved tools such as Copilot Studio, partnering with technical teams on anything requiring their support.
  • Move validated prototypes into supported workflows with appropriate access, human review, and documentation; measure adoption, time savings, and error reduction.

Campaign governance and measurement

  • Own operational standards for Salesforce campaign hierarchies, naming, metadata, member statuses, and UTM tagging across business units and evergreen programs.
  • Create reusable campaign and operational reports that show engagement, funnel performance, delivery timelines, and recurring bottlenecks; partner with Analytics and BI on attribution definitions and reporting alignment.

Cross-functional delivery and enablement

  • Partner with the lead lifecycle owner on campaign interactions with scoring and routing, and with GTM Systems and IT on Salesforce configuration, integration changes, and testing.
  • Maintain instance documentation, operating procedures, and training materials so the platform remains supportable beyond any single administrator. Train and mentor marketers on Marketo best practices and approved self-service capabilities.

Qualifications:

Required

  • 6+ years of B2B marketing operations or campaign operations experience, including hands-on ownership of campaign builds, launches, and operational improvements.
  • 3+ years of hands-on Marketo Engage experience, including instance administration, program builds, engagement programs, tokens, dynamic content, smart campaign logic, and platform troubleshooting.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce campaigns, campaign hierarchies, membership, and reporting, and of Marketo to Salesforce synchronization, including field mapping, sync errors, and lead and contact behavior.
  • Experience managing marketing databases, audience segmentation, and preference center, consent, and suppression workflows; strong skills in UTM tracking, data validation, and email QA.
  • Working knowledge of email deliverability and global privacy and consent requirements as they apply to marketing automation.
  • Demonstrated experience improving marketing workflows through automation, with the ability to translate business needs into clear requirements and validate results.
  • Strong project management, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to prioritize competing requests, influence without direct authority, and present data-backed recommendations to marketing leadership.

Preferred

  • Adobe Certified Expert, Adobe Marketo Engage Business Practitioner certification, or willingness to obtain it within the first six months.
  • Experience supporting or leading a Marketo instance audit, cleanup, re-architecture, or migration.
  • Familiarity with Velocity scripting, the Marketo REST API, webhooks, middleware or iPaaS tools, and basic proficiency in a scripting language such as JavaScript or Python.
  • Experience with Microsoft Power Automate, Forms, SharePoint, Copilot Studio, AI agents, or MCP integrations.
  • Experience with Litmus, Validity BriteVerify, Marketo Measure or other attribution tools, and global campaigns spanning multiple business units.

What success looks like

Success is measured by reliable campaign delivery, platform quality, and measurable improvements in how Marketing works:

  • Speed to market: Shorter intake-to-launch cycle times and on-time launches through reusable templates, streamlined workflows, and automation.
  • Campaign quality: Fewer QA defects and less rework, with consistent adherence to campaign, tracking, and naming standards.
  • Data and attribution: Accurate campaign data, member statuses, and tracking that support reliable funnel and attribution reporting.
  • Platform health: Improved database completeness, email validity, deliverability, and campaign processing efficiency.
  • Efficiency and adoption: Measurable hours saved from automation and AI, and broader use of intake workflows, program templates, and documented processes.
  • Planning contribution: Clear, data-backed recommendations brought into each quarterly planning cycle.

Expected outcomes for the first 12 months include completed priority Marketo audit remediation with a recommended optimization roadmap, a standardized global program template library, current instance documentation, baseline reporting for intake-to-launch cycle time and hours saved, and a portfolio of automation improvements in production with documented reductions in campaign build time, manual effort, or errors, including at least one meaningful AI-enabled workflow deployed through the approved Marketing AI architecture.

Salary: $125,000 - $140,000 (depending on experience and qualifications)

jobs.excerpt: At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality.
jobs.description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

We combine data-driven content, rigorous product comparisons and user-first design, supported by a modern, scalable technology and data platform. Our global teams bring together expertise across performance marketing, product, commercial operations, data and analytics.

Our Data & Analytics organisation builds the products, platforms and intelligence that support commercial decision making across the business.

Overview

We're looking for a Business Analytics Manager who can turn complex business performance data into clear insights, recommendations and better commercial decisions.

You'll lead a small team of Analysts working directly with our business verticals, acting as a trusted analytics partner to General Managers and their commercial teams. Your focus will be on helping the business understand its performance, identify opportunities for growth and make better decisions through accurate, actionable data.

This is a hands-on leadership role that combines commercial understanding, analytical expertise and stakeholder management. You'll help your team move beyond reporting what happened to explaining why it happened, what it means for the business and what we should do next.

The Opportunity

Our Business Analytics team works directly with General Managers and their teams to understand commercial performance and identify opportunities to improve profitability.

You'll manage a small team of Analysts aligned to different business verticals, helping them become trusted partners to their stakeholders while maintaining a consistent standard of analytical quality across the organisation.

A significant part of the role involves understanding how the business makes money, from traffic acquisition and customer journeys through to conversions, partner performance, revenue and profitability. You'll help ensure that commercial and financial reporting is accurate, explainable and trusted, working closely with Finance and other Data teams to investigate discrepancies and improve the underlying information.

You'll also work with senior stakeholders to translate business questions into clear analytical requirements, prioritise opportunities and turn complex findings into compelling stories and practical recommendations.

This is an opportunity to shape how Analytics supports the business, developing a team that proactively identifies opportunities rather than simply responding to reporting requests.

What You'll Do

Commercial Performance & Business Partnership

  • Act as a trusted analytics partner to General Managers and senior commercial stakeholders, helping them understand the drivers of revenue, profitability and business performance. You'll work with your team to identify trends, investigate changes in performance and recommend opportunities for growth, ensuring analysis is grounded in a strong understanding of how each business operates.

Financial Accuracy & Data Confidence

  • Help establish confidence in the commercial data used to manage the business. You'll work closely with Finance, Revenue Operations and Data Engineering to understand revenue, costs, partner performance and profitability, investigate discrepancies and ensure reporting is accurate and explainable. You'll champion analytical rigour while recognising the importance of delivering timely, practical information to stakeholders.

Business Insight & Storytelling

  • Guide your team in translating complex datasets into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences. You'll help Analysts move beyond dashboards and descriptive reporting to explain the underlying drivers of performance, challenge assumptions and communicate what the business should do next. You'll also help identify opportunities for deeper analysis, forecasting and experimentation.

Analytics Products & Business Requirements

  • Translate commercial questions into clear analytical requirements, working with Analytics, BI, Engineering and Data Science teams to develop scalable reporting and insight products. You'll help identify where reusable datasets, dashboards and analytical approaches can replace repetitive work, improve consistency and enabling stakeholders to access trusted information more independently.

Team Leadership & Prioritisation

  • Lead and develop a small team of vertical-aligned Analysts, supporting their technical development, commercial understanding and stakeholder relationships. You'll help prioritise work across business areas, balance immediate commercial needs with longer-term improvements, and ensure the team's capacity is focused on delivering the greatest value. You'll remain technically involved, reviewing analytical approaches and helping the team tackle complex problems.

What You'll Bring

We're looking for someone who combines strong analytical expertise with commercial judgement, excellent communication skills and the ability to lead a team.

You'll likely bring:

  • Experience in business analytics, commercial analytics or performance analytics, including experience managing or mentoring Analysts.
  • Strong commercial understanding, with experience analysing revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, sales performance or other key business drivers.
  • Experience working directly with senior business stakeholders, translating complex questions into analytical requirements and actionable recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to explain complex findings clearly and influence commercial decisions.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large, complex datasets.
  • Experience with BI and visualisation platforms such as Tableau, Power BI or Looker.
  • A strong understanding of data quality, reporting accuracy and the importance of reconciling commercial information with financial outcomes.
  • Experience prioritising analytical work across multiple stakeholders, balancing commercial urgency with analytical quality.
  • Experience coaching and developing Analysts, helping them build both technical capability and commercial confidence.
  • A proactive, curious approach to problem solving, with the ability to identify opportunities rather than simply respond to requests.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in performance marketing, affiliate marketing, lead generation or digital publishing.
  • Familiarity with marketing and acquisition data from platforms such as GA4, Google Ads, Meta or other advertising platforms.
  • Experience working with Finance, Revenue Operations or commercial reporting teams.
  • Experience analysing sales performance, partner economics, conversion funnels or customer profitability.
  • Python experience for statistical analysis, forecasting or more advanced analytical work.
  • Experience collaborating with Data Scientists on predictive modelling, experimentation or customer analytics.
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform, particularly BigQuery.
  • Experience developing reusable analytical products or self-service reporting capabilities.
  • Experience working with distributed teams and agile delivery processes.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to help shape how Analytics influences commercial decisions across a growing, data-driven business.

You'll work directly with senior business leaders on meaningful commercial challenges, lead a talented team of Analysts and collaborate with specialists across Engineering, BI, Data Science and Revenue Operations.

You'll have the opportunity to develop a Business Analytics function that goes beyond reporting, building trusted relationships, improving the quality of business information and helping our teams make better, faster and more profitable decisions.

jobs.description:
Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.


Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.


Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.


As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.


We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.


We're transforming the collecting experience with technology that brings authentication, grading, and trading into the modern era. Our products are equalizing the playing field by providing tools that make complex research analytics (including pricing, scarcity reports, and historic sales data) accessible to every collector, old or new. Our engineering mission is to democratize technology while promoting innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning throughout the organization.


We're looking for a Staff Applied AI Engineer to join the Applied AI function at Collectors. This is an embedded, build-first role with portfolio-level ownership: you'll own a full business domain, decide which problems in it are worth solving with AI, and build and ship the solutions end-to-end. You'll still prototype fast and prove value in business terms, but your impact compounds beyond your own builds: the patterns you establish, the assets you make reusable, and the roadmap you shape become the way the whole team ships in your lane.


This is not a traditional software engineering role, and it's not an architecture-only role either. We're looking for a product-minded builder who leads through shipped work: someone who can walk into an unmapped business domain, earn the trust of its leaders, build the first few wins personally, and then turn those wins into a durable portfolio.


You'll report to the Head of Applied AI. Remote or hybrid candidates will also be considered. We believe that there is significant value in in-person collaboration.

What You'll Do


  • Own a business domain, not just a use case. You'll be accountable for the AI opportunity across an entire lane (for example Operations, Marketplace, or Finance): mapping the workflows, sizing the opportunities, and deciding what gets built, in what order, and why.
  • Build the hardest use cases yourself. You spend the majority of your time hands-on. You take the first, riskiest, or most technically demanding builds in your lane from prototype through production, adoption, and measured impact.
  • Turn one-off wins into reusable patterns. You notice when three builds share a shape, extract the common asset (a connector, an eval harness, a workflow pattern), and make it something every builder on the team can pick up.
  • Define success up front and prove it at portfolio level. You instrument outcomes before you build, and you can stand in front of the domain's leadership and account for the cumulative value your lane has delivered.
  • Design for earned autonomy. You build agents with the traces, evals, and human-in-the-loop gates that let them graduate to more autonomy on evidence, not on elapsed time, and you help set that standard for others.
  • Operate as a power user of frontier AI. Use Claude, OpenAI, and our orchestration platform daily as your primary tools, and bring a strong, current point of view on models, harnesses, and tooling that informs the team's platform choices.
  • Win trust at the leadership level. Your stakeholders are function leaders, not just operators. You navigate competing priorities, secure sponsorship, and keep skeptical partners engaged through delivery.
  • Multiply the builders around you. You review designs and code, unblock senior and mid-level engineers, raise the hiring bar as an interviewer, and make the people around you measurably better.
  • Build production grade applications around AI systems. You can design and implement the application layer around agents and AI workflows, with strong judgement across frontend APIs, state latency, reliability, security and scalability

Who You Are


  • A builder, first and foremost. Seniority hasn't pulled you away from the keyboard. You're happiest hands-on, and you have a strong bias toward shipping over deliberating.
  • Proven at portfolio scope. You've owned a domain, program, or product area where you chose the roadmap, not just executed it, and you can speak to the judgment calls: what you built, what you deliberately didn't, and how it played out.
  • You've shipped multiple end-to-end agents. You've deployed agentic or AI-powered solutions to real users more than once, in more than one context, and you can speak concretely about value delivered, tools used, trade-offs made, and what you'd do differently now.
  • A power user of AI. You use Claude, OpenAI, or similar models daily and fluently, you push them harder than most of the people around you, and you have informed opinions about frameworks, evals, and orchestration that you can defend with evidence.
  • Fluent at turning business pain into working software. You're comfortable embedded inside non-technical teams, and you can translate a leader's strategic frustration, not just an operator's task-level one, into a scoped, sequenced portfolio.
  • Technically strong across the stack. You can architect and build agent systems independently, make sound build-versus-reuse calls, and hold your own in design review with principal-level engineers.
  • Proficient in application engineering, not just AI. You have hands-on experience building and shipping production applications, preferably full-stack, and can make sound architectural decisions across frontend and backend systems.
  • Outcome-obsessed. You talk in metrics and business value, not feature lists, and you hold yourself accountable for whether the portfolio moved the numbers, not just whether things shipped.
  • A force multiplier. You have a track record of making other engineers better through review, mentorship, patterns, or tooling, and people you've worked with would say so unprompted.
  • A clear communicator. You're equally comfortable with operators on the floor, engineers in review, and executives in a readout, and you can carry a room that started out skeptical.
  • A continuous learner. You believe staying excellent in this field means never standing still. You actively track the latest models, tools, and techniques as they ship, form your own view on what matters, and bring the best of it back to the team.

The Role

BPX is hiring Senior Martech Consultants into our Intelligent Marketing practice. You will configure, build and optimise customer engagement platforms for enterprise clients, turning marketing use cases into live, measurable, cross-channel journeys. Braze is the primary engagement platform for this team, fed by customer data platforms such as Twilio Segment and cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake.   • Write and maintain dynamic, personalised content using Liquid, Connected Content and Content Blocks, driven by customer attributes and events.
  • Set up the data behind each journey: user attributes, custom events, segments and audience syncs from the CDP and data warehouse.
  • Support migrations from legacy marketing automation platforms, including template, data and journey rebuilds, parallel running and cutover.
  • Plan and run testing, from QA, seed lists and previews through to A/B tests, multivariate tests and control groups.
  • Monitor deliverability, performance and data flows, and diagnose issues across the stack before they reach the client's customers.
  • Build consent, preference management and regulated content controls into every journey, including GDPR and sector-specific requirements.

Customer engagement is where our clients' data investment turns into revenue, and demand for Braze skills across BPX's Intelligent Marketing practice is outstripping the team we have. Description

MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States.

We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

As Staff Product Designer, you will own the end-to-end design of MEDvidi's AI Track, the core line of AI-powered clinical tools where providers interact with model outputs in a regulated healthcare environment. Your design decisions directly shape how clinicians review, accept, and correct AI-generated notes, treatment plans, and recommendations, impacting both provider efficiency and patient outcomes.

You will work closely with product managers and engineers, reporting to the Director of Product. This is a senior IC role with no direct reports: you drive product design from problem definition through delivery, gather requirements independently, and bring solutions to release. Your scope includes provider-facing tools (Chart Review, AI Scribe, AI Receptionist), patient portal, and internal operational systems, all web-based.

Why this role

  • Zero-to-one in AI-first environment. You will shape new interaction patterns for agentic AI features: Chart Review, AI Scribe, AI Receptionist, where design quality directly affects clinical decisions.
  • Prototype in real code, not Figma mockups. Prototyping happens in Claude Code and Cursor on the actual codebase with production components. Your prototypes go straight to engineering without redrawing.
  • Co-own a design system built for humans and AI agents. You will evolve reusable components, tokens, and documentation that are readable by both your teammates and code-generation agents, a rare opportunity to define what design systems look like in an AI-native workflow.

Responsibilities

  • Own product design in your areas of the AI Track end-to-end: from defining the problem with the product manager, through user analysis, to working with engineers on the solution and accepting the build.
  • Design and iterate on human-AI interaction patterns: interfaces where providers verify, accept, edit, or reject model output and bring those patterns to a state where other teams can reuse them.
  • Ensure quality of design decisions: validate solutions with users when needed, perform design acceptance with engineering, analyze post-release results, and feed learnings back into the product.
  • Contribute to the design system within product initiatives: turn your solutions into reusable components in Storybook with tokens, naming, and documentation that are usable by both designers and AI code-generation agents.
  • Gather requirements independently: go to providers, medical operations, and product managers, identify problems, and bring back a proposal. There is no standing PM brief in AI Track, you shape the brief.
  • Accelerate design delivery using AI tools: build functional prototypes in Claude Code or Cursor on the real codebase with production components; prototypes go to engineering without redrawing.

This role is not for you if

  • You need a detailed brief before starting work. Requirements here are gathered by you, not handed to you, there is no PM or BA writing specs for AI Track.
  • You prefer managing people over hands-on design. This is an IC role with no direct reports; the impact comes from the quality of your own design decisions.
  • You design exclusively in Figma and hand off static specs. Prototyping at MEDvidi happens in code on the real codebase using AI agents, comfort with a code editor is a daily requirement, not a nice-to-have.

Requirements

  • 6+ years in product design, with a focus on complex work interfaces: EHR, admin panels, CRM, operational tools, or other systems where specialists perform their core work.

  • Track record of contributing to a design system within product work: shipping reusable components, tokens, and documentation as part of feature delivery, not as a standalone project.
  • Proven ability to gather requirements independently, finding problems, talking to users and stakeholders, and driving a solution to release without waiting for a mandated brief.
  • Advanced English (B2+) and fluent Russian.
  • Availability to work within CET-compatible hours.

Would be a plus

  • Experience in healthcare or telemedicine products: understanding of HIPAA, clinical compliance constraints, and the provider's role in decision-making.
  • Experience leading a design team's transition to AI tools: setting up shared agent workflows, running workshops, driving adoption across peers.
  • Hands-on user research with specialist users: usability testing and interviews with doctors, nurses, or clinical operators (not only end consumers).

What we offer

  • High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.
  • Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model.

  • Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events.

About Megaport

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

Our Team Culture

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.
We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role

The Senior Technical GTM Specialist acts as a technical authority within the Global GTM organisation, bridging our Megaport Network and Latitude.sh Compute and Storage platforms. This is a pivotal role in translating Megaport’s platform capabilities into clear, deployable architectures for our customers. This role bridges Product, Engineering, and Go-to-Market teams by transforming complex multi-platform solutions into practical blueprints, technical enablement materials, and field-ready assets.

You will work at the intersection of deep technical expertise and customer-facing strategy, ensuring that highly sophisticated solutions - spanning connectivity, compute, storage, and emerging workloads - are articulated with precision and credibility.

This role provides a high impact career path for experienced Solution Architects who want to shape global Technical GTM strategy, and build technical content (diagrams, guides, labs, battlecards etc) that help influence & close deals.

Instead of high-level collateral, you will create concrete technical blueprints, clean architecture diagrams, API integration guides, and hands-on lab environments.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Enablement Partnership & Technical Guides: Partner closely with the Global Sales Enablement team to write, design, and maintain clear technical guides for both internal teams (Solutions Architects, Technical Account Managers & Global Sales team) and external audiences.

  • Global Solution Architecture Training: Build & deliver technical trainings & workshops for all Global Megaport Solution Architects, ensuring accurate content in collaboration with product and product marketing.

  • Product & Engineering Roadmap Alignment: Work directly with the Product managers and Engineering teams to stay ahead of upcoming product releases, test early feature builds, and ensure technical enablement materials are complete before the release. Leveraging product marketing and enablement teams to distribute.

  • Hands-on Demos & Labs: Build interactive sandbox environments, demo scripts, and lab guides for Solution Architects to use, learn & demo in complex customer deals.

  • GTM Strategy & Deal Feedback: Convert deal insights and win/loss data into actionable GTM strategy and concrete product feature requests for Engineering and Product teams.

  • Contribute to thought leadership through whitepapers, solution briefs, and technical deep dives

What We Are Looking For

  • Diagramming & Visual Tool Skills: Proven capability using Figma, Lucidchart, Draw.io, or equivalent tools to design clear, customer facing technical diagrams.

  • Core Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of networking fundamentals (BGP, IP routing, firewalls) and bare-metal server infrastructure.

  • Hands-on Capability: Strong experience working with APIs, infrastructure automation (Terraform/Ansible), and setting up live lab environments.

  • Simple & Clear Communication: Ability to translate complex engineering concepts into direct, plain language for sellers and enterprise buyers.

  • Demonstrated ability to create detailed technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and deployment guides

  • You can work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

What We Offer

  • Generous leave plans – including, parental leave, birthday leave, and a purchased annual leave program

  • Health and wellness support – through a wellness allowance and employee wellbeing initiatives

  • Comprehensive learning support – generous study and training allowance plus paid study leave

ABOUT THE ROLE

AI is rewriting how every company works, and everyone is racing to figure out how to secure it. We have, and we need someone to take it to market.

The AI Security Sales Executive is a quota-carrying sales role dedicated entirely to Abnormal's AI Security suite: five products built to help customers govern AI, secure AI, and defend against rogue AI. You will own AI Security in your territory, from the first conversation through close, hunting the largest new logos while working alongside the Account Executives who already know our customers best. This is a sales role for someone who can carry a number and go as deep technically as our best engineers when a conversation demands it.

The timing matters. Abnormal is growing about 50% year over year, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. AI security now comes up in close to 80% of customer conversations at the executive level, and customers already trust our behavioral AI to solve it. Demand is outrunning capacity. You will step into a deep pipeline on day one, and you will have real say in how this category gets sold.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own AI Security in your territory. Carry the AI Security quota and run the full sales cycle end to end, from first conversation through close, including significant upsell campaigns across our existing customer base.
  • Hunt the largest new logos. Take Abnormal's AI Security story into the biggest enterprises in the world, and open doors beyond the customers who already trust us.
  • Prioritize ruthlessly. Inbound interest will outpace your calendar. Decide where your time moves the needle, and where it does not.
  • Partner with Account Executives. Work alongside the core team in your territory, equip them to carry AI Security conversations, and step in on the deals that matter most.
  • Go deep on the technology. Hold your own with security and platform teams on behavioral AI, cloud security, and agent security when a customer needs more than a standard pitch.
  • Run point on design partner conversations for products still in early availability, working closely with product leadership to shape these deals and bring the right resources to the table.
  • Shape the product and the playbook. Feed what you hear in the field back to product leadership in a fast loop, and help build how AI Security gets sold as the suite matures from early availability to GA.
  • Stay current as the suite evolves. Availability and depth will shift quickly, and you will keep pace.

WHAT YOU’LL SELL

Abnormal's AI Security suite includes five products, each at a different stage of availability:

  • AI Governance: Discovers your AI, uncovers shadow AI, and shows who's using what and at what cost.
  • AI Cloud Security: Detects and contains AI cloud breaches using behavioral AI and honeypots.
  • AI Employee Guardrails: Lets employees use AI without leaking data or triggering unintended actions.
  • AI Agent Security: Inventories an organization's AI agents and ensures they behave as intended.
  • AI Security Workbench: Lets security teams use AI to run investigations with Abnormal's models, without guardrails.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS RIGHT NOW

Every security vendor is staking a claim in AI security. Abnormal has earned real credibility here through eight years of behavioral AI investment and a track record protecting email for thousands of customers. That trust is an advantage today, not a permanent one, and this role exists to make sure we capitalize on it while the window is open.

For the right person, that means owning a brand-new motion at the center of a fast-growing company, working directly with executive and product leadership, and building a track record as one of the people who defined how this category gets sold.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying sales experience, primarily selling into Enterprise accounts, with a proven record of winning new logos and expanding accounts.
  • Technical depth and curiosity: comfort discussing AI architecture, cloud security concepts, and how behavioral models work, in enough detail to earn trust with technical buyers.
  • A hunter's drive paired with the judgment to prioritize when demand exceeds capacity.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity. The suite and the motion for selling it are still evolving, and much of the playbook will be written by whoever takes this role on.
  • Strong cross-functional instincts. You will partner closely with Account Executives, Sales Engineering, and product leadership, and you will work autonomously between those touchpoints.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Direct experience selling AI security, cloud security, or other emerging security categories.
  • Experience in an overlay, specialist, or advisory role in cybersecurity or AI, or a record of selling into CISOs and security leaders.
  • Experience selling early-availability products and shaping design partner deals.

Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.
In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

About Luma Financial Technologies

Founded in 2018, Luma Financial Technologies (“Luma”) has pioneered a cutting-edge fintech software platform that has been adopted by broker/dealer firms, RIA offices, and private banks around the world. By using Luma, institutional and retail investors have a fully customizable, independent, buy-side technology platform that helps financial teams more efficiently learn about, research, purchase, and manage alternative investments as well as annuities. Luma gives these users the ability to oversee the full, end-to-end process lifecycle by offering a suite of solutions. These include education resources and training materials; creation and pricing of custom structured products; electronic order entry; and post-trade management. By prioritizing transparency and ease of use, Luma is a multi-issuer, multi-wholesaler, and multi-product option that advisors can utilize to best meet their clients’ specific portfolio needs. Headquartered in Cincinnati, OH, Luma also has offices in New York, NY, Miami, FL, Zurich, Switzerland and Lisbon, Portugal. For more information, please visit Luma’s website.

About the role

We’re looking for a driven sales professional to lead our growth in the Canadian structured notes market. Luma has strong relationships in Canada and is already operating in this market. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving growth in Canada and establishing Luma as the independent, multi-issuer platform of choice for Canadian distributors of structured notes.

Luma is a leading structured notes platform across the United States, Latin America, and Europe. In this role you will lead the commercial strategy and its execution: identifying and winning distribution clients, building relationships with Canadian issuers, and partnering with our Americas Bank and Broker Dealer team on ongoing client management once accounts are live.

Success in this role depends on a strong existing network across the Canadian notes market and deep knowledge of structured products.

What you'll do

Market Development and Growth

  • Lead the execution of Luma’s Canada expansion strategy and drive revenue growth for the Canadian structured notes market.
  • Identify, pursue, and win new distribution clients across Canada, including independent and bank owned investment dealers, advisors, family offices, and other distributors of notes.
  • Build the pipeline of prospects, drive sales efforts, and set = commercial priorities.

Distributor and Issuer Relationships

  • Deepen and expand existing relationships across buy side independent broker dealers.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with Canadian structured notes issuers, helping extend their distribution reach and empowering to extract value from the Luma platform.
  • Coordinate issuer-related initiatives with Luma’s head of issuer relations.
  • Serve as the interface between Canadian partners and the Luma team.

Market Positioning and Advocacy

  • Champion Luma’s multi-issuer, independent approach to platform technology with Canadian distributors of structured notes.
  • Monitor Canadian market dynamics, product innovation, and regulatory developments to refine Luma’s positioning.
  • Represent Luma at industry events, conferences, and client forums to build brand presence and market credibility.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Luma’s Americas Bank and Broker Dealer team on ongoing client management and service for Canadian accounts once they are live.
  • Work with Product, Technology, Operations, and other involved teams to ensure smooth onboarding and client success, including any Canada specific platform requirements.
  • Act as the voice of the Canadian client, providing actionable feedback to inform product development, platform enhancements, and workflow priorities.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in structured products sales, distribution, or relationship management.
  • Strong working knowledge of structured products: payoff structures, pricing mechanics, lifecycle events, and the trade workflow from RFQ through maturity.
  • Extensive relationships across buy side distributors of notes in Canada, including independent broker dealers, bank owned and independent investment dealers, and family offices.
  • Relationships with Canadian structured notes issuers are a significant advantage.
  • Familiarity with the Canadian market landscape, including CIRO registered dealers and the distribution of principal protected notes, market linked GICs, and autocallable structures.
  • Exceptional communication skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field. Canadian Securities Course (CSC) or other industry designations a plus.

Senior Fellow, Energy and Environment

R Street Institute

Washington, D.C.

The R Street Institute—a free-market think tank headquartered in Washington, D.C. and with staff located across the country—seeks a collaborative Senior Fellow for its Energy and Environment program. If you are the right fit, you will report to the Energy and Environment Program Director. If you want to join a mission-driven organization and work toward pragmatic policy solutions, this may be the opportunity for you!

Your typical day at R Street may include producing research and written work on market-driven approaches to disaster mitigation; educating state and federal legislators on potential efficient environmental regulations; presenting at events on water scarcity policies managed through clearer water rights and markets rather than mandates; engaging with the media; and coordinating with allies, both in the EcoRight space and the wider environmental community.

Other Aspects of Your Role

  • Develop and advance market-driven approaches to environmental challenges, grounded in the evidence on climate change and in R Street’s commitment to limited, effective government
  • Conceive, manage, and coordinate environmental policy projects, including those led by R Street’s other energy and environment subject matter experts
  • Monitor state and federal environmental policy developments and adapt engagement strategy in a fluid legislative and regulatory landscape
  • Work with the Government Affairs and Communications teams to engage target audiences, from the informed public to expert stakeholders and policy makers on practical solutions such as resilience and adaptation to natural disasters
  • Provide regulatory and legislative testimony and brief state and federal policymakers and regulators directly
  • Support director in program strategy and meetings with donors and other stakeholders
  • Remain vigilant against ninja infiltrations

Skills and Qualifications

  • Deep environmental policy expertise, including knowledge on resilience and adaptation methods to address the effects of natural disasters and knowledge of limited, efficient, and effective government regulation structures that address environmental issues without overreach
  • Top-notch writing and editing skills in both short- and long-form products that translate complex analysis for policymakers and the public
  • Exceptional communication and advanced writing skills, including experience speaking with legislators and regulators
  • Demonstrated ability to work productively with a wide variety of groups and individuals including state and/or federal policymakers, even those with whom you may disagree
  • Willingness to speak publicly and/or appear on camera, including in interviews
  • Ability to provide strategic, research-backed policy insights
  • Knowledge of permitting and siting policies related to energy and environmental issues is preferred, but not required
  • Knowledge of market-based carbon accounting policies/proposals is preferred, but not required
  • Knowledge of the relationship between insurance markets and natural disasters and climate change is preferred, but not required
  • No particular educational background required—a proven record of achieving results is far more meaningful than credentials
  • Support for R Street’s passion for free markets and limited, effective government
  • A sense of humor and a desire to grow within a multifaceted organization

The R Street Institute consistently offers pragmatic, real solutions that foster American innovation, bolster competition, and safeguard individual liberty—all with the understanding that life in a democratic society sometimes requires compromises that don’t necessarily represent first, best solutions. We focus on deep scholarship and pragmatic policy solutions that many groups tend to neglect. Our goal is to publish timely, relevant research and analysis that advances a market-oriented society and limited, effective government. To that end, our motto is “Free Markets. Real Solutions.” Read more about our mission and impact.

Workplace

Some travel is required, including to Washington, D.C. and state capitals to meet with lawmakers and stakeholders as well as nationwide for relevant conferences and professional engagements.

We offer a flexible working arrangement. This is a full-time position that can either work the majority of the week in our D.C. office or be fully remote.

Compensation, Benefits, and Perks

R Street strives to offer a compensation and benefits package that is competitive, transparent, and supportive of employee well-being. The salary range for this position is $160,000–$170,000, commensurate with experience. In addition to this competitive salary, we provide the following:

  • Unlimited paid time off, including all federal holidays, the day after Thanksgiving, and two weeks holiday closure in December
  • Alternating Fridays off
  • A health insurance option entirely paid by the employer (even for families)
  • Dental and vision insurance
  • 401(k) contributions with up to a 4 percent match
  • HSA employer contribution match
  • Quarterly wellness reimbursement
  • Mobile equipment/mobile plan reimbursement
  • Home internet subsidy
  • Annual educational and professional development reimbursement
  • A choice between child care assistance, pet care assistance, and student loan repayment assistance

At R Street, we strive for preeminence in every area in which we engage, driven by our commitment to excellence and innovation. Our culture thrives on action, creativity, and courage, with an unwavering focus on quality, credibility, and impact. We believe progress requires diverse experience and expertise, which is why we champion non-traditional yet prudent approaches to public policy. This principle guides how we build our programs, recognizing that each team member’s uniqueness strengthens our collective identity.

We approach our mission with intellectual rigor, embracing free inquiry and honesty to ensure our work is grounded in solid research and thoughtful analysis. While serious about our purpose, we value the joy of collaboration and the fun that comes from working together. Our collaborative spirit fosters trust and transparency, with respect and openness guiding our actions. We celebrate our individual contributions while recognizing that we are stronger as one team, united in our work and relationships.

Thus, R Street does not discriminate on the basis of age, sex, race, creed, color, national origin, sexual orientation, era of military service, gender identity or expression, relationship structure, or anything else that’s illegal, immoral, or stupid to use as a basis for hiring.

We plan to accept applications for this job until filled. We will contact qualified individuals for telephone screenings and conduct them on a rolling basis. Interviews take place virtually via Zoom.

To apply, please copy and paste your cover letter into the text box and upload your resume as a Microsoft Word document or PDF. We encourage thoughtful use of AI tools. If you use them, please describe how they contributed to your work.


The R Street Institute stands for free markets, limited, effective government and pragmatic solutions to difficult problems. We envision:

A free society, where public policy begins with freedom as its initial premise and governments exist primarily as guardians of inherent, inalienable rights.

An inclusive society that provides a place, a voice, and equal opportunity for all.

A just society that holds everyone accountable to the same laws.

Our Values

The following values are the principles that guide how R Street fulfills its mission and operates. Our organization believes in these values and we live them:

Always be better

We want to achieve preeminence in every area where we work. We encourage a bias for action, innovation, creativity, and courage in everything that we do. We measure ourselves by the quality, credibility and impact we achieve as a result.

Different is good.

We believe that great minds think differently and building broad coalitions has made us who we are. Making progress on policy requires that we operate outside of the echo chamber and take non-traditional approaches to policy making. We apply this same principle to the way we operate and how we build our teams: with a focus on diversity and inclusion. We are all unique but belong to the same team.

Serious(ly)

We’re serious about our work, but don’t take ourselves too seriously. We believe in the intellectual rigor, free inquiry and honesty, that is required to achieve our mission, but having fun doing it is equally as important.

One Team

We all work together and work with humility. We strive to cultivate trust and transparency at all levels, between ourselves as individuals and as an organization, with our stakeholders, and in our work. We demonstrate respect and openness in our actions at all times. We are all unique but belong to the same team.
