jobs.description:
Statistiker:in (m/w/d)

Ab 4.500 € brutto / Monat · Klare Steigerung nach Ergebnissen · Kleines Team, große Verantwortung

Worum es geht

Wir begleiten Mediziner:innen durch ihre Promotion — von Methodik über Auswertung bis zur fertigen Dissertation. Unsere Klient:innen sind keine Studenten, sondern erwachsene Profis, die liefern müssen. Du bist die Person, die dafür sorgt, dass das passiert.

Konkret heißt das: Du übernimmst Projekte von der ersten Methodendiskussion bis zur finalen Abgabe. Du analysierst Daten (R, Python, SPSS, MAXQDA — je nachdem, was das Projekt verlangt), überarbeitest wissenschaftliche Texte, erklärst Doktorand:innen Methoden ruhig und klar, gibst Feedback, hältst Termine ein und triffst Entscheidungen, ohne dass jemand dich an die Hand nehmen muss.

Ehrlich gesagt

Wir sind ein kleines Unternehmen mit hoher Schlagzahl und hoher Effizienz. Wir brauchen sorgfältige, einsatzbereite und belastbare Leute, die methodisch sauber arbeiten, überdurchschnittlich verdienen wollen und in einem wachsenden Unternehmen von Anfang an dabei sein wollen.

Im Gegenzug bekommst du etwas, das ein Konzern nicht bieten kann: Vom ersten Tag an eigene Projekte, direkten Kundenkontakt, sichtbare Wirkung, und einen Aufstieg, der sich an deinen Ergebnissen bemisst und nicht an deiner Betriebszugehörigkeit.

Was du machst

  • Mediziner:innen durch den kompletten Promotionsprozess führen — Methodik, Statistik, Schreiben, Struktur

  • Statistische und qualitative Auswertungen liefern (R, Python, SPSS, MAXQDA)

  • Doktorand:innen Methoden geduldig und klar erklären — schriftlich und im Gespräch

  • Wissenschaftliche Texte überarbeiten, Feedback geben, methodische Sauberkeit sicherstellen

  • Mehrere parallele Projekte koordinieren — Termine, Qualität, Kundenkontakt

  • KI- und Automatisierungstools so einsetzen, dass du schneller und besser wirst als ohne

  • Mit Professor:innen, Lehrstühlen und Forschungsstellen sauber kommunizieren

Was du mitbringst

  • Hochschulabschluss (Bachelor oder Master) in Statistik, Psychologie (empirisch/quantitativ), Sozialwissenschaft (quant), Wirtschaftsmathematik, BWL mit Empirie-Schwerpunkt, Mathematik, Public Health (quantitativ) oder vergleichbar. Eine Promotion ist nicht erforderlich und gibt hier keinen Bonus.

  • Strukturierte, methodische Arbeitsweise. Du planst, bevor du loslegst. Du arbeitest sorgfältig statt hektisch. Du erkennst Inkonsistenzen in Daten oder Texten, die andere überlesen.

  • Bodenständigkeit. Du hast in deinem Leben schon einmal richtig gearbeitet — Gastro, Bau, Pflege, Pflichtdienst, Lager, Versorgerjobs, körperliche Tätigkeiten neben dem Studium. Wer einmal eine 10-Stunden-Schicht in der Küche oder auf der Baustelle gemacht hat, weiß, was ehrliche Arbeit bedeutet

  • Aktuelle Statistik-Praxis. Du hast in den letzten 12 Monaten konkret mit R, Python, SPSS oder MAXQDA gearbeitet — nicht nur im Studium.

  • Erfahrung im Erklären von Methoden — als Tutor:in, Nachhilfelehrer:in, Übungsleiter:in, Werkstudent:in im Lehrstuhl-Umfeld oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle. Wer Lernenden schon einmal Statistik ruhig erklärt hat, bringt das wichtigste Soft-Skill mit.

  • Emotionale Stabilität. Wenn ein:e Klient:in panisch wird, bleibst du ruhig. Wenn drei Mandate parallel brennen, sortierst du methodisch, statt dich anstecken zu lassen. Du nimmst Fehler sachlich, nicht persönlich.

  • Eigenverantwortung und Verbindlichkeit. Du strukturierst deinen Tag selbst, hältst Deadlines ein, lieferst zuverlässig — auch wenn niemand drüberguckt.

  • Belastbarkeit in intensiven Phasen — keine Schönwetter-Mentalität.

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau — du musst Texte korrigieren und gegenüber Senior-Klient:innen klar, aber respektvoll argumentieren können.

  • Lust auf Privatwirtschaft, nicht auf Uni-Atmosphäre.

Berufserfahrung von Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Wir nehmen auch Berufseinsteiger:innen mit starkem Tutor-Track. Mit 2-5 Jahren Berufserfahrung in datenorientierten Bereichen (Marktforschung, Pharma-Innendienst, Junior Analytics, klinische Studien) bist du im Vorteil.

Was wir bieten

  • Geld: Ab 4.500 € brutto, reale Steigerung in den ersten 6–12 Monaten nach Ergebnissen

  • Aufstieg nach Leistung: Wer liefert, kommt schnell hoch — Zugehörigkeit zählt nicht

  • Echte Verantwortung: Eigene Projekte, eigene Kunden, eigene Entscheidungen — ab Tag 1

  • Profi-Umfeld: MacBook, moderne Tools, KI-Stack — keine Bastellösungen

  • Klare Strukturen: Max. 2–3 Personen pro Büro, keine Konzernpolitik, keine Meetings ohne Zweck

  • Entwicklung: Methodisch, technisch und unternehmerisch — du wächst hier real

Wen wir nicht suchen

Wir suchen keine Akademiker:innen, die in der Forschungsblase bleiben wollen. Keine Theoretiker:innen, die sich in Details verlieren, ohne zu liefern. Keine Leute, die "Work-Life-Balance" auf das Stundenkonto reduzieren. Wer langsam, unzuverlässig oder konfliktscheu ist, wird hier nicht glücklich — und wir auch nicht.

Wir suchen jemanden, der ruhig, methodisch und ergebnisorientiert arbeitet — und dafür entsprechend bezahlt werden will.

Bewerbung

Schick uns Lebenslauf und ein aussagekräftiges und persönliches Anschreiben.

  1. Warum du in eine kleine Firma willst — nicht in einen Konzern oder die Uni.

  2. Was du in den nächsten 12 Monaten konkret erreichen möchtest.

Relevante Arbeiten, Code oder Projektbeispiele gerne dazu.

Unvollständige Bewerbungen sortieren wir aus. Bei passenden Bewerbungen melden wir uns innerhalb von 5 Werktagen.

jobs.title: Product Design Lead (Canada)
jobs.excerpt: This is a fully remote role based in Canada.  Candidates may work from anywhere within Canada.
jobs.description:
This is a fully remote role based in Canada. Candidates may work from anywhere within Canada.

About Proof

We’re Proof, a high-growth company in the legal tech industry, founded in 2017. We’ve built a best-in-class platform trusted by thousands of law firms across the United States for Service of Process, the formal delivery of legal documents, and E-Filing. We connect law firms with process servers and enable electronic court filing, delivering over a million documents per year through a network of thousands of process servers. We’re working to make the legal system more efficient, transparent, and accessible than it’s traditionally been.

Design at Proof

We design for the whole service, not just the interface. We aren't a downstream team turning tickets into screens; we help the company understand complex problems, make ambiguity concrete, and decide what should become simpler before more gets built.

Design isn't an approval gate that every decision has to pass through. Depending on the work, we may lead the problem framing, partner with Product, Engineering, and Operations to explore a solution, or help a team improve work already underway. The goal is to bring the right level of design involvement while important decisions are still open.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to take on challenging product and service workflows, with a primary focus on the onboarding workflows that power legal document delivery.

Delivering documents in the real world comes with inevitable edge cases and complications. An action in the field ripples through our internal systems and what a law firm sees. For example, if a process server finds a recipient has moved, the law firm needs clarity, internal teams need to resolve the exception, and the delivery workflow changes. Designing here means understanding those connections and deciding whether the right intervention is software, a process shift, automation, or all three.

You’ll report directly to the Director of Design on a small, high-leverage team, partnering with Product, Engineering, and Operations leadership to frame ambiguous problems, explore tradeoffs, and shape direction before solutions are locked in.

You’ll have meaningful autonomy to frame problems, choose the right approach, and drive work forward, with close cross-functional partnership, not a prescribed playbook.

What you’ll do

  • Own complex workflows end-to-end: Aid in framing problems, navigate ripple effects across operations, servers, and customers, and drive through to delivery.
  • Prototype to learn: Build prototypes at the right fidelity to test assumptions, make ideas tangible, and help teams make clear decisions early.
  • Work with the hood open: Share unfinished work early, invite critique, and partner with Product, Engineering, and operations while problems are still malleable.
  • Design whole systems, not just screens: Create coherent workflows, interfaces, information architecture, and states across digital tools and operational processes.
  • Contribute to the practice: Create and improve interaction patterns and language within your work that help Operations specialists, process servers, and law firms move through the product without having to re-learn it. Share what you learn and work alongside other designers to strengthen craft and service thinking.

How we work

Part of the work here is strengthening how we build context, shifting toward an everyday habit, not a scheduled research phase. Rather than wait for complete briefs, we dig into the mechanics of the service by shadowing Operations specialists, listening to law-firm calls, talking with process servers, and asking questions until we have a solid understanding. From there, we move fluidly between sketching, prototyping, and writing clear recommendations to help teams make confident decisions while the problem is still open.

What you bring

  • Experience: Product design experience, or equivalent demonstrated expertise, including independently owning end-to-end design for complex product or service workflows.
  • End-to-end ownership: Proven track record leading ambiguous product or service work through shipped delivery, with clear reasoning and tradeoffs.
  • Rapid context-building: High domain curiosity and the ability to ramp up quickly on complex systems. You treat learning as a continuous habit, shadowing, listening to users, and digging into real workflows to develop a grounded point of view while the problem is still open.
  • Service & operational craft: Experience designing for internal operations, complex systems, or expert users where workflow efficiency and trust are paramount. You balance speed with clarity and accuracy, especially when mistakes have consequences beyond the interface.
  • Change in established environments: Experience introducing thoughtful change inside organizations with established workflows and deep tribal knowledge.
  • Prototyping: Comfort building prototypes at varying fidelities to explore ideas, communicate intent, and get early feedback from users and teammates.
  • Influence & partnership: A history of shaping product and technical direction across disciplines without relying on formal authority.
  • Craft & collaboration: Experience creating reusable design patterns, contributing thoughtful critique, and helping other designers improve their work.

Bonus points

You may also bring experience with:

  • Legal technology, logistics, marketplaces, or field-service products
  • Workflow automation or AI-assisted products, with sound judgment about where automation creates leverage and where human judgment, transparency, and restraint matter more

This may not be the right role if

  • You prefer to receive complete requirements or follow a prescribed process before beginning design.
  • You see design primarily as producing polished interfaces after the problem and direction have already been defined.
  • You prefer to stay within one part of the design practice and rely on handoffs rather than move across the work as the situation requires.

Compensation

From credit card processing to back-office management, North points the way to smarter, faster, and just plain better payment solutions.


Job Summary:

The Lifecycle Marketing Specialist owns the customer journey from first touch through renewal and expansion. This role is responsible for designing and executing email, in-app, and multi-channel lifecycle campaigns that transition contacts through the funnel—from lead to activated customer to advocate. Acting as the primary owner of the marketing automation platform (HubSpot), this position operates at the intersection of demand generation, product marketing, and analytics, partnering closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams to deliver relevant, timely, and measurable customer experiences.


What You’ll Do:

  • Partner with Analytics/Ops to define and track core lifecycle metrics (activation rate, time-to-value, retention, expansion revenue) and report on campaign performance.
  • Identify and troubleshoot data integrity issues across the lifecycle funnel (e.g., stage mismatches between HubSpot and CRM/Partner systems).
  • Run A/B tests on messaging, timing, and channel to continuously improve conversion rates at each lifecycle stage.
  • Collaborate with Content and Design teams to produce lifecycle-specific creative assets (email copy, in-app messages, triggered content).

What We Need From You:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or equivalent experience.

  • Track record of building nurture programs that measurably drive key business metrics (pipeline, activation, retention, NRR).
  • Experience in payments, fintech, or other regulated B2B industries is a plus.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to independently pull and interpret data to drive campaign decisions.

North, and our family of companies, are committed to helping entrepreneurs grow their businesses. As an end-to-end payment solutions company, we provide everything business owners need to get paid, whether they serve customers in a physical storefront, online, or both. Who We Are

BioMarin is a leading rare disease biotechnology company focused on genetically defined conditions.

Guided by our purpose to develop medicines that make a profound impact on people’s lives, our global teams have delivered a portfolio of therapies since our founding in 1997. Our revolutionary treatments for conditions like achondroplasia (the most common form of dwarfism), PKU (phenylketonuria), CLN2, a form of Batten disease, and a number of forms of MPS (mucopolysaccharidosis) offer new possibilities for patients and families who previously had few, if any, available options. More recently, with the close of the Amicus acquisition, our portfolio has expanded to include therapies for Fabry disease and Pompe disease, expanding our ability to reach more people living with rare genetic conditions.

Our success comes from our unwavering commitment to excellence, our deep understanding of patient needs, our scientific expertise, and our world-class manufacturing capabilities. At the heart of BioMarin is a dedicated team of the brightest minds in the industry working together to deliver innovative therapies to patients and families around the world.

About Worldwide Research and Development

From research and discovery to post-market clinical development, our R&D engine involves all bench and clinical research and the associated groups that support those endeavors. Our teams work on developing first-in-class and best-in-class therapeutics that provide meaningful advances to patients who live with rare diseases.

The Role

The Medical Scientific Director is accountable forthe day-to-day oversight of numerous BioMarin-sponsored and collaborative studies across a therapeutic area,ensuring consistency of approach, conduct, monitoring, analysis, and reporting of studies within one or more programs.TheMedical Scientific Directorwill work in partnership with Real World Evidence (RWE)/Epidemiology, Global Medical Leads, Data Sciences and Global Study Operations to develop practical study strategies and ensure optimal hands-on study operations and execution support for Medical Affairs-led studies from cross functional partners.

The Medical Scientific Director is part of the Integrated Evidence function comprised of subject matter experts in evidence planning, observational study design and data interpretation. The function works to drive excellence in evidence planning and implement novel study design approaches to generate robust evidence to enhance understanding of unmet medical need, support patient and endpoint selection for clinical studies and inform medical practice on appropriate use and long-term safety and effectiveness of BioMarin products to drive clinical adoption.

Key Responsibilities

Study Strategy and Implementation

  • Executes evidence generation activities (non-interventional, low-interventional and interventional Phase IIIb/IV studies) that will fill priority evidence gaps identified in product Integrated Evidence Plans (IEPs)
  • Collaborates closely and builds alliances with Global and Country Medical Leads, RWE Lead, and HEOR to understand key global and local (key market) needs and opportunities in order to develop strategic study pull through and dissemination plans
  • Collaborates closely with operational strategic partners to ensure successful implementation of GMAF-led studies; identifies issues in a timely manner, leads implementation of complex solutions, and/or escalates as appropriate
  • Provides scientific input into the development of study concepts, protocols and protocol amendments, statistical analysis plans, data review plans, and responses to regulatory agency questions regarding scientific aspects of study protocols
  • Leads the development of annual, interim and periodic study reports for Medical Affairs-led studies, including coordination of SME input, data interpretation and presentation, and ensuring that regulatory agency questions (where relevant) have been adequately addressed
  • Designs secondary data analysis plans of BioMarin clinical and real-world data to support program strategy
  • Ensures adequate medical monitoring oversight of assigned studies (where relevant) including monitoring and arbitration on subject eligibility, quality of safety and study data, development and review of ICFs, CRFs, TLGs, accurate AE and concomitant medication coding, and inspection readiness activities
  • Presents results of assigned studies to internal and external stakeholders, including at scientific conferences, and other relevant forums.
  • Coordinates Medical Affairs input in preparation of regulatory submissions, responses to regulatory queries, IRB/Ethics Committee questions, and in preparation for program regulatory inspections and audits for assigned programs.
  • Participates in initiatives to enhance or drive efficiency in study implementation

Desired Experience

  • PharmD/PhD/MD with at least 5 yearsexperience conductingobservational and Phase IIIb/IVstudies within Clinical Development and/or Medical Affairs;MS/MPH with 10+ years similar experience
  • Experience in delivering a portfolio ofprotocols and ensuring they meet strategic program objectives
  • Experience responding to regulatory agency, IRB/Ethics Committee questions regarding study designs and protocol conduct

Skills

  • Proven track record of working with cross-functional partners to ensure successful end-to-end delivery of studies in support of product Integrated Evidence Plans.
  • Track record of delivering high quality novel observational and Phase IIIb/IV studies
  • Works effectively in a cross-functional matrix settings to shape the study strategy for one or more assigned projects
  • Awareness of novel prospective observational and interventional study designs
  • Understanding of statistical and data analysis, research methods and design
  • Experience in study monitoring
  • Advanced knowledge of the clinical research process and Good Clinical /Pharmacoepidemiology Practice standards and requirements relating to conducting research and disseminating of scientific information.
  • Strong scientific writing and document development

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Job Title: Lead, Compliance Quality Assurance

Department: Regulatory Compliance

Reports to: Head, Compliance Quality Assurance

About this role As the Lead, Compliance Quality Assurance, you are the tactical backbone of our quality assessment framework. You will spearhead the day-to-day operations of our QA Assessor team, transforming quality assurance into a catalyst for operational excellence.

Through rigorous standard enforcement and precision-based calibration, you will ensure that Moniepoint’s critical divisions including KYC/Due Diligence, AML, LEA, Transaction Monitoring, and Fraud consistently meet SLAs and regulatory policy standards. Acting as the final line of defense against compliance drift, you are dedicated to maintaining flawless execution, high-velocity accuracy, and total regulatory integrity across all operational touchpoints.

Responsibilities

  • Supervise, train, and manage QA Assessors, ensuring consistent grading and execution through regular file calibration exercises.
  • Lead the secondary review process across the 'Six Pillars' (AML/Transaction Monitoring, Regulatory Control/LEA, and Forensic Fraud), identifying vulnerabilities in accuracy, speed, and regulatory compliance.
  • Maintain a centralized Compliance Defect Log and translate QA findings into actionable weekly feedback for operational Team Leads to drive continuous improvement.
  • Perform deep-dive analyses on compliance misses to differentiate between system threshold errors and investigator oversight, recommending necessary process adjustments.
  • Assist in coordinating internal and external audits by providing evidence of QA testing integrity and ensuring high-quality, audit-ready data.

Experience & Background

  • 2–4 years of progressive experience in Compliance QA, Financial Crime Investigation, or EDD/CDD within a FinTech, or commercial bank.
  • Must have at least 2 years of experience in a supervisory or team lead capacity.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

Skills & Competencies

  • Advanced proficiency in Compliance tools and data analysis using SQL and Excel.
  • Comprehensive understanding of Nigerian regulatory frameworks (AML/CFT), instant payment fraud, card/POS fraud typologies, and legal protocols for handling Law Enforcement Agency (LEA) and CDD, EDD and Customer screening.
  • Professional certification such as DCP, CAMS, CFE, or ICA International Diploma is an added advantage.

What success looks like in this role

  • Maintenance of flawless execution, high-velocity accuracy, and total regulatory integrity across all operational touchpoints.
  • Consistent meeting of SLAs and regulatory policy standards across KYC/Due Diligence, AML, LEA, Transaction Monitoring, and Fraud divisions.
  • Prevention of compliance drift through rigorous standard enforcement and precision-based calibration.
  • Transformation of quality assurance processes into a true catalyst for operational excellence.

Why join us

  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities.
  • Fully remote work culture and support for professional development.

jobs.description:
Values & Innovation

At Under Armour, we are committed to empowering those who strive for more, and the company's values - Act Sustainably, Celebrate the Wins, Fight on Together, Love Athletes and Stand for Equality - serve as both a roadmap for our teams and the qualities expected of every teammate.

Our Values define and unite us, the beliefs that are the red thread that connects everyone at Under Armour. Our values are rallying cries, reminding us why we're here, and fueling everything we do.

Our pursuit of better begins with innovation and with our team's mission of being the best. With us, you get the freedom to go further - no matter your role. That means developing, delivering, and selling the state-of-the-art products and digital tools that make top performers even better.

If you are a current Under Armour teammate, apply to this position on the Internal Career Site Here.

Purpose of Role

The Sr. Professional, Store Development Operations supports the Americas Store Construction team through project coordination, special-project tracking, and end-to-end fixture management. This role maintains project information, schedules, budgets, action logs, and documentation while coordinating deliverables across internal partners, consultants, contractors, fixture suppliers, and warehouse providers. The role is also responsible for coordinating fixture takeoffs, ordering, delivery, reconciliation, inventory, and asset tracking across new stores, renovations, and portfolio initiatives. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and experienced in retail construction coordination, fixture operations, logistics, and cross-functional stakeholder management.

Your Impact

• Coordinate the construction-document process through external consultants and track required reviews, approvals, and deliverables with internal partners.
• Maintain organized project and fixture documentation in SharePoint and other designated platforms to support document retention, accessibility, and collaboration.
• Maintain project schedules, budget information, action logs, and risk trackers; proactively escalate schedule, cost, procurement, and delivery risks to the appropriate project lead.
• Maintain accurate project trackers, drawing records, meeting notes, decisions, approvals, and portfolio data in designated systems.
• Identify opportunities to improve workflows, reporting accuracy, fixture utilization, cost control, and delivery timelines.
• Prepare regular status reports and presentation materials for construction leadership, cross-functional partners, and external stakeholders.
• Coordinate fixture takeoffs with Store Design, Visual Merchandising, Marketing, Operations, and project leads to validate quantities before ordering.
• Maintain accurate fixture inventory and asset records across suppliers, warehouses, active projects, and existing stores, including fixture type, generation, quantity, condition, location, and intended use.
• Coordinate fixture production, shipping, delivery, installation requirements, and transfers with project managers, consultants, general contractors, suppliers, warehouses, and store teams.
• Support punch-list coordination and track outstanding items through resolution.
• Coordinate the set up new sites in Service Channel prior to store openings.
• Coordinate the collection and transfer of new-store asset, warranty, and closeout information for facilities including test and balance reports, operating manuals, certificates of occupancy, lighting and HVAC specifications, finishes, fixture generation, square footage, and project type.
• Support warranty-period coordination and turnover follow-up for completed store projects.
• Support the Construction & Facilities teams with additional store development, construction coordination, and special-project duties as assigned.
• Support Facilities team with regional support including weekend, on call coverage, two weekends per month.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in construction management, architecture, business, supply chain, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
• Minimum of 5 years of experience in retail construction coordination, store development, fixture management, procurement, logistics, or project administration.
• Ability to read and interpret construction documents, fixture plans, schedules, and specifications.
• Familiarity with AutoCAD or similar drawing software is preferred.
• Experience maintaining project schedules, budgets, action logs, purchase orders, inventory records, or comparable operational trackers.
• Ability to coordinate multiple projects and priorities under tight deadlines.
• Strong time management, prioritization, organization, written communication, and escalation skills.
• Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through.
• General understanding of retail construction processes, fixture procurement, logistics, and store-opening requirements.
• Demonstrated ability to coordinate effectively with vendors, consultants, general contractors, warehouse partners, and internal stakeholders.
• Strong team player with a collaborative, service-oriented mindset.

Workplace Location

  • Location: Fully Remote
  • Travel: 20%

Sponsorship Eligibility: (US ONLY) UA does not offer sponsorship of job applicants for employment-based work authorization for this position at this time.

Relocation

  • No relocation provided

Base Compensation

$75,000.00-$100,000.00 USD

Most new hires fall within this range and have the opportunity to earn more over time. Initial placement within the salary range, however, is based on an individual's relevant knowledge, skills and experience for the position. UA is committed to helping our teammates succeed and advance in their careers. Base salary is only one component of our competitive Total Rewards package.

Benefits & Perks

  • Paid "UA Give Back" Volunteer Days: Work alongside your team to support initiatives in your local community
  • Under Armour Merchandise Discounts
  • Competitive 401(k) plan matching
  • Maternity and Parental Leave for eligible and FMLA-eligible teammates

About IonQ:

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Trideca is Australia's trusted strategy, AI, and digital transformation partner, helping some of the nation's largest enterprises (including NAB, Suncorp, Optus, Medibank, and AGL) drive meaningful business impact through technology.

With offices in Melbourne and Sydney and projects spanning multiple industries, we thrive on solving complex challenges, delivering cutting-edge solutions, and pushing the boundaries of what's possible.

About the opportunity

Trideca is delivering the implementation phase of a large customer identity transformation for one of Australia's best known regulated enterprises. The program moves customer identity from Okta to Auth0 across web, mobile, API and IVR channels, serving millions of customers. Design is complete, and the Auth0 platform is now ready to be built. That means tenancies, token services, security configuration and CI/CD. We are looking for an Identity Platform Lead who has built Auth0 at enterprise, customer scale before and can lead that build from the first day. You will have to work in Sydney/Melbourne time

What you will do

  • You will design and stand up Auth0 tenancies across development, test, staging and production.
  • You will build the token issuance and validation services and define the token and session architecture for every channel.
  • You will set the WAF rules, rate limiting and security hardening around each tenancy, and build a CI/CD pipeline that deploys Auth0 configuration as code.
  • You will also define a blue/green cutover approach so the new Auth0 flows can run alongside Okta without disrupting live traffic.
  • You will own the technical migration path from Okta to Auth0, including how existing sessions and credentials move across.
  • You will work closely with the established API, iOS and Android squads to define the contract each channel builds against, and make sure machine to machine traffic stays correctly scoped on Okta during the transition.
  • You will be the senior technical voice on identity. That means resolving the remaining platform level questions, making the key technical calls, documenting the build so it can be operated and extended after handover, and raising go live risk early, given that some cutover changes cannot be rolled back.

What you bring

  • You have stood up Auth0 tenancies at enterprise, customer facing scale, not only integrated applications against an existing tenancy.
  • You have migrated an identity platform from Okta or a comparable enterprise IAM product to Auth0.
  • You know OAuth2, OIDC, token services and Auth0 Actions in depth from hands on work.
  • You have defined WAF and security configuration for a customer identity platform, and applied Terraform or an equivalent infrastructure as code tool to identity configuration.
  • You work well in ambiguity and can find the questions nobody has asked yet.
  • Experience in financial services, healthcare or another regulated industry is highly regarded.

What success looks like

A working Auth0 authorizer in a lower environment that unblocks API testing. Clear, documented ownership of the identity platform. A pipeline that deploys Auth0 configuration reliably and repeatably. A cutover plan in which outage and rollback risk is understood and mitigated. Delivery squads building against a stable, tested platform rather than mocked outputs.

Why Choose Trideca?

Empowering Women in Technology: We are committed to closing the gender gap in technology. With our dedicated road map for women, you'll find tailored opportunities to advance your career, supported by mentorship, leadership programs, Women in Technology Chapter and inclusive policies like menstruation leave and flexible working options.

Growth Through Learning: Your growth is our priority. At Trideca, you'll have access to a wide range of learning and development initiatives, from certifications and workshops to personal development programs, ensuring you are always at the forefront of technology and innovation.

Work Your Way: Our flexible work policy supports you to balance your personal and professional life.

Trideca Values

Clients Come First

We obsess over our clients; they mean everything to us and are central to everything we do. We take the time to understand them, so we can deliver outstanding experiences and create moments of WOW.

Achieve Greatness Together

Business is a team sport, and we are here to win. We respect, value, and inspire each other to bring our best to raise the bar. We will high-five you when you've nailed it and have honest discussions when you don't.

We Celebrate Our Differences

We are stronger and more successful when we include and appreciate different backgrounds, ideas, and experiences. Diversity helps us be more creative, solve problems better, and achieve more. By valuing everyone's unique contributions, we create a cohesive workplace where everyone can thrive and grow.

Own Your Space

We own our space, relationships, and client outcomes. We are fully committed and accountable to ourselves and each other; we deliver what we commit to. We adopt a commercial outlook and expect everyone to think and make decisions like we are the CEO.

Debate, Agree, Commit

We champion open dialogue where every voice matters and ideas are rigorously challenged to create stronger solutions. Once we reach alignment, we commit fully as one team and execute with excellence and accountability.

Have Fun, Go Nuts

No explanation is required, have fun, go nuts.

We also believe that the unique contributions of everyone at Trideca is the driver of our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to embrace everyone's perspectives and experiences, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability. We are passionate about creating a workplace that fosters active participation and provides an equal playing field, where merit and accomplishment are the sole criteria for success. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. We celebrate the diversity of our workforce and are dedicated to creating an environment where everyone feels welcome, valued, and included.

jobs.description:
Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.

What You’ll Do:

  • Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.
  • Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.
  • Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.
  • Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have:

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.
  • Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.
  • Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.
  • Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
  • An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

The France Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-100,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

We're seeking a Senior Brokerage Operations Associate (Canada). An experienced individual contributor who has lived dealer, clearing, and custody reality and designs every process as if manual work is temporary.

You turn CIRO-aligned operating requirements into scalable, automated, auditable workflows that Product and Engineering can build against. You partner closely with the ACCC President / UDP, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and global Ops. Someone who influences through expertise, crisp documentation, and decision logs, not through a team.

Success is measured by launch readiness, STP and control quality, registered-account / tax operability, and systems others can run and not by headcount or heroic spreadsheet ops.

What you'll walk into:

You won't be starting from zero. You'll be owning live problems:

  • Getting ready to open: figure out how we open and maintain accounts, process trades, and hold client cash and securities on day one. Build that for ACCC rather than copying a manual process from another firm.
  • Working with partner brokers: define how a partner firm and ACCC split the work on accounts, trades, and holding client assets, so it still works as volume grows.
  • After the trade: settlement in Canada (through CDS), trades that fail to settle, and corporate actions such as dividends and splits. Automate the routine cases and keep a clear list of exceptions, instead of running the book in spreadsheets.
  • Registered accounts and tax: TFSA, RRSP, RESP, and similar accounts. Cover who can open them, contribution rules, what a security cost, tax withheld on dividends and other income, and the reports clients and partners need.
  • The day after launch: written steps for daily work, checks that our records match the custodian and the market, contacts at vendors and custodians, and a plan if a system or vendor fails. Have these ready before real client volume shows up.
  • Building Canada: clear handoffs between product, engineering, and operations teams.

What you’ll own:

  • Account lifecycle & client/introducing-broker servicing (onboarding handoffs, KYC/AML ops interfaces, maintenance, transfers)
  • Trade lifecycle (capture, affirmation, clearing, settlement, fails, breaks)
  • Custody & asset servicing (segregation, security movements, corporate actions, cash)
  • Books & records, reconciliations, exception management, and operational controls
  • Registered accounts & tax ops: TFSA, RRSP, RESP and related wrappers; tax lots / cost basis; withholding; local reporting partners need to stay compliant
  • Day-2 production ops: runbooks, escalations, vendor/custody interfaces, BCP/DR operational playbooks

How you’ll work:

  • Translate Canadian reality into runnable process — CIRO-aligned dealer/clearing/custody expectations, introducing–carrying dynamics, custody controls, and operational risk into SOPs, RACI, controls, and exception paths Product and Engineering can build against
  • Automation-first by default —redesign high-volume / high-risk / high-friction work for straight-through processing, rules, exception queues, and measurable SLAs, instead of spreadsheet heroics
  • AI-first operating lens — Prototype and productize AI-assisted ops (exception triage, recon investigation, SOP Q&A, control-testing support, runbook copilots) with human oversight where risk or regulation requires it
  • Go-live and beyond — Readiness for ACCC launch and early production; continuous improvement after go-live
  • Raise the bar without managing a team — Coach partners through expertise, crisp documentation, and decision logs; leave systems others can run

How we'll measure success:

  • Launch readiness gates met with documented controls, SOPs, RACI, and runbooks Product / Eng / Ops can execute against
  • STP, exception, and reconciliation aging targets defined and trending the right way post go-live
  • Registered-account and tax workflows ready when partners launch, rather than added later
  • Specs and decision logs that remove re-discovery for Product and Engineering
  • Systems and playbooks others can run after you, so knowledge sticks in the org and not only in one person's head

Who you are (Must-haves):

  • 10+ years deep, hands-on Canadian brokerage operations experience at a CIRO dealer, carrying broker, custodian, clearing firm, or brokerage ops function in Canada
  • Fluent in the plumbing: clearing / settlement, custody, CDS / CDSX (or equivalent), fails, corp actions, tax, cash / securities ops, account servicing, introducing / carrying arrangements
  • Demonstrated depth in at least two of: clearing / settlement; custody & asset servicing; books & records / reconciliations; registered accounts & tax
  • Regulatory-literate (CIRO / provincial securities / CSA context). You design operable controls, and you are not the UDP or compliance sign-off owner
  • Builder: you've redesigned and shipped process + tooling changes that stuck, not only run BAU
  • Practical with automation and AI (workflow automation, rules engines, RPA, or AI-assisted ops). You know where AI helps and where controls must stay deterministic
  • Exceptional written communication: SOPs, RACI, decision logs, and requirements that cross-functional teams can ship against

Who you might be (Nice-to-haves):

  • Greenfield Canadian dealer / clearing / custody stand-up
  • API-first or broker-as-a-service / correspondent platforms
  • US and Canada dual-entity operations
  • Deep CDS / CDSX or Canadian market-infrastructure experience
  • Registered-account or Canadian tax-ops stand-up (TFSA, RRSP, RESP, tax lots, withholding, reporting)
  • AI-native ops workflow: recurring use of tools like Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, or custom agents for SOP drafting, exception synthesis, and prototyping

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

In addition, this position plays a key role in managing internal reporting, budgeting, and administrative processes to support strategic decision-making.

The role requires close coordination with Operations & Maintenance (O&M) teams, Engineering, and other internal departments or external vendors to resolve challenges and implement performance improvement initiatives. Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance urgent operational needs with long-term planning are essential for success in this position.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Act as the single point of accountability for the commercial operation and performance of assigned assets.
  • Prioritize daily activities to maximize revenue generation and financial performance of assigned solar and/or BESS assets.
  • Monitor day-to-day operations of assigned assets across multiple locations and ensure projects are operating at or above expected levels.
  • Lead resolution of asset-related outages utilizing internal and external resources effectively to minimize safety and financial impacts.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for O&M providers, landowners, and local utilities.
  • Oversee maintenance schedules, issue resolution, and warranty claims.
  • Track and assist with development of project budgets, operating expenses, and all existing project revenue streams.
  • Ensure compliance with PPAs, land leases, interconnection agreements, and other key contracts, as required.
  • Develop and deliver monthly and quarterly performance reports for stakeholders and investors, providing independent analysis and presenting actionable insights.
  • Ensure all projects meet local, state, and federal regulatory requirements.
  • Lead the onboarding process and maintain revenue maximization efforts for new projects transitioning from project delivery to asset management at the achievement of commercial operation.
  • Coordinate with development, construction, legal, and finance teams to ensure all project documentation, contracts, and data are transferred accurately at designated Stage/Gate milestones.
  • Ensure accurate setup of asset data in asset management platforms.
  • Collaborate with development, engineering, and operations teams to plan and execute the integration of BESS into existing solar or hybrid assets.
  • Collaborate with various teams to identify opportunities for asset optimization and risk mitigation.
  • Support senior management in development and implementation of strategic asset management plans to improve asset performance.

Qualifications:

  • 5–7 years of professional experience, with strong preference for background in Solar/BESS, financial analysis, project management, or related fields.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Science, Mathematics, or Finance preferred, but not required.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a proven ability to convey complex information clearly.
  • Results-driven professional with strong problem-solving skills, integrity, and a solid work ethic.
  • Proactive and adaptable, excelling in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
  • Agile in navigating organizational change while maintaining focus on priorities.
  • Proven collaborator, fostering effective partnerships with peers, leadership, and vendors.
  • Resourceful and persistent, consistently achieving objectives with professionalism.
  • Advanced skills in Microsoft Suite, proficiency in PowerPoint & Excel, MS Power Platform (Apps, Automation, and BI).
  • Preferred, prior working experience with GreenPowerMonitor, QuickBase, Softwrench/Maximo, or similar project management software.
  • Ability to travel up to 15%

Our interview process:

A typical interview process at Silicon Ranch might include the below stages. Please note that we may make changes to these steps as needed, and details will be provided to you early on in the process.

  1. Introductory Interview with our recruiter
  2. Hiring Manager Interview to dive into technical skills and behavioral questions
  3. Panel Interview to assess cross-functional skills and dive deeper into technical skills
  4. Executive Interview to answer high-level questions about SRC and the team

jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Benefits Operations Specialist to join our team. This a remote role based in Ireland, reporting to the Senior Manager, People Operations EMEA in the People & Culture department. As a Benefits Operations Specialist, you will be a subject matter expert in the day-to-day execution and administration of Zscaler’s EMEA benefit programs. You will serve as the backbone of the benefits function, ensuring that the employee life-cycle from onboarding to off-boarding is handled with precision, empathy, and compliance, focusing on high-touch administration of complex leave cases and the seamless delivery of our benefits concierge service.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Lead the end-to-end administration for new hire enrollments, leaver processing, and off-cycle qualifying life events while owning the monthly benefits-to-payroll data bridge

  • Manage the submission and tracking of insurance claims for disability and sick leave, conducting quarterly headcount audits to ensure 100% data integrity with all benefit providers

  • Serve as the senior point of escalation for complex employee inquiries, resolving issues within defined SLAs and educating staff on the most beneficial support options

  • Identify process ambiguities to document solutions in Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and manage the end-to-end invoice reconciliation process for all vendor billing

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

  • You are a problem-solver. You seek out challenges because you are energized by finding solutions, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback, knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrate a proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency.

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools

  • Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 4+ years of dedicated experience in HR Benefits administration, with an emphasis on benefits operations

  • Technical proficiency in HRIS (Workday preferred), payroll systems, and benefit vendor portals

  • Advanced Excel skills for data auditing, payroll reporting, and invoice reconciliation

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Direct experience working within a global, public SaaS or high-growth technology organization

  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently and make sound decisions with minimal guidance in a fast-paced environment

jobs.title: 数据开发工程师（实时计算方向）
jobs.excerpt: 【岗位定位】 1、公司已经建立较完善的数据仓库和实时数据体系，具备数据采集、计算、存储及服务能力。随着业务规模增长和实时应用场景增加，我们希望引入两名中高级数据开发工程师，负责实时数据需求交付、任务优化及工程治理。 2、该岗位以实时数据开发为主，同时参与离线数仓建设。你将重点解决实时链路中的数据延迟、状态膨胀、资源消耗、数据质量及一致性等问题，推动实时数据体系向更稳定、更高效、更规范的方向演进。 【岗位职责】 1、负责实时数据需求的分析、方案设计和开发交付，基于Flink、Kafka等技术建设实时数据处理链路，为实时分析、监控、指标及业务决策等场景提供数据支持。 2、参与实时数仓建设及模型设计，结合业务需求完成数据分层、指标口径、维度模型和数据服务的设计与落地。 3、持续优化现有实时任务，解决数据延迟、反压、Checkpoint异常、状态膨胀、资源利用率不合理及数据不一致等问题，提升任务稳定性和计算效率。 4、参与数据治理和工程质量建设，包括任务依赖梳理、元数据管理、数据质量监控、告警机制、开发规范及问题排查体系建设。 5、参与大数据平台及计算引擎的日常维护和问题处理，协同上下游团队保障数据链路的稳定性、准确性和时效性。 6、沉淀实时开发最佳实践和技术经验，通过技术分享、代码评审及方案评审，提升团队整体实时研发能力。 【任职要求】 1、本科及以上学历，计算机、软件工程、信息技术或相关专业，具有5年及以上数据开发或大数据研发经验；能力优秀者可适当放宽。 2、具备完整的数据仓库项目经验，熟悉实时数仓架构、数据分层和数据模型设计，能够将业务需求转化为数据模型及技术方案。 3、熟练掌握Flink，具有Flink SQL、DataStream API等实际项目经验，理解State、Checkpoint、Watermark、窗口、反压和容错机制。 4、具备实时任务开发及优化经验，能够独立分析和解决任务延迟、资源消耗较高、状态异常、数据倾斜及数据一致性等问题。 5、熟悉Kafka及实时数据链路，理解数据采集、传输、计算、存储和服务的完整流程。 6、熟悉Hadoop、Hive、Spark等大数据技术，具备一定的离线数据开发能力。 7、熟练掌握SQL，能够完成复杂数据加工和性能优化；至少熟悉Python、Java或Scala中的一种开发语言。 8、熟悉MySQL、PostgreSQL、Elasticsearch等常用数据库或存储系统。 9、具备良好的业务理解、沟通协作和书面表达能力，责任心强，能够主动推动问题解决和项目落地。 【加分项】 1、具有大规模Flink任务开发、性能调优或集群治理经验。 2、具有实时数仓架构优化、实时链路治理或技术升级经验。 3、熟悉Hologres、ClickHouse、Doris等实时OLAP技术。 4、具有实时指标、实时监控、实时风控、实时推荐等复杂业务场景经验。 【我们期待的候选人】 1、我们希望你不仅能够完成数据需求开发，也愿意深入理解实时计算机制，关注数据链路的稳定性、性能和工程质量。 2、面对复杂问题，你能够从数据、代码、任务配置和运行机制等多个角度定位原因，并将解决方案沉淀为可复用的规范、工具或最佳实践。

【岗位职责】

一、钱包账户体系

2.主导异构账户体系的融合与抽象，沉淀统一的账户模型与 Web3 ID 能力，支撑钱包及其他业务方的接入需求。

二、钱包核心服务

1.负责钱包核心后端服务的设计与开发，覆盖资产管理、代币列表、交易历史、上链广播、Gas 策略等关键链路。

2.负责大规模钱包数据（账户、资产、交易历史等亿级数据量）的存储设计、查询性能与版本兼容性。

3.负责钱包与中台基础能力（行情、Token、节点 RPC、资产）的集成与解耦，推动公共能力下沉、钱包业务上浮。

三、多链支持与上链

1.负责钱包多链支持的接入与维护，覆盖 EVM、Solana 及其他主流公链。

2.负责交易构造、签名、广播、状态追踪的完整链路，保障在网络拥堵、Nonce 冲突等场景下的稳定性。

【任职要求】

一、技术基础

1.5 年以上后端开发经验，3 年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine / Channel）、标准库及主流框架（Gin / Go-zero / Gorm）。

2.熟练掌握微服务架构与分布式系统设计（消息队列、分布式锁、熔断限流、幂等设计等）。

3.精通 SQL / NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理；具备亿级数据量场景下的存储设计与查询优化经验。

4.主导过中大型后端系统从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地，具备账户、订单、资产等核心域的建模经验。

5.至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理，熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。

6.熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Move / Sui 者优先。

7.熟悉交易构造、签名、广播、Nonce 管理、Gas 策略等链上交易全链路，具备主网钱包或交易系统的实战经验。

8.具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。

二、钱包专项

1.熟悉主流钱包账户体系，包括助记词 / 私钥 / 硬件钱包 / MPC / 托管钱包等的原理与差异，理解各类账户的安全模型与使用场景。

2.具备钱包后端的实际开发经验，主导或深度参与过账户系统、资产模块、交易历史等核心模块的设计与落地。

3.具备多账户体系融合、抽象与对外开放能力建设的经验，或对此方向有清晰的方法论。

三、AI 工程能力

1.日常使用 AI Coding Agent 开发，并有相应工程沉淀。

2.具备搭建 Agent Harness、编写 Skills / Prompts 的实践经验。

3.了解 MCP、Tool Use、RAG、Eval 等概念及其工程落地边界。

【加分项】

1.有 MPC / TSS 钱包后端的开发经验，或熟悉 Turnkey、Fireblocks、Privy 等托管钱包方案。

2.有 AA 智能合约钱包（EIP-4337 / EIP-7702、Safe、Biconomy 等）相关的开发经验。

3.有亿级数据量下的数据迁移、版本兼容、双写切换等实战经验。

4.有钱包安全相关经验（密钥管理、签名风控、欺诈检测等）。

5.有围绕 AI Coding 的内部工具、Skill 库、Agent 工作流等沉淀经验。

6.有开源社区贡献或技术博客输出。

Staff Platform Engineer

Location: This position can be located in the following area(s): remote in Canada

Company Overview

Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We design and ship AI co-workers that integrate into enterprise operations and deliver measurable results for our clients. We're all in on AWS, combining deep UX capability with senior engineering talent to get AI into production fast and keep it there.
We’ve earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators. Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Staff Platform Engineer to define and lead platform engineering strategy across complex, multi-environment cloud systems. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who can own infrastructure architecture end-to-end, drive DevSecOps and compliance practices, and serve as a technical leader on the engagements they support.

In this role, you will work as a key technical contributor on a cross-functional team, defining standards and owning platform reliability, performance, and security at scale. You’ll mentor engineers, partner with leadership on infrastructure direction, and lead complex migrations and modernization initiatives.

Why This Role Matters

At Robots & Pencils, we design AI systems for a human world. Our name says it all. Robots and pencils means engineering paired with creativity, because every agent we ship has to work for real people in real workflows. That balance is baked into how we operate.

Every role here contributes directly to that mission. Here, you shape how AI systems integrate into enterprise operations, how teams move at real velocity, and how products create measurable impact for clients and the people they serve. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days. That pace demands people who take ownership, lead with craft, and care deeply about what they put their name on.

What You’ll Do

Craft & Delivery

  • Define DevOps strategy and lead infrastructure architecture across multi-environment, multi-region cloud systems
  • Architect and own scalable Kubernetes platforms and containerized infrastructure at scale
  • Own infrastructure as code strategy and standards across environments
  • Lead DevSecOps implementation including secrets management, compliance, auditing, IAM, and zero-trust networking
  • Drive platform reliability, performance SLAs, and cost optimization across production systems
  • Lead complex cloud migrations and platform modernization initiatives
  • Own observability strategy and production reliability practices
  • Lead the design and operation of AI/ML platform infrastructure, including model serving and deployment, GPU workload orchestration, LLM gateway and observability, vector store infrastructure, and CI/CD for AI/ML systems
  • Bring an AI-forward mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude, Cursor, and other modern AI assistants to ship higher-quality work at pace

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner with engineering, product, and leadership to align platform strategy with business and delivery goals
  • Communicate complex infrastructure decisions and tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Lead design reviews, architecture discussions, and release readiness assessments

Leadership & Influence

  • Establish platform engineering standards and best practices on the engagements you support
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, helping them grow their craft, confidence, and impact
  • Act as a technical escalation point on complex infrastructure and platform challenges
  • Evaluate emerging tools and technologies, recommending patterns that improve platform reliability and developer experience

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years of professional DevOps or platform engineering experience, with experience leading complex platform initiatives
  • Expert scripting and programming skills (e.g., Python, Go, Java, Bash)
  • Deep cloud expertise across at least one major platform
  • Expert Kubernetes and container orchestration skills
  • Expert IaC skills across multiple tools
  • Strong CI/CD architecture experience at scale
  • Strong DevSecOps experience including secrets management, compliance, and auditing
  • Experience with networking, IAM, security architecture, and zero-trust principles in cloud environments
  • Experience with service mesh, distributed systems, and microservices architecture
  • Strong experience with AI/ML platform infrastructure, including model serving and deployment, GPU workload orchestration, LLM gateway and observability, vector store infrastructure, and CI/CD for AI/ML systems
  • Demonstrated leadership and technical mentoring experience across a team or organization
  • Strong stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to translate technical depth across audiences
  • Demonstrable, day-to-day usage and expert knowledge of AI-forward tools such as Claude and Cursor
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate highly ambiguous technical and business challenges with sound judgment
  • Cloud certifications (e.g., AWS DevOps Engineer Professional, CKA, Azure DevOps Engineer) or FinOps experience is a plus

Helpful Extras and Unique Skills

  • Designing and provision HPC cluster infrastructure using CI/CD pipeline across AWS, CoreWeave, GCP, and OCI

jobs.description:
Veda builds vault infrastructure for DeFi at scale. We manage $2B+ in total value locked across 15+ blockchain networks, powering yield strategies for partners including Kraken, Etherfi, and Plasma. Our protocol turns complex multi-chain DeFi positions into simple vault interfaces that institutional and retail users can actually trust.

We seek individuals with high agency to join us in defining the next phase of DeFi growth and adoption. The ideal candidate takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and adapts swiftly to evolving demands.

The Role

As an SVM Engineer, you will design, implement, and optimize smart contracts and DeFi protocols on the Solana Virtual Machine. With a special focus on vault architecture and security, you'll be responsible for creating robust financial applications that maintain the highest standards of security while delivering exceptional performance.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop smart contracts and DeFi protocols on the Solana Virtual Machine

  • Build and optimize secure vault systems for asset management and yield strategies

  • Collaborate with security teams to ensure protocols are protected against exploits

  • Integrate with existing DeFi protocols and establish cross-protocol compatibility

  • Optimize code for Solana's parallel execution environment

  • Conduct thorough testing and debugging of smart contracts

  • Research and implement innovative solutions to improve scalability and reduce transaction costs

  • Stay current with the latest developments in the Solana ecosystem and DeFi space

  • Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing

You have

  • Experience building, deploying, and maintaining SVM smart contracts in production

  • Strong programming experience in Rust

  • Deep understanding of Solana and low-level SVM concepts

  • Thorough understanding of the Solana Virtual Machine architecture and its constraints

  • Experience building DeFi protocols (lending, trading, yield farming, etc.)

  • Knowledge of cryptographic principles and blockchain security best practices

  • Familiarity with Solana Program Library (SPL) and ecosystem tools

  • Understanding of vault architectures in DeFi contexts

  • Experience with on-chain security patterns and common vulnerabilities

  • Solid grasp of financial concepts as they apply to decentralized finance

  • Problem-solving attitude and ability to work in a fast-paced environment

Even better if you have

  • Track record of creating audited and battle-tested smart contracts

  • Strong systems engineering fundamentals. You’ve built event-driven architectures, data pipelines, caching layers, and API services that handle high throughput.

  • You’ve seen production at scale. You’ve lived through systems that scaled past their original design. You know what breaks first, what compromises are temporary, and what shortcuts become permanent regret.

  • Previous experience building vault protocols on Solana or other blockchains

  • Contributions to open-source Solana projects

Competitive base salary plus equity. We’re a Series A company heading toward Series B — early enough that your equity is meaningful, late enough that the business is real.

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

jobs.description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Position Summary

Kaseya is looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner to lead executive searches across the company. You will own Director-level and above hiring for every part of the business: Go-to-Market (Sales, Marketing, Customer Success), Corporate Functions (Finance, Legal, HR, IT, Operations) and Product & Technology.

This is a full-cycle, high-visibility role. You will partner directly with senior leaders and the executive team, run searches from intake to signed offer, and represent Kaseya to the senior talent market. You will also help build and refine how Kaseya runs executive search, so every leadership hire follows a consistent, well-documented process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead full-cycle executive searches for Director, Senior Director, VP and C-suite roles across GTM, Corporate Functions and P&T, managing a concurrent portfolio of senior searches.
  • Run thorough intake sessions with hiring executives to define the role, success profile, leadership competencies, compensation range and target talent pools.
  • Build search strategies and market maps, including target companies, competitor org intelligence and passive-candidate pipelines.
  • Source and engage senior passive talent directly through networks, LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals and targeted outreach.
  • Assess candidates for leadership capability, functional depth, scale experience and culture fit, and present well-calibrated shortlists with clear written candidate summaries.
  • Design and coordinate structured executive interview processes, including panel planning, case presentations and interviewer prep.
  • Manage offers end to end: compensation benchmarking, offer strategy, negotiation, references and closing, in partnership with Total Rewards and HR Business Partners.
  • Keep all executive searches in Greenhouse as the system of record, including resumes, interviews, feedback and offers.
  • Select, manage and hold accountable external retained search firms when used, including contract terms, fee management and performance against timelines.
  • Report search status, pipeline health and market insights to hiring executives and TA leadership on a regular cadence.
  • Deliver an exceptional, confidential candidate experience that strengthens Kaseya's employer brand with senior talent.
  • Help build and continuously improve Kaseya's executive search playbook, templates and process documentation.
  • Handle confidential searches, including backfills and new leadership roles, with discretion.
  • Support broader TA initiatives as needed, such as succession-driven hiring, workforce planning and hiring manager enablement.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of full-cycle talent acquisition experience, including at least 4 years focused on Director-level and above or executive search.
  • Proven track record closing senior hires across multiple functions, ideally covering GTM, Corporate Functions and Product & Technology.
  • Experience in an in-house TA team at a high-growth technology or SaaS company, or at a retained executive search firm.
  • Strong direct sourcing skills, with demonstrated success engaging passive senior candidates.
  • Ability to assess leadership capability and functional expertise, and to give candid, evidence-based recommendations to senior executives.
  • Strong offer negotiation and closing skills, including complex executive compensation (base, bonus, equity, sign-on).
  • Executive presence and the confidence to advise, influence and push back with senior leaders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Sound judgment and discretion with highly confidential information.
  • Hands-on experience with an applicant tracking system (Greenhouse preferred) and LinkedIn Recruiter.
  • Highly organized, able to manage several concurrent senior searches with competing priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business or a related field.
  • Experience with IT, MSP, cybersecurity or B2B software organizations.
  • Global executive hiring experience, including North America, EMEA, LATAM or India.
  • Experience hiring in a PE-backed or acquisitive company.
  • Experience building or formalizing an executive search function, playbook or process.
  • Background managing retained search firm relationships and budgets.
  • Familiarity with leadership assessment tools and structured interviewing methods.
  • Experience with market mapping and talent intelligence tools.
  • An established network of senior leaders in technology GTM, finance or engineering.
