How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.description:
HSE Lead, Global Programs and Systems

About the Company

The mining industry has steadily become worse at finding new ore deposits, requiring >10X more capital to make discoveries compared to 30 years ago. The easy-to-find, near-surface deposits have largely been found, and the industry has chronically under-invested in new exploration technology, relying on antiquated manual mining techniques– even as demand accelerates for copper, lithium, and other metals to build electric vehicles, renewable energy, and data centers.

KoBold builds AI models for mineral exploration and deploys those models—alongside our novel sensors—to guide decisions on KoBold-owned-and-operated exploration programs. In the six years since founding, KoBold has become by far both the largest independent mineral exploration company and the largest exploration technology developer. Our data scientists and software engineers, who come from leading technology companies, jointly lead exploration programs with our renowned exploration geologists.

KoBold has proven its first discovery with materially less capital than the industry average and found one of the best copper deposits ever discovered: the copper is far more concentrated than the global average of copper mines, and this asset alone is expected to generate meaningful revenue for decades. KoBold has a portfolio of more than 60 other projects, each of which has the potential for another high-quality discovery.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and natural resources companies Equinor, BHP, and Mitsubishi.

About The Position:

KoBold operates exploration programs across Africa, North America, Europe, and Australia, and is scaling faster than any independent explorer in the industry. As HSE Lead, Programs and Systems, you will design and own the HSE management system, digital tooling, and training infrastructure that keep people safe across every jurisdiction we operate in.

You will build the systems, standards, and software that empower safety ownership at the field level. If you have ever wished you could tear up your company's HSE stack and rebuild it with modern tools, an AI native workflow, adequate resourcing, and strong executive support to do it right, this role is that opportunity.

Additional responsibilities will include:

  • Own the KoBold HSE Management System end to end, including architecture, document hierarchy, review frequency, and continuous improvement aligned to ISO 45001.
  • Own KoBold's digital HSE stack, including DATS, Forwood, and any additional platforms. Lead vendor evaluation, workflow configuration, integrations, and administration.
  • Design HSE analytics that field teams actually use, including leading and lagging indicators, real time dashboards, and communications that surface risk before it becomes an incident.
  • Own KoBold's AI in HSE strategy. Identify high leverage applications that optimize or replace existing software tools, facilitate risk assessment, critical risk verification, observations and inspections, etc.
  • Own the global document library for all HSE standards, programs, and operating procedures.
  • Own the global training strategy and the Learning Management System, including role based curriculum, certification tracking, compliance reporting, competency verification, and content building.
  • Design cultural initiatives that engage field crews and contractors, not just corporate, including recognition, campaigns, safety moments, and leading indicator storytelling.
  • Partner with regional HSE Managers and Field Operations leaders. You provide the platform, standards, data, and analytics; they deliver in the field.
  • Directly support HSE for field campaigns, requiring intermittent travel to field projects across the globe.

What You Will Bring (Must Have)

  • Five or more years in HSE with meaningful time owning or administering enterprise HSE software (DATS, Intelex, Cority, Enablon, Sphera, VelocityEHS, or comparable).
  • Demonstrated experience building or materially improving an HSE management system aligned to ISO 45001, ANSI Z10, or an equivalent framework.
  • Track record designing HSE training programs and administering a Learning Management System.
  • Comfort working across multiple jurisdictions and regulatory regimes.
  • Strong written communication. This role produces the standards other people follow.
  • Ability to lead through influence, driving change across regional operations, field teams, and executive stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Proficiency with document control platforms and modern collaboration stacks such as SharePoint, Confluence, and Google Workspace.
  • Ability to travel to remote exploration sites and pass site specific medical fitness screening when required.

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Experience in mining, exploration, oil and gas, construction, or another high risk industry.
  • ISO 45001 Lead Auditor, CSP, CIH, ASP, or NEBOSH Diploma.
  • Experience using AI or LLM tooling to build HSE workflows (document search, incident triage, content generation).
  • BI and analytics experience with leading and lagging indicators (Power BI, Tableau, or SQL).
  • Multi country experience, especially in Africa or emerging markets.
  • Prior experience transitioning off a third party HSE provider to in house capability.
  • Familiarity with low code or scripting tools (Retool, Airtable, Python) for building lightweight HSE tools.

Compensation and Benefits

Base salary range: $125,000 to $170,000 USD, depending on experience and location. Total compensation also includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package covering health, dental, vision, retirement, paid time off, parental leave, and a home office stipend.

Location, Travel

Remote, based in North America. Expect roughly 10 to 15 percent travel to KoBold sites globally, weighted toward the first 12 months as you establish standards and build relationships.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States or Canada.

How to Apply

The Role

Digible is looking for an Account Executive, Digital Marketing, to join our team!

The Account Executive is a senior revenue-generating role focused on building qualified pipeline through proactive outbound prospecting. This individual brings deep expertise in digital marketing and is responsible for identifying, engaging, and converting net-new prospects into meaningful revenue opportunities. Success in this role requires strategic outreach, consultative discovery, and disciplined follow-through within the multi-family industry.

This position does not work inbound leads. Success is driven by the ability to create momentum from zero; opening doors, building relevance with target accounts, and advancing outbound-sourced opportunities through proposal development and close partnership with Growth Leadership.

This role is critical to Digible’s outbound growth engine and expansion into new ownership groups, operators, and emerging markets. Outbound growth requires focus, resilience, and ownership. This role ensures Digible continues to expand beyond inbound demand by consistently opening new conversations and creating net-new pipeline with the right accounts.

This is a senior outbound hunter role. Candidates seeking inbound-heavy, account management, or support-based sales roles will not be a fit.

You’ll Love This Job If You:

  • You’re a digital marketing expert who understands performance strategy, paid media, and growth channels, and can speak confidently about them with senior stakeholders
  • You want a true hunter role focused on net-new pipeline creation
  • You enjoy prospecting, opening doors, and creating opportunity through outbound effort

  • You’re comfortable initiating conversations with senior stakeholders

  • You have experience in the multifamily or real estate space, or are excited to apply your expertise in that industry

What you’ll do:

Outbound Pipeline Creation (Primary Focus)

  • Generate qualified pipeline exclusively through outbound prospecting and account engagement
  • Leverage your digital marketing expertise to create relevant, insight-driven outreach
  • Identify, research, and prioritize target accounts aligned to Digible’s ICP
  • Prospect into ownership groups, operators, and decision-makers through email, LinkedIn, calls, and tailored outreach
  • Create relevance through strong account research, timing signals, and buyer-specific messaging
  • Convert outbound activity into discovery meetings and sales-qualified opportunities

Discovery & Opportunity Development

  • Lead strategic discovery conversations focused on business outcomes and growth challenges
  • Qualify opportunities based on fit, urgency, need, and buying intent
  • Advance outbound-sourced opportunities through proposal development and close in partnership with Growth Leadership
  • Maintain clear momentum, next steps, and stakeholder alignment throughout the sales process

Outbound Strategy & Optimization

  • Apply your marketing expertise to continuously test and refine outbound messaging, targeting, and sequences to improve response and meeting rates
  • Share outbound learnings and patterns to strengthen team playbooks and effectiveness
  • Partner with Marketing on outbound narratives, positioning, and account-level entry points

Pipeline Management & Forecasting

  • Maintain accurate opportunity stages, notes, and activity tracking in CRM
  • Forecast outbound pipeline with clarity and discipline
  • Identify bottlenecks in the outbound motion and recommend improvements to conversion and velocity

How will success be measured:

  • Outbound-sourced qualified pipeline generated
  • Meetings booked from outbound outreach
  • Conversion from meeting → opportunity → close
  • Deal velocity and progression of outbound opportunities
  • Forecast accuracy and CRM discipline
  • Revenue contribution driven by outbound-sourced pipeline

This role is not responsible for:

  • Working inbound leads or marketing-generated pipeline
  • Managing campaign execution or marketing operations
  • Owning HubSpot workflows, automations, or sales systems administration
  • Supporting opportunities sourced and owned by other roles

This role exists to create new opportunities through outbound focus and execution.

What You Should Have:

  • Deep expertise in digital marketing
  • 4–6+ years of experience in outbound sales, new business development, or growth-focused revenue roles
  • Proven ability to generate pipeline through outbound prospecting, not just convert warm leads
  • Strong discovery, communication, and objection-handling skills
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment with clear revenue accountability
  • Experience selling B2B services or agency offerings preferred

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times

This role is open to candidates located within the United States.

While this job description outlines the core expectations of the role, it’s not a full list of everything you’ll do at Digible. We believe in leaning in by hitting your key goals, sharing insights, and finding new ways to elevate performance, process, and client success.

Compensation:

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Software Engineer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Senior Software Engineer with Sezzle, you will work with a highly-motivated team to tackle interesting and challenging problems across multiple areas of the organization. Your experience and guidance will help other members of the team level-up their own skills as well.

In this backend focused role, you will work closely with stakeholders from Product, Support and the business. You’ll also partner with other engineering teams to provide high-quality, scalable, and innovative solutions to internal and customer problems. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include designing, developing, and delivering new features, as well as unblocking and mentoring your teammates.

This role has both an internal and external focus, your contributions will make a meaningful difference in the day-to-day lives of your peers at Sezzle, enhancing their ability to support our business and customers, and you will have opportunities to take any feedback and iterate.

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

  • Application submitted (you are here)
  • Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
  • Interview with recruiters (30 min)
  • Coding assessment (~1.5 hours)

  • Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
  • Offer!

  • Coordinate with internal company stakeholders to design market winning products

  • As needed, lead small development teams to bring a project to market
  • Mentor other engineering teammates to help elevate their experience and knowledge

  • At least 7 years of full-stack software engineering experience
  • Experience bringing new ideas and building consensus on the path forward
  • Experience with building and serving REST APIs using Go (preferably) and Java Python or a similar language.
  • Experience working in a distributed, cloud-based architecture, with either design patterns like transactional outboxes, or queuing tools like RabbitMQ, SQS, Kafka
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience with SQL based RDMS through an ORM tool
  • Comfortable using observability platforms like Prometheus, or vendor solutions like NewRelic or Datadog to instrument your code for production monitoring and alerting.
  • DevOps experience with CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with containerized micro-service architecture deployed with Kubernetes on AWS
  • Demonstrated history of delivering commercial APIs and web applications
  • A clear record of getting products to market and prioritizing solutions and improvements based on stakeholder/customer feedback.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. You’ll supervise and mentor advanced practice providers (APPs) to ensure excellent, ethical, and measurement-based care across the team.

What makes this role unique? The Supervising Psychiatrist will treat patients and supervise and support advanced practice providers, such as nurse practitioners (NPs) or physician assistants (PAs), including reviewing their cases and treatment plans, assisting them in handling complex or crisis situations and ensuring clinical quality and adherence to best practices.

Clinical Care

  • Provide psychiatric evaluations, diagnoses, and treatment for individuals with mild to moderate conditions, including depression, anxiety, PTSD, and mood disorders.
  • Prescribe medications responsibly, ethically, and in alignment with measurement-based care.
  • Conduct follow-up assessments, manage medications, and offer psychotherapy when clinically appropriate to optimize patient outcomes.

Supervision & Mentorship

  • Supervise and mentor APPs (NPs, PAs, APRNs), ensuring adherence to clinical protocols and best practices.
  • Review documentation and treatment plans to ensure quality and adherence to compliance standards.
  • Support APPs in managing clinical crises in line with guidelines.

Process Development

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and improve tools, workflows, and care models that elevate psychiatric care.
  • Help define and implement treatment guidelines and protocols that exceed industry standards.

Patient Support & Education

  • Provide psychoeducation and psychotherapy as appropriate to support medication adherence and engagement.
  • Partner with patients to set goals that enhance their mental health and quality of life.

Team Collaboration

  • Work alongside therapists, care coordinators, and other clinicians in a collaborative, interdisciplinary care model.
  • Contribute to case reviews, clinical discussions, and organizational planning.
  • Partner with clinical leadership to refine operational workflows and clinical decision-making support systems.

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

  • Deliver outstanding psychiatric care, including psychotherapy, when clinically indicated.
  • Actively contribute to team meetings, case consultations, and the development of innovative care models.

We’re looking for someone who is/possesses:

  • Board-certified psychiatrist (MD or DO)
  • An active and unrestricted medical license to practice psychiatry in a state served by Two Chairs, or eligibility for expedited licensure through the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact (IMLC)

  • Preferred: additional state licensure or willingness to obtain additional state licenses

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated best-in-class Senior Site Reliability Engineer. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Senior SRE with Sezzle, you will have a high degree of autonomy and authority to identify and resolve problems you see in our infrastructure, deployments, operational workload, and overall systems.

You should consider yourself a DOer to be a good fit for this role. We expect you to bring a deep well of experience to play, and with AI tooling, you should be a force for scaling in the organization.

What You'll do:

  • Architect, upgrade, design, and build scalable infrastructure solutions leveraging Kubernetes, AWS, RDS (MySQL/Postgres), and modern distributed patterns.

  • Define, maintain and enforce SLAs and alerts across our infrastructure.

  • 12+ years of professional software engineering or infrastructure engineering experience, including significant SRE and backend experience.
  • Deployed significant changes to a production application or infrastructure configuration in the past 30 days.
  • Strong proficiency in Golang, with experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs.
  • Expertise with SQL-based RDBMS (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and experience optimizing schema and queries for performance at scale.
  • Proficiency in observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic).
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems design patterns (e.g., transactional outbox, event-driven architecture and stream processing, queues).
  • Demonstrated ability to bring new ideas forward, influence decisions, and lead complex technical initiatives.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience with AWS cloud infrastructure, mainly AWS Aurora RDS, both MySQL and Postgres.
  • Experience with data engineering, data pipelines and data warehousing.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deploying containerized microservices in Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with AI developer tooling like Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, Cursor and using it to be a more productive engineer.
  • Track record of shipping commercial APIs and data-driven applications in high-growth environments.
  • Proven leadership in guiding technical direction, improving system reliability, and scaling high-traffic services.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
  • Open Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

jobs.description:
POSITION:

The state of Indiana Clinical Provider (NP/IBCLC or PA/IBCLC) is responsible for ensuring direct patient care is evidence-based and aligns with SimpliFed's maternal health program requirements. Provider will conduct lactation-related clinical assessments, oversee remote patient monitoring, administer CPOE orders within scope of practice, and screen for maternal mental health.

ROLE:

The role of the Clinical Provider (NP/IBCLC) is expected to uphold the highest standards of care for the company and its patients. Providers will be required to engage in telehealth, virtual video, face-to-face appointments with patients to provide care and assist patients with their personal goals and those goals prescribed by their health care team(s). Providers are responsible for all clinical decision-making in alignment with SimpliFed's clinical protocols associated with the provision of Professional Services.

VENUE:

This role works full time remotely using SimpliFed approved devices.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The role of the SimpliFed Clinical Provider (NP/IBCLC) will conduct professional services consultations with patients via telehealth. Providers, based on their respective professional fields, will assess patients and provide education on topics such as lactation, infant feeding, hypertension, gestational diabetes, anemia, thyroid levels, and maternal mental health to name a few. Providers will document their findings in the exam form, provide proper resources to patients, and schedule patient follow up appointments, based upon need. Providers will make all necessary referrals to outside and referring providers based upon the need of the patient.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Master’s or Doctoral degree in respective clinical field (Nurse Practitioner)
  • Professional licensure in respective clinical field (Nurse Practitioner), in good standing with the governing board.
  • Professional certification as an International Board Certified Lactation Consultant (IBCLC) or Certified Lactation Counselor (CLC), in good standing with the governing board.
  • 3 years of direct clinical experience in hospital, clinic, or other healthcare setting with a minimum of 2 years experience as a CLC/IBCLC.
  • Active MMIS (State Medicaid) Credentials Preferred.
  • Interest in maternal health and improving outcomes.
  • Provide education and clinical support services to empower families to make informed decisions around baby feeding and infant care.
  • Ability to work independently and make sound decisions aligned with SimpliFed’s policies.
  • Strong active listening skills and sound judgment.
  • Demonstrated written and oral communication skills, as well as strong charting skills.
  • Knowledge of clinical workflows, healthcare quality and compliance standards, EHR data management, clinical documentation, HIPAA, and related regulations.
  • Ability to accept constructive feedback and make improvements to better serve SimpliFed patients, partners, and mission.

POSITION SPECIFICS:

  • SimpliFed providers will see patients for a variety of matters in the maternal health and perinatal space. Services provided may include, but not limited to:
    • Lactation and Infant Feeding Services provided by IBCLC and CLC credentialed professionals.
    • Remote Patient Monitoring for Blood Pressure and Gestational Diabetes Nurse Practitioner, Physician Assistant, and Registered Nurse credentialed professionals.
    • Perinatal Mental Health provided by all SimpliFed providers and Credentialed Perinatal Mental Health Counselors (PMHC)
    • Other issues in the maternal vacuum of care such as, but not limited to, nutrition, anemia, thyroid issues.
  • SimpliFed Providers will communicate with patients via the company's electronic medical record system and virtual video platform.
  • SimpliFed Provider communications should focus on clinical relevance and empower patient health literacy and evidence-based decisions.
  • Review of patient’s intake forms, complete a history and virtual physical evaluation of the pregnant or postpartum patient.
  • Conduct Perinatal Mental Health Assessment using standardized assessment instruments and tools provided in the Exam Forms as well as general observation of a patient's current mental state.
  • Provide education on topic(s) associated with the appointment type.
  • Obtain relevant patient medical history using the intake form or other forms as defined by SimpliFed.
  • Complete Exam Forms in full, including, but not limited to, a record of the start and end times of the visit as well as relevant medical history, intake, baby wellness, diagnosis and procedure codes for the visit, by checking the appropriate boxes on the exam form
  • Complete Documentation of all events, observations, evaluations, assessments, and instructions relevant to the visit, the same day as the completed appointment.
  • Develop an individual Care Plan for each patient which includes written instructions, resources, and a plan for follow up.
  • Complete Referrals/Coordination of Care (if necessary) and send to the proper entity.
  • Scheduling subsequent appointments with patients prior to completing the current appointment.

GENERAL EXPECTATIONS:

About the company

At Covera Health, we're on a mission to improve healthcare by making every diagnosis more accurate.

Every year, millions of patients receive imaging that shapes life changing medical decisions. Yet too often, important findings are missed, patients struggle to access high quality imaging, and the healthcare system treats radiology like a commodity instead of one of the most critical moments in a patient's care journey.

We're changing that.

Covera combines clinical expertise, advanced AI, and one of the industry's largest radiology quality datasets to help detect disease earlier, improve diagnostic accuracy, and give clinicians greater confidence in every decision they make. Better diagnoses lead to better treatment, fewer unnecessary procedures, lower healthcare costs, and, most importantly, better outcomes for patients.

In 2026, Covera and Medmo came together to create the first platform designed to support the entire radiology journey. From helping patients find and schedule high quality imaging, to coordinating care, to ensuring the accuracy of every diagnosis, we're building a connected experience that simply hasn't existed before.

Backed by Insight Partners, our platform supports nearly 6 million people across Fortune 10 and Fortune 100 employers, three of the five largest national health plans, and thousands of value based primary care physicians.

This is an exciting moment to join Covera. We're building technology that is helping detect serious conditions earlier, improving the quality of care for millions of patients, and redefining what healthcare can be. If you're excited by meaningful work, ambitious teammates, and the opportunity to help save lives through better healthcare, we'd love to meet you.

About the role

As Senior Vice President of Engineering, you will lead Covera Health's Engineering and Platform/IT organizations, with direct ownership of our technology architecture, engineering standards, and technical execution. You will lead a technology organization of approximately 30 people, including Engineering and AI, and play an active role in the technical decisions that shape our products and platforms.

jobs.excerpt: **This position requires Afternoon and EVENING hours between 1pm-10pm EST.
jobs.description:
**This position requires Afternoon and EVENING hours between 1pm-10pm EST.**

POSITION:

The Clinical Provider (IBCLC) is responsible for providing direct lactation consultation services via secure virtual platforms to prenatal and postpartum women in accordance with SimpliFed's evidence-based maternal health program guidelines.

ROLE:

The role of the Clinical Provider (IBCLC) is expected to uphold the highest standards of care for the company and its patients. Providers will be required to engage in telehealth, virtual video, face-to-face appointments with patients to provide care and assist patients with their personal goals and those goals prescribed by their health care team(s). Providers are responsible for all clinical decision-making in alignment with SimpliFed's clinical protocols associated with the provision of Professional Services.

VENUE:

This role works remotely using SimpliFed approved devices.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The role of the SimpliFed Clinical Provider (IBCLC) will conduct professional services consultations with patients via telehealth. Providers, based on their respective professional fields, will assess patients and provide education on topics such as lactation, infant feeding, and maternal mental health to name a few. Providers will document their findings in the exam form, provide proper resources to patients, and schedule patient follow up appointments, based upon need. Providers will make all necessary referrals to outside and referring providers based upon the need of the patient.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • High School Diploma. Bachelor’s degree or Associate’s Degree preferred.
  • Professional certification as an International Board Certified Lactation Consultant (IBCLC), in good standing with the governing board.
  • 3 years of direct clinical experience in hospital, clinic, or other healthcare setting with a minimum of 2 years experience as a CLC/IBCLC.
  • Active MMIS (State Medicaid) Credentials Preferred.
  • Interest in maternal health and improving outcomes.
  • Provide education and clinical support services to empower families to make informed decisions around baby feeding and infant care.
  • Ability to work independently and make sound decisions aligned with SimpliFed’s policies.
  • Strong active listening skills and sound judgment.
  • Demonstrated written and oral communication skills, as well as strong charting skills.
  • Knowledge of clinical workflows, healthcare quality and compliance standards, EHR data management, clinical documentation, HIPAA, and related regulations.
  • Ability to accept constructive feedback and make improvements to better serve SimpliFed patients, partners, and mission.

POSITION SPECIFICS:

  • SimpliFed providers will see patients for a variety of matters in the maternal health and perinatal space. Services provided may include, but not limited to:
    • Lactation and Infant Feeding Services provided by IBCLC and CLC credentialed professionals.
    • Perinatal Mental Health provided by all SimpliFed providers and Credentialed Perinatal Mental Health Counselors (PMHC)
    • Other issues in the maternal vacuum of care such as, but not limited to, nutrition, anemia, thyroid issues.
  • SimpliFed Providers will communicate with patients via the company's electronic medical record system and virtual video platform.
  • SimpliFed Provider communications should focus on clinical relevance and empower patient health literacy and evidence-based decisions.
  • Review of patient’s intake forms, complete a history and virtual physical evaluation of the pregnant or postpartum patient.
  • Conduct Perinatal Mental Health Assessment using standardized assessment instruments and tools provided in the Exam Forms as well as general observation of a patient's current mental state.
  • Provide education on topic(s) associated with the appointment type.
  • Obtain relevant patient medical history using the intake form or other forms as defined by SimpliFed.
  • Complete Exam Forms in full, including, but not limited to, appointment duration, relevant medical history, baby wellness, diagnosis, and care plan.
  • Complete Documentation of all events, observations, evaluations, assessments, and instructions relevant to the visit, the same day as the completed appointment.
  • Develop an individual Care Plan for each patient which includes written instructions, resources, and a plan for follow up.
  • Complete Referrals/Coordination of Care (if necessary) and send to the proper entity.
  • Scheduling subsequent appointments with patients prior to completing the current appointment.

GENERAL EXPECTATIONS:

  • Be committed to the mission of the SimpliFed.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills to include working with fellow SimpliFed leadership and employees, external medical professionals, and patients. Social perceptiveness necessary.
  • Work within the scope of practice and remain compliant with the execution of clinical protocols, licensure, and credentialing.
  • Ability to work with minimal supervision and maintain a high degree of communication of current work activity with supervisors.
  • Behave in a professional manner and consistently demonstrate and promote the values of respect, honesty, and dignity for the patient, providers, and all members of the healthcare team.
  • Committed to the constant pursuit of excellence and teamwork in improving maternal health by leading with empathy and compassion.
  • Successfully complete background check.
  • Maintain compliance with SimpliFed’s policies and prevailing Federal security and privacy regulations.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

Work is performed virtually. Comfortable working with remote productivity communication tools is required.

jobs.description:
About the Organization
EnGen offers an at-scale, AI-powered approach to English instruction, designed to solve a systemic access issue: Adult English learners now represent 1 in 10 working-age adults in the U.S., yet the workforce system serves the needs of just 4% of these workers.
A Certified B Corporation, EnGen is filling the gap by partnering with employers, adult educators, workforce development organizations, and state governments to connect job seekers and incumbent workers with English skills, career pathways, and employment in high-demand industries. EnGen's workforce-aligned approach addresses employers' recruitment and retention challenges and advances learners' economic mobility.
Position Overview
We're looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer to help build the technology that empowers adult English learners to achieve their career goals. You'll develop and enhance our AI-powered learning platform using TypeScript/React on the frontend and Python/FastAPI on the backend.
We expect our engineers to be fluent in AI-assisted development — using tools like Cursor and Claude Code to write, review, and ship code faster and at higher quality. You should be comfortable directing AI to generate code, critically evaluating what it produces, and knowing when to write it yourself.

Full-Stack Development

  • Deliver production software across our TypeScript/React frontend and Python/FastAPI backend — whether writing code directly or steering AI tools to generate it
  • Build responsive web applications for diverse learners across desktop and mobile
  • Design and implement scalable APIs to support our learning platform
  • Develop real-time features for interactive lessons, conversation practice, and learner-coach communication

AI/LLM Integration

  • Integrate Large Language Models for content classification, skill assessment, learner feedback, and personalization
  • Build information extraction systems to analyze learner responses
  • Implement AI-powered features for conversation practice and multilingual support

Development Excellence

  • Write clean, well-tested code — and apply the same rigor when reviewing AI-generated output
  • Actively use and refine AI-assisted development workflows to improve your own productivity
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and education specialists
  • Contribute to A/B testing frameworks and learning experience optimization

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional full-stack web development experience
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript, React, Python, and FastAPI
  • Experience integrating with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) for classification, extraction, or personalization
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) — and genuine comfort using them as part of your daily workflow
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and API design
  • Strong passion for EnGen's mission to help immigrants and refugees remove English as a barrier to career advancement
  • Self-directed and able to work independently in a remote environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building edtech or language learning platforms
  • Knowledge of NLP and educational AI applications
  • Familiarity with WCAG accessibility standards
  • Experience with Railway, Cloudflare, or similar cloud infrastructure
  • Multilingual capabilities, particularly Spanish

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and equity
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Flexible PTO and fully remote environment
  • Professional development budget
  • Mission-driven work with measurable real-world impact
Ready to use technology to break down language barriers and create economic opportunities? Join us in building the future of workforce English instruction.

jobs.excerpt: About Happy HealthHappy Health is revolutionizing sleep medicine delivery through our comprehensive telehealth platform.
jobs.description:
About Happy Health

Happy Health is revolutionizing sleep medicine delivery through our comprehensive telehealth platform. We've eliminated the traditional barriers to sleep care – no more waiting months for appointments or spending uncomfortable nights in sleep labs. Our patients receive FDA-cleared home sleep testing via Happy Ring, connect with board-certified sleep specialists, and when required, begin evidence-based treatment within just 5 days. Ongoing physiological data monitoring with the Happy Ring enables real-time condition management, combination therapies, and drives measurable outcomes.

Happy Ring represents the future of sleep diagnostics: an FDA-cleared medical device integrating advanced biometric sensors with AI-powered analysis to deliver highly accurate diagnostics and longitudinal management at home. For sleep medicine physicians, this means you'll have access to high-quality diagnostic data that empowers you to make confident clinical decisions for your patients, and integrate multimodal treatments that focus on root-cause solutions.

Overview

This position on the software team has direct ownership of and responsibility for the architecture, scalability, reliability, security, and long-term evolution of our backend infrastructure.

As part of the software team behind the Happy Health product, you will help ensure that the integrated services and systems instrumental to the customer-facing experience (e.g. CRM, EHR, eComm, 3PL, etc.) are designed and operated to scale reliably. You will also help lead the design and implementation of internal tools used by technical and non-technical leaders and teams across the company. In addition to a primary role in hands-on engineering, this role will provide technical leadership across backend architecture, integration strategy, engineering standards, and platform decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and evolve a serverless backend stack in AWS, primarily utilizing Python 3.10+, Lambda, CDK, DynamoDB, Cloudfront, SNS, SQS, S3, and other related services to support customer-facing applications and internal operational workflows.

  • Lead the design, implementation, and integration of our REST API, event processors, services, and underlying datastores that deliver meaningful data to and from customers resulting from their use of the Happy Ring.

  • Establish and guide backend engineering best practices across system design, observability, reliability, performance, maintainability, and security.

  • Provide technical leadership to other team members, contractors, and partners building on these systems.

  • Drive architectural decisions and cross-functional technical alignment across software, mobile, web, eCommerce, operations, and partner-facing systems.

  • Help ensure regulatory compliance and best practices are maintained across these systems and the mechanisms used to access them, including M2M authentication, authorization, and login workflows.

  • Identify technical risks, scalability bottlenecks, and platform gaps early, and proactively drive solutions that support near-term commercial growth and long-term platform needs.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in backend software development
  • 5+ years of experience in Python
  • 5+ years of experience building and operating production systems in AWS
  • Demonstrated experience designing scalable APIs, cloud infrastructure, and continuous integration workflows.
  • Strong experience making technical tradeoffs across performance, reliability, security, and speed of execution

  • Proven ability to lead technical design and influence engineering direction across multiple systems or teams

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience working in the healthcare technology industry

  • Experience working in regulated environments involving security, privacy, and compliance requirements

  • Experience with serverless architecture at scale.

  • Experience with GraphQL, OpenAPI, and client SDK generation tools.

  • Experience integrating EHR, CRM, eCommerce, and logistics/3PL platforms.

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and serving as a technical lead without direct people management responsibility

Collaboration

    You will directly collaborate with many members across the team and are expected to serve as a senior technical leader across backend systems and integrations.

    eCommerce: As one of the primary consumers and users of our APIs, you will work directly and regularly with technical and non-technical members of the eCommerce team to ensure that purchasing, 3PL, CRM, and EHR systems and workflows around the Happy Ring product are integrated seamlessly and designed to scale.

    Mobile: You will collaborate with the mobile engineering team to ensure the APIs used by our mobile apps and SDKs are properly designed, implemented, and maintained to meet the needs of mobile users.

    Partners: You will work with technical members of partner teams to understand, design, and develop APIs and integrations they can use to gather and interact with data generated through their use of the Happy Ring.

We are pioneering a transformational approach to treating cancer by harnessing the ability of the human immune system to recognize and attack diverse cancer cells in each patient. We are committed to continuous innovation in cell therapy, including gene-edited cell therapy, which may be a promising option for patients with cancer.

Overview

The Manager, Investor Relations and Corporate Communications, will help drive high-impact communications across investors, media, employees, and other key stakeholders. Reporting to the Senior Director, Corporate Communications, and partnering closely with the Investor Relations and Corporate Communications team, this role will turn company strategy, milestones, and data into clear, compelling communications that support investor engagement, corporate visibility, and internal alignment.

This is a hands-on, execution-oriented role for a strong communicator who thrives in a fast-moving public company environment. jobs.title: Solutions Consultant
jobs.excerpt: Canvas Medical is accelerating everyday medicine with an EMR platform built for healthcare automation.
jobs.description:
Canvas Medical is accelerating everyday medicine with an EMR platform built for healthcare automation. We create modern, elegant front- and back-end tooling to enable new ways for developers and clinicians to integrate data, automate workflows, and collaborate to solve healthcare's toughest challenges. In doing so we advance our mission to give care teams superpowers with software.
Canvas is institutionally backed by some of the greatest technology investors in the world (funded notable health tech companies such as GoodRx, Oscar Health, and Hims & Hers Health).
Role Description
We're hiring a Solutions Consultant to join our GTM Operations team and bridge the gap between customer needs and platform capabilities. This role sits at the intersection of customer empathy, product strategy, and technical execution—helping providers and care teams unlock real value from Canvas Medical's EMR by transforming their workflows into actionable, high-quality solutions.
As a Solutions Consultant, you'll engage directly with customers, prospects, and internal stakeholders to understand complex healthcare delivery challenges. You'll translate these insights into clear product requirements, prototype solutions using the Canvas SDK, and help evolve our platform by identifying strategic enhancement opportunities. This is a high-leverage role where you'll act as a multiplier—accelerating how Canvas delivers value to customers while shaping how our platform scales.
The ideal candidate brings deep curiosity about healthcare technology, comfort with modern development tools, and exceptional ability to bridge business and technical contexts. You'll thrive in ambiguity, balance short-term customer needs with long-term platform health, and collaborate seamlessly across operational and technical teams. We're looking for someone with a growth mindset who can rapidly iterate, experiment with new approaches, and build from the ground up with agility.

Responsibilities

  • Customer Discovery & Solution Design
  • Engage directly with customers, prospects, and internal partners to understand clinical workflows, pain points, and desired outcomes
  • Translate healthcare delivery insights into clear, structured Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) that drive solution design
  • Balance immediate customer needs with long-term platform evolution to create sustainable, scalable solutions
  • Document learnings and contribute to internal knowledge-sharing to elevate team effectiveness
  • Technical Prototyping & Platform Development
  • Build and validate solutions using the Canvas SDK, demonstrating fluency in event-driven design, handlers, and effects
  • Partner with engineers to prototype elegant solutions that showcase platform capabilities
  • Strategically evaluate when to deliver within existing SDK capabilities versus advocating for platform enhancements
  • Create and maintain reusable solution patterns and playbooks that accelerate future engagements
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Delivery
  • Collaborate across sales, customer success, implementation, engineering, and product teams to align on delivery and feedback loops
  • Bridge operational and technical contexts to move solutions forward effectively
  • Surface and track quality signals (demo-to-production flow, SDK adoption, customer feedback) to inform iteration
  • Shadow senior team members while progressively owning lower-complexity engagements independently

Qualifications

  • Required Experience & Background
  • Recent graduate or early-career candidate in Computer Science, Health Informatics, Engineering, UX, Applied Data, or related discipline
  • Deep interest in healthcare technology and EMR systems with desire to improve provider and patient workflows
  • Demonstrated ability to learn quickly and adapt in ambiguous environments
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with ability to distill complex contexts into crisp requirements
  • Technical Skills & Capabilities
  • Comfort learning and working with modern SDKs, APIs, and plugin-based architectures
  • Willingness to ramp into concepts like event-driven design, handlers, and effects
  • Strategic mindset to balance short-term deliverables with long-term platform health
  • Ability to identify leverage points and scalable solution patterns
  • Healthcare & Domain Expertise
  • Understanding of healthcare delivery challenges and provider workflow pain points
  • Interest in healthcare automation and improving clinical operations through software
  • Ability to engage with clinical, operational, and financial stakeholders
  • Personal Attributes
  • Collaborative by default—thrives working across operations and technical teams
  • Growth mindset with rapid learning velocity
  • Productive tension management—comfortable wrestling with trade-offs
  • AI-native and pragmatic—uses modern tooling to accelerate discovery while respecting real-world constraints
  • Nice-to-Have Qualifications
  • Exposure to building or working with SDKs, frontend/backend integrations, or plugin architectures
  • Familiarity with healthcare data workflows, standards, or provider-facing tooling
  • Experience drafting product requirements, specs, or mockups for technical systems
  • Comfort with basic scripting (Python, JavaScript) or building demonstrable prototypes
  • Prior customer-facing experience in technical capacity (internships, support, technical project work)

What Success Looks Like at 90 Days

  • Own parts of the solution lifecycle—writing PRDs and delivering SDK-based prototypes independently
  • Successfully translate 3-5 customer engagements into actionable solutions using the Canvas platform
  • Identify and document at least 2 platform enhancement opportunities that enable scalable solutions
  • Build strong working relationships across GTM operations and engineering teams

Growth Path

  • In your first 6-12 months, you'll begin owning significant portions of the solution lifecycle—from customer discovery through prototype delivery. High performers evolve into senior solution consultants who lead small pods, shape customer delivery strategies, and drive platform capability expansion.
  • This role offers a unique opportunity to influence both how Canvas delivers immediate customer value and how our platform scales to meet future healthcare automation challenges.

Location

  • Remote/San Francisco/Washington DC We are a fully remote, distributed team but encourage in-person collaboration in our office in San Francisco, or one of our satellite locations which for this role is in Washington DC. We encourage people to do their work when and where they perform at their best. Because of this structure, strong written communication skills, time management skills, and personal accountability are very important to us.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Canvas Medical is accelerating everyday medicine with an EMR platform built for healthcare automation.
jobs.description:
Canvas Medical is accelerating everyday medicine with an EMR platform built for healthcare automation. We create modern, elegant front- and back-end tooling to enable new ways for developers and clinicians to integrate data, automate workflows, and collaborate to solve healthcare's toughest challenges. In doing so we advance our mission to give care teams superpowers with software.
Canvas is institutionally backed by some of the greatest technology investors in the world (funded notable health tech companies such as GoodRx, Oscar Health, and Hims & Hers Health).
Role Description
We're hiring a Solutions Engineer to join our Engineering team and build the technical bridge between customer needs and platform capabilities. This role is the engineering counterpart to our Solutions Consultants—where they translate customer needs into requirements, you'll transform those requirements into robust, scalable technical solutions that push the boundaries of our platform.
As a Solutions Engineer, you'll architect and implement custom solutions using the Canvas SDK, build reusable plugins and integrations, and extend our platform's capabilities to meet complex healthcare automation challenges. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to prototype rapidly, validate technical approaches, and deliver production-ready solutions that delight customers. This is a builder role where you'll directly impact how healthcare providers leverage our EMR platform while contributing to the evolution of our developer tools and SDK.
The ideal candidate brings strong engineering fundamentals, passion for healthcare technology, and exceptional ability to navigate between rapid prototyping and production-quality code. You'll thrive in collaborative environments, balance customer urgency with engineering excellence, and drive technical decisions that scale. We're looking for someone who experiments fearlessly, iterates quickly, and can build elegant solutions from the ground up while maintaining the robustness required for healthcare systems.

Responsibilities

  • Technical Solution Development
  • Build production-ready solutions using the Canvas SDK, demonstrating mastery of event-driven architectures, handlers, and effects
  • Transform PRDs from Solutions Consultants into elegant, maintainable code that solves real healthcare workflow challenges
  • Create robust plugins and integrations that extend platform capabilities while maintaining HIPAA compliance and clinical documentation standards
  • Develop and maintain a library of reusable components and patterns that accelerate future solution delivery
  • Platform Enhancement & Innovation
  • Identify gaps in SDK capabilities and contribute directly to platform improvements through pull requests and feature development
  • Design and implement new SDK features that enable broader solution patterns across the customer base
  • Build developer tools and utilities that improve the efficiency of both internal teams and external developers
  • Create technical documentation, integration guides, and reference implementations for complex solutions
  • Cross-Functional Technical Leadership
  • Partner with Solutions Consultants to validate technical feasibility and architect optimal approaches
  • Collaborate with core engineering teams to align custom solutions with platform roadmap and architectural standards
  • Enable customer success through technical workshops, debugging sessions, and solution handoffs
  • Mentor Solutions Consultants on technical concepts and best practices for SDK usage

Qualifications

  • Required Experience & Background
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
  • 2+ years of professional software development experience with modern web stacks
  • Demonstrated ability to build end-to-end solutions from requirements to production deployment
  • Strong problem-solving skills with ability to navigate ambiguous technical challenges
  • Technical Skills & Capabilities
  • Proficiency in Python is mandatory.
  • JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks (React preferred) are a bonus.
  • Experience with API design, event-driven architectures, and plugin-based systems
  • Strong understanding of software design patterns, testing practices, and code maintainability
  • Comfort with rapid prototyping while maintaining production-quality standards
  • Experience with version control, CI/CD pipelines, and modern development workflows
  • Healthcare & Domain Expertise
  • Interest in healthcare technology and improving clinical workflows through automation
  • Understanding of healthcare data standards (FHIR, HL7) or willingness to learn quickly
  • Ability to translate clinical requirements into technical architecture decisions
  • Appreciation for the complexity and criticality of healthcare systems
  • Personal Attributes
  • Builder mentality—passionate about creating solutions that directly impact users
  • Collaborative approach to problem-solving with strong communication skills
  • Growth mindset with ability to learn new technologies and domains rapidly
  • Pragmatic engineering approach—knows when to build for today versus tomorrow
  • Customer empathy with drive to understand and solve real user problems
  • Nice-to-Have Qualifications
  • Experience building or maintaining SDKs, developer tools, or platform products
  • Background in healthcare IT, EMR integrations, or clinical systems
  • Familiarity with regulatory requirements (HIPAA, FDA guidelines) for healthcare software
  • Experience with Python for backend services or data processing
  • Prior experience in customer-facing engineering or solutions architecture roles
  • Contributions to open-source projects or technical community engagement

What Success Looks Like at 90 Days

  • Ship 5+ production-ready solutions that demonstrate deep understanding of the Canvas SDK and platform capabilities
  • Contribute at least 2 meaningful enhancements to the SDK or developer tools based on customer solution needs
  • Establish strong working relationships with Solutions Consultants and become go-to technical partner for complex implementations
  • Create technical documentation and reference implementations that enable self-service solution development

Growth Path

Solutions Engineers at Canvas have multiple growth trajectories. Within 12-18 months, high performers evolve into senior solutions engineers who architect our most complex customer implementations and drive platform strategy. Many transition into core platform engineering roles, bringing deep customer context to shape product development. Others grow into technical leadership positions, building and scaling our solutions engineering practice. This role offers unique exposure to both customer challenges and platform internals, positioning you to influence Canvas's technical direction and healthcare impact.

Remote/San Francisco/Washington DC
We are a fully remote, distributed team but encourage in-person collaboration in our office in San Francisco, or one of our satellite locations which for this role is in Washington DC. We encourage people to do their work when and where they perform at their best. Information Security Compliance Coordinator
Contact Discovery Services - Washington, DC
Location: Remote
Start Date: Negotiable

A leading eDiscovery technology and consulting firm headquartered in Washington, DC is looking for a part-time Information Security Compliance Coordinator in the eDiscovery space to support the Director of Compliance with day-to-day compliance-related activities associated with ISO 27001, SOC 2, and CMMC. This role is primarily focused on administrative support, documentation, coordination, and execution of assigned tasks within the company’s information security and compliance programs.
The qualified candidate would assist with audit preparation, evidence collection, compliance tracking, and status reporting, ensuring that the required materials are accurate, up to date, and delivered on time. This role works under direction and established procedures and does not have compliance strategy or decision-making but plays a key role in keeping compliance efforts organized, on schedule, and well-documented.

This position includes working with a variety of internal & external team members including fellow Project Managers, business development team, attorneys, company or government representatives, and other legal staff. This is a part-time position (25 hours per week), with the potential to transition to a full-time role.

DUTIES OF THE POSITION:

Compliance & Audit Support

  • Support ISO, SOC 2, and CMMC compliance activities under the direction of the Director of Compliance
  • Assist with internal and external audit preparation, including:
  • Collecting requested evidence
  • Tracking auditor requests
  • Organizing documentation for review
  • Maintain compliance artifacts such as control matrices, evidence folders, spreadsheets, and trackers
  • Track remediation items and follow up with control owners as directed

Documentation & Administration

  • Update and maintain compliance documentation, policies, procedures, and logs as instructed
  • Manage version control and ensure documentation is current and properly stored
  • Prepare draft reports, summaries, and status updates for compliance leadership
  • Maintain audit calendars, timelines, and task lists

Coordination & Communication

  • Coordinate meetings related to compliance and audits, including scheduling, agendas, notes, and action-item tracking
  • Serve as a point of contact for routine compliance-related requests and information gathering
  • Communicate clearly with internal teams to obtain documentation and updates, escalating issues when needed

Program Support

  • Assist with maintaining awareness of compliance requirements across applicable frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, CMMC)
  • Support compliance training and awareness activities as directed
  • Perform other compliance-related administrative or support tasks as assigned

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 1 – 3 years of experience in a compliance support, audit support, risk, security, IT administration, or similar operational role
  • Experience supporting audits, compliance programs, or regulated environments is preferred
  • Ability to follow established processes and execute tasks accurately and on time
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • High attention to detail, especially when handling documentation and evidence
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously
  • Strong, clear written and verbal communication skills
  • Familiarity with information security or compliance concepts
  • Exposure to one or more frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, or CMMC is a plus
  • Basic understanding of data protection and secure handling of information
  • Ability to take direction and execute tasks independently once assigned
  • Comfortable working with sensitive and confidential information
  • Reliable, methodical, and process-oriented
  • Willingness to learn and grow within a compliance function

THE FOLLOWING SKILLS ARE PREFERRED BUT NOT REQUIRED:
  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Business, or a related field
  • Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered

jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Contáctica is the leading Martech Creative Agency in Puerto Rico, a strong challenger in Latin America, and a dynamic catalyst for growth in the U.S. mainland. For over 20 years we have challenged the status quo and accelerated the evolution of visionary companies and their teams by delivering pioneering knowledge, transformative Martech Solutions, and full-spectrum Marketing Agency Services.

With headquarters in Puerto Rico and Colombia, and a closely integrated team working from across ten countries, we are uniquely positioned to serve key industries such as Banking, Insurance, and Consumer Packaged Goods (CPGs), tackling the most complex brand, product, and business challenges of today and tomorrow.

In 2025, as we enter a new era of Hyper-Evolution, we are passionately committed to drive growth and innovation by leveraging the Power of Humanity + Artificial Intelligence, maintaining our unwavering commitment to exceptional business outcomes through Strategic Thinking, Creativity, Deep Client Insight, and Cutting-Edge Technologies.

If you're driven by the same convictions—and eager to take them further—we invite you to review this role and consider joining us.

JOB DESCRIPTION

We are looking for a seasoned, high-impact Operations Director to design, strengthen, and scale the operating model of Contáctica. This is not only an execution role, but a business leadership role at the center of how the company grows, delivers, and performs. As a close partner to the CEO, the Operations Director will help translate strategy into action while also serving as a trusted advisor on operational health, business performance, structural gaps, and scaling priorities.

This leader will oversee the design, improvement, and governance of the company’s operational frameworks, ensuring they are efficient, scalable, and aligned with both business objectives and client expectations. We are looking for someone who brings exposure to multiple operating models and best practices, ideally from Martech, technology, SaaS, consulting, or other high-growth service environments—not only traditional marketing agencies. This person should be able to identify what the business needs, adapt proven frameworks intelligently, and build the right structure for Contáctica’s stage of growth.

A core part of the role is leading the day-to-day operational engine of the business: managing capacity, balancing workloads, improving resource allocation, monitoring delivery risks, strengthening accountability, and enabling consistent, high-quality execution across teams. You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Client Services, Creative, Media, Strategy, Technology, and Finance to ensure the company operates with greater clarity, speed, discipline, and alignment.

This role also requires strong business and financial acumen. The Operations Director must be able to analyze numbers rigorously, question assumptions constructively, identify patterns and inefficiencies, and turn operational and financial data into better decisions. You will help strengthen visibility across performance, profitability, utilization, forecasting, and delivery performance, while giving the CEO and leadership team sharper insight into how the business is really operating.

Additionally, you will help connect operations to growth by understanding how sales, client needs, solution design, delivery feasibility, technology enablement, and financial performance interact. You should be comfortable acting as a thought partner in decisions that affect not only internal efficiency, but also scalability, client experience, and long-term business health.

Ultimately, this role requires a leader who thrives in complexity, combines strategic thinking with execution discipline, and can build the operational backbone Contáctica needs to scale intelligently and sustainably. The ideal candidate is not just a strong operator, but a broad business thinker who can challenge, advise, and help shape the next stage of the company’s growth.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Operational Excellence & Process Optimization

  • Design, improve, and standardize cross-functional operating processes to ensure structure, efficiency, scalability, and consistency across the organization.
  • Build and strengthen operational systems, frameworks, and governance mechanisms that increase predictability, quality, accountability, and execution discipline.
  • Bring best practices and adaptable operating models from Martech, technology, SaaS, consulting, and other high-growth service environments.
  • Integrate Martech, AI, automation, and workflow tools into day-to-day operations to improve productivity, visibility, speed, and accuracy.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement by identifying structural inefficiencies and implementing practical, scalable solutions.

Day-to-Day Operations Management

  • Lead the company’s day-to-day operational engine, including capacity planning, workload balancing, resource allocation, and delivery coordination across teams.
  • Monitor operational and delivery risks proactively, identify bottlenecks early, and drive fast, effective resolution across stakeholders.
  • Ensure strong coordination and seamless collaboration between Sales, Client Services, Creative, Media, Strategy, Technology, and Finance.
  • Improve operational clarity and discipline across handoffs, planning routines, prioritization, and execution follow-through.
  • Support the organization in operating with greater speed, alignment, responsiveness, and consistency.

Strategic Execution & CEO Partnership

  • Act as a trusted thought partner to the CEO on operational health, business performance, structural gaps, and scaling priorities.
  • Translate strategic priorities into clear operational action plans, decision frameworks, and execution rhythms.
  • Help leadership evaluate trade-offs, challenge assumptions constructively, and identify opportunities to improve how the business operates and grows.
  • Support the CEO in operational prioritization, business acceleration, and the execution of high-impact company initiatives.
  • Contribute business judgment, operational perspective, and practical recommendations that strengthen decision-making at the leadership level.

Performance, Reporting & Business Insights

  • Build and oversee operational dashboards, reporting frameworks, and management routines that increase visibility across the business.
  • Track and analyze key indicators such as capacity, utilization, profitability, delivery performance, forecasting accuracy, timelines, and service quality.
  • Translate operational and financial data into actionable insights that support better strategic and business decisions.
  • Identify patterns, risks, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities through rigorous analysis of operational and business performance.
  • Strengthen predictability, transparency, and accountability across all major areas of the company.

Commercial, Client & Cross-Functional Effectiveness

  • Develop a strong understanding of how sales, client needs, solution design, technology enablement, and delivery execution connect to business performance.
  • Partner with commercial and client-facing leaders to improve scoping quality, handoffs, delivery feasibility, and client experience.
  • Ensure operational systems support not only efficient execution, but also business development, retention, and scalable growth.
  • Safeguard an exceptional client experience through quality standards, operational consistency, and disciplined execution.
  • Support teams in ensuring deliverables meet agreed scope, timing, quality, and business expectations.

Financial & Resource Optimization

  • Oversee workforce planning, resource costs, and operational decisions that impact margins, profitability, and long-term financial health.
  • Analyze financial and operational performance with rigor, questioning assumptions and validating whether the business is operating effectively.
  • Identify resource inefficiencies, profitability risks, and structural issues that affect growth, delivery quality, or financial performance.
  • Support leadership with stronger visibility into staffing models, utilization, revenue support, and operational sustainability.
  • Help ensure that operational decisions are grounded in sound business logic, financial discipline, and growth readiness.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8–12 years of experience in Operations, Business Operations, PMO, Delivery Management, Revenue Operations, or similar cross-functional leadership roles.
  • Strong preference for experience in Martech, technology, SaaS, consulting, digital product, or other high-growth service organizations; experience beyond traditional marketing or creative agencies is highly valued.
  • Proven track record leading operational transformation, process design, cross-functional execution, and business scaling initiatives.
  • Experience working with more than one operating framework, methodology, or management model, with the ability to adapt and apply what best fits the business.
  • Strong understanding of how operations connect with sales, client service, technology, finance, and delivery in a growth-focused business.
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen, with experience interpreting KPIs, dashboards, forecasting, profitability metrics, utilization, and operational performance data.
  • Ability to question constructively, identify patterns and risks, and turn data into practical recommendations and smarter decisions.
  • Experience serving as a strategic advisor or close business partner to senior leadership and/or CEO-level stakeholders.
  • Strong experience in capacity planning, workflow optimization, delivery risk management, prioritization, and operational governance.
  • Proficiency with ERPs, CRMs, project management platforms, BI/reporting tools such as Power BI or Looker Studio, and process automation solutions.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, influence, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, ambiguous, and evolving environments.
  • Fully bilingual in English and Spanish (required).

LOCATION AND WORK ENVIRONMENT

This position offers the flexibility to work mostly remotely, allowing you to connect with our teams and clients from anywhere in North or Latin America. While you can be based anywhere in the Americas, we have a strong preference for candidates located in Puerto Rico, Colombia or Mexico due to strategic alignment with our core operational regions as well as in person collaboration with the CEO. This setup is designed to foster a dynamic and flexible work environment while maintaining close collaboration with our teams across our major hubs.

Periodic travel will be required to engage directly with teams and clients, ensuring you have the opportunity to strengthen relationships and foster teamwork. Additionally, regular team get-togethers and strategic off-site meetings are part of our culture to promote synergy, brainstorming, and alignment with our company's vision and goals.

START THE JOURNEY

If you share our beliefs—and are committed to act on them fully—we invite you to apply to join our team and experience the thrill of working in a fast-paced, cutting-edge, mostly remote environment.

Apply here and start the journey. Please include a personal letter with your application explaining why you're the best person for this position.

  • Develop and maintain accurate short and long-term forecasts for multi-channel contact volumes (calls, emails, etc.).
  • Translate forecasts into staffing requirements and create optimized agent schedules that meet service level targets.
  • Monitor real-time performance across all channels and make proactive, intraday adjustments to staffing and applications.
  • Manage agent schedule adherence, time-off requests, and other scheduling adjustments.
  • Collaborate with operations, marketing, and other departments to gather insights that impact contact volume.
  • Provide clear and concise communication regarding performance, schedules, and staffing decisions to leadership and the team.
  • Develop and distribute regular WFM reports and dashboards on key performance indicators (KPIs) like service level and occupancy.
