jobs.description:
GHX is seeking a Software Engineer III to join Developer Platform & AI Enablement, the team that builds the tooling, standards, and AI capabilities the rest of GHX core product engineering runs on. Reporting to the Director, Software Engineering, Developer Platform & AI Enablement, you’ll work on a small team whose customers are other engineers: the developers building the healthcare supply chain products that take more than a billion dollars out of the cost of delivering healthcare every year.

The SWE III is responsible for analyzing, design, program, debugging, and modifying software. This role is responsible for interacting with users to define system requirements and/or necessary modifications in an Agile/Scrum environment. You’ll grow into owning a capability end to end: a surface of the GHX agent platform, an MCP server other teams depend on, or the complexity-based router that decides whether a request runs on a local model or a hosted one. This is an embedded role, you’ll spend most weeks inside a product engineering team’s repository proving out a pattern before bringing the reusable version back to the broader engineering teams.

Duties and responsibilities

  • Analyzes, designs, programs, debugs, tests, documents, releases, and supports platform capabilities end to end.
  • Authors technical designs and architectural artifacts, and reviews the designs of peers.
  • Develops, versions, and documents reusable GitHub Actions and composite actions used across the organization.
  • Develops, versions, and documents reusable terraform modules (or other IaC) used across the organization.
  • Builds and operates MCP servers over stdio and remote/HTTP transports, owning tool schema design, transport selection, and authentication.
  • Extends our internal agent platform, including the SDK and the APIs other GHX teams build against, and contributes to local model routing.
  • Reads and safely modifies unfamiliar codebases, including Java and Maven builds, without owning the application code.
  • Drives defects and blockers to resolution, and writes automated tests and system test specifications.
  • Instruments developer-facing tooling to measure adoption and extends the team’s delivery-metrics pipeline.
  • Participates in architectural design spikes, project planning, and estimation in an Agile/Scrum environment.
  • Co-facilitates recorded AI in Automation Office Hours remotely each week.
  • Facilitating live sessions, both remote and in person, is an essential function of this role.
  • Actively uses AI-powered development tools to improve productivity and code quality, and authors the agent configuration artifacts other engineers reuse.
  • Create and maintain documentation as part of development and enablement efforts.
  • Stay up-to-date on industry trends and best practices related to Snowflake, Python, and AWS.
  • May mentor and onboard new team members as needed.

Required Qualifications

  • BS or MS Degree in Computer Science.
  • Requires 3-5 years of software development experience
  • Experience building internal tooling whose users were other engineers, with the ability to explain why a given tool was or was not adopted.
  • Daily use of agentic coding tools — Claude Code (preferred), Copilot, Cursor, or similar.
  • Direct experience authoring GitHub Actions at the reusable workflow or composite action level, or equivalent CI that other people consumed.
  • Direct experience authoring Infrastructure as code.
  • Technical writing that other engineers act on — design documents, ADRs, runbooks, or documentation you can point to.
  • Willingness to teach live and unscripted, including co-facilitating recorded remote sessions and full-day in-person workshops.
  • Willingness and ability to travel as needed.
  • Must be able to work independently and as part of a team on multiple overlapping projects.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Has measured a non-deterministic system and argued from the numbers — an eval harness, a benchmark, or a rubric.
  • Experience building and operating MCP servers, including remote/HTTP transports and auth.
  • Comfortable deploying and debugging on AWS
  • An agent configuration artifact you authored that another engineer used — a skill, subagent, md/AGENTS.md, or MCP tool.
  • Experience with local or open-weight inference: Ollama, llama.cpp, or MLX, quantization tradeoffs, context and KV-cache sizing, and OpenAI-compatible shims.
  • Experience measuring developer outcomes: adoption instrumentation, DORA-style delivery metrics, and data plumbing behind messy organizational data.
  • Experience with the healthcare supply chain, EDI documents and standards, an added advantage.

Estimated Salary: $102,000 - $136,000

LI - SR

GHX: It's the way you do business in healthcare
Global Healthcare Exchange (GHX) enables better patient care and billions in savings for the healthcare community by maximizing automation, efficiency and accuracy of business processes.

GHX is a healthcare business and data automation company, empowering healthcare organizations to enable better patient care and maximize industry savings using our world class cloud-based supply chain technology exchange platform, solutions, analytics and services. We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe - who rely on smart, secure healthcare-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes and make more informed decisions.

It is our passion and vision for a more operationally efficient healthcare supply chain, helping organizations reduce - not shift - the cost of doing business, paving the way to delivering patient care more effectively. Together we take more than a billion dollars out of the cost of delivering healthcare every year. Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Across Europe, North America, South America, Asia and Australia, we work in an environment built on kindness, flexibility, growth and belonging, where colleagues support one another and good ideas are heard wherever they come from.

If you want a role with real purpose, global reach and the chance to keep growing while you help protect patients, you will feel at home here. We would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Director, Financial Planning & Analysis
jobs.excerpt: The MissionClarify is an outcomes company.  We partner with 60+ health systems to do the work that most analytics vendors walk away from.
jobs.description:
The Mission

Clarify is an outcomes company. We partner with 60+ health systems to do the work that most analytics vendors walk away from. Across 900 million annual referrals and $1 trillion in downstream spending, we identify where mission and margin are falling out of alignment, and then we embed with the people who can change it: the liaison in the field, the contract negotiator at the table, the service line leader running the plan.

We bring the most complete picture of care economics in healthcare. 300 million patient journeys. 5.6 trillion price transparency rates. Episode-level quality across every major payer contract. Clarify Meridian puts that picture to work at the point of every decision. But the picture is not what we deliver. The outcomes are.

The Opportunity

Clarify is looking for a Director, Financial Planning & Analysis to build and own the financial models and analyses that power decision-making at a fast-scaling, AI-first healthcare technology company. This role sits within Finance and reports to the CFO. You'll build the financial models and analyses that inform the CFO's decisions, help shape how Clarify's financial story is told to the company, the Board, and outside stakeholders, and support the CFO on fundraising, M&A, and other high-stakes work. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role for someone trained in a demanding, high-accountability environment - investment banking, private equity, hedge funds, or specialty/credit lending - who is ready to move from advising or evaluating businesses to owning the financial engine of one.

We recently acquired Loyal Health to build the industry's first closed-loop network intelligence and patient activation platform, and we are actively transitioning our commercial model from traditional SaaS subscriptions to Meridian, a tech-enabled outcomes partnership where our economics are tied to the results we deliver for health systems. That shift - modeling success-fee revenue, at-risk contracts, and multi-year outcomes-based partnerships alongside our existing SaaS book - is exactly the kind of complex, non-linear financial modeling problem that will keep this role interesting for years, not months.

You'll work directly on fundraising, M&A evaluation and integration, and long-range forecasting for a business model most finance professionals have never had to model before - the kind of access and trust that comes from being the person whose numbers the CFO relies on. You'll also partner closely with Operations and Sales on revenue recognition, ARR tracking, and the sales-ops-adjacent mechanics that keep our commercial engine honest. Healthcare experience is not required but the analytical rigor and self-taught intensity to get there fast absolutely is.

Does this sound like you?

  • You were trained in a demanding, detail-intensive finance environment - investment banking, private equity, hedge funds, or specialty/credit lending
  • You're a self-directed learner who has successfully made a hard pivot before - from banking or investing into an operating company, a new industry, or a new function - and you figured it out fast without a playbook
  • You're quantitatively fearless - three-statement models, scenario analysis, and complex revenue mechanics don't intimidate you, and you'd rather build the model yourself than wait for someone else to hand you one
  • You're AI-native in your workflow - you use Claude, ChatGPT, or similar tools daily to accelerate modeling, diligence, and reporting, and you're always looking for the faster way to get to a defensible answer
  • You bring rigor and ownership to the numbers, not just back-office analysis - the CFO relies on you because your models hold up under scrutiny and your work is airtight
  • You're comfortable being the most rigorous person in the room on structure and diligence, while still moving at startup speed - you default to shipping a solid answer today over a perfect one next week
  • You want ownership, not oversight - you'd rather build the financial infrastructure for a company you can point to than be one more analyst on someone else's deal

The role

    The Director, Financial Planning & Analysis will be responsible for:

    Immediate Priority: Budget & Forecast Automation

  • Our budgeting and forecasting process today runs almost entirely in Excel and is highly manual; this role's first mandate is to redesign and automate that process end-to-end
  • Evaluate and select FP&A / planning tools to replace manual spreadsheet-based workflows, and lead implementation and adoption across Finance
  • Use AI tools, including Claude, to automate recurring modeling, data consolidation, and reporting work within the budget and forecast cycle

    • Strategic Forecasting & Financial Modeling (35%)

  • Lead corporate-wide financial planning, budgeting, and long-range forecasting, including scenario modeling across our blended SaaS and outcomes-based revenue streams
  • Build and maintain the company's core financial model, capturing the mechanics of success-fee contracts, at-risk revenue, and multi-year health system partnerships alongside traditional SaaS metrics (ARR, gross margin, retention, unit economics)
  • Provide the CFO with financial analysis on the implications of strategic decisions - pricing models, new product lines, market expansion, and resource allocation
  • Proactively surface insights on financial and operational drivers, flagging risks, overages, and optimization opportunities before they become surprises

    • Fundraising & M&A Support (25%)

  • Build and own fundraising materials, investor models, and diligence support for equity and debt processes, working directly with the CFO, in support of the CFO's engagement with the CEO and COO.
  • Lead financial diligence and integration modeling for M&A activity, drawing on our recent acquisition of Loyal Health as a template for evaluating future targets
  • Develop board- and investor-ready analyses that translate complex operating data into clear, defensible narratives on growth, margin, and capital efficiency
  • Support the CFO on cap table management, valuation considerations, and capital structure planning

    • Revenue Recognition & Commercial Finance Operations (25%)

  • Partner with Accounting on revenue recognition for complex, multi-element contracts spanning traditional SaaS subscriptions and outcomes-based success fees, ensuring ASC 606 compliance
  • Own ARR tracking and reporting, building the infrastructure to cleanly separate contracted revenue, at-risk success fees, and probability-weighted bookings as our business model evolves
  • Partner with Sales and Operations on quote-to-cash and sales-ops-adjacent processes - deal structuring support, pricing mechanics, and SFDC-sourced reporting - to keep commercial and financial data in sync
  • Drive process rigor and controls across revenue operations to ensure the accuracy, integrity, and auditability of financial data as deal complexity increases

    • Reporting, Systems & Cross-Functional Partnership (15%)

  • Prepare timely, accurate BVA analysis that the CFO uses to brief Clarify's leadership team, Board of Directors, and external stakeholders
  • Continuously improve reporting infrastructure, dashboards, and tools - leveraging AI wherever possible - to increase visibility and decision-making speed across the organization
  • Build strong working relationships with Sales, Product, Engineering, and People & Culture leaders, representing Finance as a cross-functional partner rather than a gatekeeper

    • What we offer you

    •Competitive compensation (base + bonus + equity)

    •Quality health insurance

    •Traditional 401K plan

    •Vision, dental, disability and life insurance

    •Flexible Spending Accounts and Commuter Benefits

    •Generous PTO

    •Flexibility

    •Monthly wellness stipend

    •Remote friendly

    •A collaborative workplace which will challenge you and celebrate your work

    •The opportunity to design the financial infrastructure for a fundamentally new business model in healthcare, rather than maintain someone else's spreadsheet

    •Enterprise AI tools (Claude, cloud platforms) and an expectation that you'll use them to work faster and smarter

    We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

What we are looking for

    We are always looking for new team members who will add to our culture and have a strong passion for impact. In particular, the Director, Financial Planning & Analysis will have:

    Must-haves:

  • 6-10+ years of progressive finance experience, with meaningful time in a rigorous, high-accountability environment - investment banking, private equity, hedge funds, or specialty/credit lending - followed by a successful transition into an operating company
  • Advanced financial modeling and diligence skills - can build a complex three-statement model or scenario analysis from scratch, under time pressure, without hand-holding
  • Hands-on experience automating budgeting and forecasting processes - moving a company off manual, spreadsheet-based cycles, evaluating and selecting FP&A/planning tools, and using AI tools like Claude to streamline modeling and reporting
  • Demonstrated ability to teach yourself a new domain quickly - your career shows at least one hard pivot (industry, function, or company stage) where you got up to speed fast and delivered
  • An AI-first mindset - active daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to accelerate modeling, diligence, and reporting; can cite specific examples of using AI to compress timelines
  • Strong business acumen - builds credibility quickly with the leadership team and translates financial analysis into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a complex, evolving business model - you're energized, not unsettled, by a company that is actively redesigning its own revenue mechanics

    • Strongly preferred:

  • Prior experience at a bank, private equity fund, hedge fund, or healthcare/life sciences credit lender, with direct exposure to healthcare, life sciences, or tech-enabled services companies
  • Experience supporting fundraising processes (equity or debt) and/or M&A diligence and integration, ideally in a venture-backed or sponsor-backed environment
  • Familiarity with SaaS metrics and valuation frameworks (ARR, NRR, CAC/LTV, magic number) and eagerness to extend that fluency to outcomes-based and success-fee revenue models
  • Strong working knowledge of GAAP and revenue recognition standards (ASC 606), particularly for complex or multi-element contracts
  • Experience implementing or scaling financial systems, dashboards, or reporting infrastructure
  • CPA, CFA, or MBA
  • Prior experience operating in a venture-backed, high-growth environment

What we offer you

  • Competitive compensation (base + bonus + equity)
  • Quality health insurance
  • Traditional 401K plan
  • Vision, dental, disability and life insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts and Commuter Benefits
  • Generous PTO
  • Flexibility
  • Monthly wellness stipend
  • Remote friendly
  • A collaborative workplace which will challenge you and celebrate your work
  • The opportunity to design the financial infrastructure for a fundamentally new business model in healthcare, rather than maintain someone else's spreadsheet
  • Enterprise AI tools (Claude, cloud platforms) and an expectation that you'll use them to work faster and smarter
We believe that a happy, diverse, and impact-driven team is critical to our mission of transforming healthcare. Having a diverse team allows us to bring more ideas to the table when working on lighting the path to higher-value care. We embrace employees and applicants of all backgrounds, including those of traditionally underrepresented groups. With this in mind, we do not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, the basis of disability, homelessness, reproductive health decisions or any other federal, state, or local protected class.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Employee Experience
jobs.excerpt: Role DescriptionDropbox’s Virtual First team researches, tests, and scales better ways of working for a distributed organization.
jobs.description:
Role Description

Dropbox’s Virtual First team researches, tests, and scales better ways of working for a distributed organization. We combine organizational research, experimentation, behavioral science, technology, and employee experience to continuously improve how Dropboxers work—wherever they are.

As a Senior Program Manager, Employee Experience, you will own a strategic Virtual First work stream focused on tool optimization and technology-enabled ways of working, identifying opportunities to improve employee effectiveness and translating those opportunities into research, experiments, recommendations, and scalable organizational change.

This role combines program management with research, innovation, and cross-functional stakeholder management. You will manage a portfolio of interconnected programs rather than a single project, with particular focus on knowledge management, AI enablement, and building employee confidence with tools and technology. You will establish research priorities, design and facilitate experiments, synthesize findings, and work with partners across Dropbox to turn evidence into better ways of working.

Success in this role means creating new knowledge, translating that knowledge into clear recommendations, and driving measurable improvements in employee effectiveness, tool confidence, and adoption of AI-enabled and technology-supported ways of working.

Responsibilities

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, priorities, and outcomes of a Virtual First workstream focused on technology, including tools, workflows, automations, AI enablement, and knowledge management
  • Design and lead organizational research, pilots, and experiments that test new ways of working
  • Translate qualitative and quantitative findings into actionable recommendations, behavioral frameworks, and operating models for downstream adoption
  • Manage a portfolio of concurrent programs and initiatives from initial scoping through research, validation, and enablement planning
  • Establish clear objectives, success measures, milestones, risks, and reporting across the workstream
  • Facilitate cross-functional Steering Committees and initiatives involving stakeholders across People, Technology, Communications, Operations, and other business functions
  • Partner with People Analytics and other measurement experts to establish research methodologies and evaluate outcomes.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in program management, organizational effectiveness, workplace strategy, employee experience, innovation, research, or a related discipline.
  • Expertise in tools and technology enablement, including AI adoption, knowledge management, digital workflows, automation, and the design of technology-enabled ways of working that improve employee effectiveness.
  • Demonstrated experience independently leading complex, cross-functional programs from ambiguity through measurable outcomes.
  • Experience designing and managing research, pilots, experiments, or other evidence-based innovation programs.
  • Strong understanding of Virtual First, distributed, hybrid, or modern ways of working.
  • Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and executive communication skills.
  • Comfort working in ambiguity and proactively identifying opportunities rather than waiting for assignments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a distributed or Virtual First organization.
  • Experience with organizational behavior, change management, behavioral science, workplace research, or human-centered design.
  • Demonstrated curiosity about the future of work and emerging technologies.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technologycontinue to evolve:

  • Awareness:Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment:Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability:Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection:Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog postfrom our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

Compensation

Canada Pay Range
$128,400—$173,700 CAD

jobs.excerpt: At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.
jobs.description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.

About Us:

At CI&T, our rapid growth is fueled by the innovative solutions we create for our global clients. We are seeking a Data Analyst with a focus on data quality and reporting for a large-scale Finance data platform modernization at a major US mortgage lender — making sure the curated data and reports built on the new platform are correct and tie out to trusted Finance benchmarks. Pipeline-level monitoring and CI/CD are owned by the DataOps Engineer; this role is about the data and the numbers, not the pipeline mechanics.

Responsibilities:

  • Define and run data quality checks and reconciliation logic against the curated data layer, comparing results to approved Finance benchmarks and closed accounting periods.
    • Validate migrated and re-pointed reports and dashboards for parity against their prior legacy-source output, including parallel-run comparisons during cutover — running old and new side by side and confirming they tie out within agreed tolerance.
    • Profile and investigate data quality issues and reconciliation variances, working with Data Engineering to identify and document root cause.
    • Build and maintain data quality dashboards/reports in Power BI (or the equivalent BI tool) so quality status and known variances stay visible to Finance and delivery stakeholders on an ongoing basis.
    • Partner with Finance and business stakeholders to define acceptance criteria and quality thresholds for each reporting deliverable.
    • Produce the acceptance evidence — reconciliation results, parallel-run comparisons, sign-off packages — required at each delivery gate, including the cutover gate.
    • Document data quality rules and known issues in a form the client's own team can maintain post-handoff.

Requirements:

  • Solid experience as a data analyst or BI analyst, with strong hands-on SQL for querying, validating, and reconciling data.
    • Hands-on experience building or validating reports/dashboards in Power BI or a comparable enterprise BI tool.
    • Experience with a data-quality or reconciliation framework or methodology (e.g. dbt tests, Great Expectations, or a structured manual reconciliation practice).
    • Comfortable working with financial/accounting data and closed-period reconciliation constraints.
    • Strong attention to detail and clear written documentation of data quality findings.
    • Fluent English (B2) — coordinates quality findings and evidence directly with client stakeholders at delivery gates.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with financial/GL reporting domains (chart of accounts, dimensions, close process).
    • Experience validating report or dashboard migrations off a legacy source system onto a new platform.
    • Experience with a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake preferred).
    • Experience in mortgage, lending, or financial-services reporting.

Our benefits include:

  • Premium Healthcare
  • Meal voucher
  • Maternity and Parental leaves
  • Mobile services subsidy
  • Sick pay-Life insurance
  • CI&T University
  • Colombian Holidays
  • Paid Vacations
And many others.
Collaboration is our superpower, diversity unites us, and excellence is our standard.
We value diverse identities and life experiences, fostering a diverse, inclusive, and safe work environment. We encourage applications from diverse and underrepresented groups to our job positions.

jobs.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW

As an Account Executive at Coalescence, you will play a key role in driving sales growth and client acquisition for our professional services supporting SaaS solutions, with a focus on Salesforce. You will work closely with prospects and clients to identify and provide tailored solutions, helping them achieve their business objectives. You will also collaborate with internal teams to ensure a seamless handover to the client services team.
This position is ideal for someone with strong interpersonal skills, experience in building relationships at the C-level, and a solid understanding of professional services within the SaaS ecosystem.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Identify, engage, and close new business opportunities, meeting or exceeding assigned sales quotas.
  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with C-level prospects and customers, acting as a trusted advisor.
  • Manage the full sales cycle—from lead generation through contract negotiation—ensuring smooth transition to the client services team.
  • Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities within new clients to maximize customer value and increase company revenue.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to align client needs with Coalescence's services, ensuring seamless project delivery.
  • Drive revenue through an assigned quota, divided into quarterly targets.
  • Work closely with the Go-to-Market Leadership and Sales team to contribute to sales strategies and internal growth initiatives.
  • Fulfill Management by Objectives (MBOs) set by leadership.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years of experience in sales roles, preferably in a company selling professional services supporting a SaaS solution.
  • Experience working with services based technology products.
  • Proven track record of success in foundational sales activities, including high-volume outbound prospecting (cold-calling, email, social selling), expert-level qualification of leads using frameworks like BANT/MEDDIC, and consistent achievement of meeting/pipeline generation targets.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to clearly convey value to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales quotas and driving revenue growth.
  • Ability to build and nurture relationships with C-level executives.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience selling IT services and/or products in a start-up environment.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce products and Professional Services Automation products. Familiarity with sales methodologies such as ValueSelling.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to juggle multiple client engagements and internal initiatives.
  • Eagerness to work closely with leadership, sales, and delivery teams to ensure the highest level of client satisfaction.
  • Ability to creatively navigate client challenges and deliver solutions that support long-term business relationships.
Note: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. The employee may perform other related duties as negotiated to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

COMPANY OVERVIEW

Coalescence Cloud is a premier data and analytics Systems Integration partner to Salesforce and Certina. We are dedicated to streamlining and enhancing our customers’ journey to process automation, focusing on delivering the outcomes they desire.
We harmonize data across that entire customer journey—from opportunity to renewal—leveraging our expert delivery teams to provide cutting-edge advice and solutions.
Our team believes that data is the bedrock of power business technologies—from consulting on an appropriate tech-stack to implementation and managed services, we are committed to client-centric guidance that emphasizes revenue growth, cost savings, and risk mitigation.
At Coalescence Cloud, we operate with the values of Guidance, Collaboration, Excellence, Sustainability, and Innovation. These principles guide our interactions with clients, partners, and teams—ensuring every interaction is supported by integrity and commitment.
BENEFITS
Medical, Vision, Dental, and Life insurance plans
Company HSA Contribution
PTO and Holiday: 12 PTO days, 6 sick leave days, and 11 Paid Holidays
Inclusive Maternity and Paternity leave policies
Role related bonuses
One-time Certification Bonuses
401k Management
WellHub Membership
Additional benefits provided through our HRIS platform

In addition to base pay, Coalescence Cloud offers a comprehensive total rewards package that may include health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, performance incentives, and other benefits and perks designed to support employee well-being and work-life balance.

We believe diversity drives innovation, strengthens our communities, and enhances our ability to deliver exceptional value to our clients.

At Ensono, our Purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and unleashing our clients to Do Great Things! Honesty, Reliability, Curiosity, Collaboration, and Passion.

About the role and what you'll be doing:

The AMS Sales Specialist is a strategic, quota-bearing sales role responsible for accelerating growth within a designated solution portfolio at Ensono. This role serves as a subject matter expert aligned to Account Executives and Client Partners, helping identify, shape, and close opportunities that drive business outcomes for our clients.

The AMS Sales Specialist partners closely with Ensono's sales, solution architecture, delivery, product, and leadership teams to develop account strategies, create pipeline, advance opportunities, and support successful revenue attainment. While Account Executives maintain primary account ownership, the Sales Specialist brings deep expertise, industry perspective, and solution-specific sales leadership to complex opportunities.

Sales Strategy & Opportunity Development

  • Partner with Account Executives and Client Partners to identify, qualify, and close opportunities within assigned accounts and territories.
  • Contribute to territory planning and account strategy development to accelerate growth within the Hybrid Cloud Services portfolio.
  • Influence deal strategy and support opportunity execution through all phases of the sales cycle.
  • Develop and execute pipeline generation initiatives, campaigns, and strategic prospecting activities aligned with business objectives.
  • Maintain an informed view of customer priorities, market trends, competitive activity, and evolving technology requirements.
  • Support forecasting activities and provide visibility into opportunity progression, risks, and growth potential.

Client Engagement & Solution Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted subject matter expert for Ensono's managed services capabilities and solution portfolio.

  • Actively identify barriers to customer success and help develop strategies that improve client outcomes.
  • Advocate for client needs while balancing business objectives and operational realities.
  • Support strategic growth initiatives and other responsibilities as assigned.

We want all new Associates to succeed in their roles at Ensono. That's why we've outlined the job requirements below. To be considered for this role, it's important that you meet all Required Qualifications. If you do not meet all of the Preferred Qualifications, we still encourage you to apply.

What You Will Need:

  • Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university or equivalent work experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in enterprise technology sales, solution consulting, business development, managed services, cloud services, infrastructure services, or application services.
  • Experience selling application managed services, application modernization, DevOps, SRE, cloud-native services, application support, or digital transformation solutions.
  • Understanding of modern application architectures, software development practices, platform engineering, and cloud ecosystems.
  • Experience supporting application assessment, migration, modernization, or managed services engagements.
  • Strong understanding of modern software delivery and IT operations practices, including the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), Agile and Scrum methodologies, CI/CD pipeline design and automation, IT service management frameworks (ITIL), and operational excellence principles that drive scalability, reliability, governance, and continuous improvement.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms including AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.
  • Experience with emerging AI and intelligent automation technologies, including AIOps, specification-driven development methodologies, AI agent orchestration and workflow design, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server architectures to enable scalable, context-aware, and automated solution delivery.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting or leading complex technology sales pursuits.
  • Strong ability to engage with technical and business stakeholders across multiple organizational levels, including executive leadership.
  • Experience working in a specialist, overlay, solution sales, consulting, or subject matter expert capacity.
  • Proven ability to influence without direct authority and successfully collaborate across matrixed organizations.
  • Strong verbal, written, presentation, and executive communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent opportunities, priorities, and stakeholder relationships.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and strategic thinking capabilities.
  • Proficiency with CRM tools, Microsoft Office applications, and sales enablement platforms.
  • Familiar with best practices for data governance, data mesh, data warehousing, and data virtualization.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience within a managed services provider (MSP), consulting organization, systems integrator, or technology services company.
  • Experience working with large enterprise and mid-market clients.
  • Relevant industry or technology certifications.
  • Experience selling AI-enabled operational services, automation solutions, observability platforms, or digital operations capabilities.
  • Experience participating in large, strategic, multi-service technology transformation programs.
  • Deep expertise in a specific industry vertical or technology domain aligned to Ensono's growth strategy.
  • Advanced certifications in cloud, infrastructure, application, or managed services technologies.

Why Ensono?

Ensono is a place to make better happen – for our clients and for your career. You can do great things through innovation or collaboration, by learning or volunteering, or to promote diversity and inclusion. You can do great things for your own health or for a healthier planet. Whatever it means to you to do great things we want Ensono to be the place you can do it.

We are a client-facing business, but we do encourage clients to allow us to work remotely most of the time so if you are not required to be on a client site, you can choose to work from home or in our Ensono offices.

Some of our benefits include:

  • Unlimited Paid Days Off

jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. About ZazzZazz is a global IT services and technology company providing managed IT services, cloud solutions, cybersecurity, software engineering and technology consulting.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

About Zazz

Zazz is a global IT services and technology company providing managed IT services, cloud solutions, cybersecurity, software engineering and technology consulting. Its managed services team supports clients through proactive monitoring, service desk support, infrastructure management and ongoing improvement. Zazz combines technical delivery with a focus on dependable services, clear accountability and long-term client relationships.

Role purpose

The Senior Internal IT and Project Engineer takes day-to-day ownership of Zazz’s internal IT services, Microsoft 365 environment and employee equipment lifecycle, alongside advanced third line support and assigned project delivery. You will resolve complex technical issues, coordinate equipment dispatch and recovery, manage changes and recurring problems, and deliver practical improvements to systems and services.

This is a hands-on engineering role with project management and project management office (PMO) responsibilities. Working remotely from India, you will coordinate with HR, Procurement, office teams, suppliers and service delivery leadership. Support priorities, project ownership and protected delivery time will be agreed with your manager, with capacity conflicts escalated early.

Key responsibilities

Third line technical support
  • Own complex incidents and service requests escalated from L1 and L2, supporting Zazz’s internal environment and assigned client services across identity, cloud, endpoints, servers, networking and integrations.
  • Lead technical investigation during major incidents, restore service safely and coordinate specialist or supplier support. Maintain clear ownership, regular updates and effective shift handovers.
  • Work to agreed service priorities, applicable SLAs and escalation procedures. Escalate technical blockers, security concerns and service risks promptly.
  • Maintain accurate HaloPSA records covering impact, diagnosis, actions, time, next steps and outcomes. Confirm service restoration before resolution and closure.
  • Coach L1 and L2 engineers, document repeatable troubleshooting steps and publish knowledge articles that reduce repeat incidents and unnecessary escalations.

Internal IT and Microsoft 365 administration
  • Own day-to-day administration and technical support for Zazz’s Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online and OneDrive, and related business applications.
  • Administer Microsoft Entra ID identities, groups, roles and access policies. Apply approved multifactor authentication, conditional access and least-privilege controls; review and remediate access exceptions.
  • Coordinate joiners, movers and leavers with HR and managers. Provision approved accounts, licences, access and equipment; complete timely access removal, session revocation and authorised data handover for leavers.
  • Manage endpoint enrolment, configuration, application deployment, patching, encryption and compliance through Intune and approved endpoint or remote management tools. Maintain standard builds and readiness checks.
  • Monitor service health, investigate email and collaboration issues, and coordinate Microsoft or supplier escalations. Maintain approved backup and recovery arrangements and verify restores where applicable.
  • Review licence allocations, unused subscriptions and renewal requirements with Procurement and Finance. Maintain configuration records, operating procedures and internal support guidance.

Asset lifecycle and equipment logistics
  • Maintain accurate asset records in HaloPSA and approved registers, including asset tag, serial number, model, assigned user, location, ownership, lifecycle status, warranty and relevant purchase details.
  • Coordinate equipment requirements for starters, replacements, upgrades and loan devices. Confirm specifications, availability, approvals and delivery dates with managers, Procurement and suppliers.
  • Arrange remote provisioning and coordinate physical preparation with office staff or fulfilment partners. Ensure devices pass build, security, enrolment and functional checks before issue.
  • Coordinate shipping with local teams, suppliers and couriers: confirm recipients and addresses, arrange delivery or collection, record tracking details and obtain receipt confirmation.
  • Own the follow-up process for leaver equipment, loan returns, repairs and replacements. Provide return instructions and labels where needed, track collections and escalate overdue, lost or damaged equipment.
  • Confirm returned equipment has been received and inspected. Coordinate approved data retention, secure wiping, redeployment, warranty returns or disposal, and retain the relevant evidence.
  • Reconcile assets with staff and office teams, investigate missing or inconsistent records, and maintain visibility of spare stock, outstanding returns and equipment awaiting repair or disposal.

Security and operational controls

Protect credentials, employee information and company data throughout support, project delivery and equipment handling. Follow approved access, retention and disposal procedures, and involve security specialists when needed. Obtain approval before purchases or material system changes, and retain a clear audit trail of approvals and completed work.

Change management
  • Raise and maintain change records in HaloPSA for planned technical work. Document the business reason, scope, affected services and assets, risk, impact, dependencies and proposed implementation window.
  • Prepare implementation steps, testing and validation criteria, communications and rollback plans. Coordinate technical review, required business approvals and Change Advisory Board (CAB) review where applicable.
  • Implement changes only within the agreed authorisation and schedule, using the approved emergency process when necessary. Record outcomes, carry out post-implementation reviews and update asset and support documentation.

Problem management
  • Identify recurring incidents, service trends and underlying technical risks. Open and own problem records, linking related incidents, changes and affected assets or services.
  • Lead root cause investigations using evidence from tickets, logs, monitoring and suppliers. Record findings, workarounds and known errors, with clear owners and target dates for corrective actions.
  • Deliver permanent fixes through approved changes or projects, verify that the underlying issue has been addressed, and share lessons learnt with the service desk.

Project management and PMO responsibilities
  • Manage assigned internal and client IT projects from scoping through closure. Agree objectives, deliverables, assumptions, exclusions and acceptance criteria; contribute technical estimates and delivery plans.
  • Build and maintain HaloPSA project plans, parent projects and child tasks with named owners, dates, milestones, dependencies and time budgets. Keep schedules and delivery status current.
  • Prepare effort and cost estimates covering engineering, hardware, licences and suppliers. Obtain budget approval, track actuals and forecast remaining costs, escalating potential overspend early.
  • Coordinate engineering capacity, supplier activity and stakeholder availability. Maintain risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies (RAID), together with decisions, actions and recovery plans.
  • Provide regular stakeholder updates and PMO reporting on milestones, budget, resources, risks and decisions required. Maintain project templates, governance records and portfolio information.
  • Assess and obtain approval for scope changes. Close projects with documented acceptance, reconciled time and costs, lessons learnt and a clear transition into ongoing support.

Hands on project engineering
  • Assess environments and turn approved requirements into practical technical designs, deployment plans and test plans, seeking specialist review where required.
  • Deliver Microsoft 365 and identity improvements, endpoint rollouts, migrations and infrastructure upgrades. Configure and troubleshoot solutions using approved tools and repeatable deployment methods.
  • Execute approved changes, coordinate user acceptance testing and support go-live and stabilisation. Resolve implementation issues and confirm agreed acceptance criteria have been met.
  • Produce configuration records, diagrams, support procedures and knowledge articles in IT Glue or approved systems. Hand over access, monitoring, support ownership and outstanding actions to operational teams.

Person specification

Essential experience and skills
  • Proven third line support or senior IT engineering experience, with ownership of complex incidents and internal IT services in an MSP or a distributed organisation.
  • Strong practical experience administering Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Windows endpoints and device management, including identity, permissions, licensing and secure employee onboarding and offboarding.
  • Advanced troubleshooting across cloud services, Windows infrastructure, DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, firewalls and VPNs, with an understanding of security, backup and recovery controls.
  • Experience managing equipment and asset records, coordinating suppliers and couriers, and following through on device delivery, returns, repair and disposal.
  • Demonstrable project delivery experience covering plans, estimates, budgets, milestones, dependencies, risks, stakeholder communication and hands-on implementation.
  • Practical Change and Problem Management experience, accurate ITSM or PSA records, and the ability to maintain usable technical documentation and mentor colleagues.
  • Clear written and spoken English, strong organisation and the ability to work independently with international teams. Availability to work remotely from India during the stated shift.

Desirable experience and qualifications
  • Experience with HaloPSA, NinjaOne, Huntress, IT Glue, Keeper, Addigy or Druva; familiarity with Azure, macOS or other cloud platforms.
  • PowerShell scripting, automation, standardised device deployment and experience contributing to PMO reporting or delivery standards.
  • Relevant Microsoft, ITIL, cloud or networking qualifications, and PRINCE2, APM or PMP certification; equivalent practical experience is equally valued.

Measures of success

Performance will be assessed against agreed objectives and available capacity: reliable internal IT services; timely joiner and leaver completion; accurate asset records and equipment recovery; effective third line resolution; controlled changes and fewer recurring issues; and projects delivered to agreed scope, milestones, budget and acceptance criteria. Clear communication, documentation and operational handover are expected throughout.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Senior Solutions Architect, you'll be a trusted advisor to GitLab customers and prospects in Japan. You'll explain how GitLab's artificial intelligence-powered development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) platform addresses customers' business priorities and technical requirements, helping technical leaders and executives evaluate its value.

You'll translate technology into business value and help customers make informed adoption decisions. The initial sale isn't the end of the relationship: you'll support continued adoption, new use cases, and expansion into additional products and editions, helping increase GitLab consumption through greater customer value.

What you’ll do

Plan the effort and timelines for migrating continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines from Jenkins to GitLab.
  • Resolve post-sale adoption challenges with post-sales teams and partners, and identify expansion opportunities across use cases, business units, workloads, products, and editions.
  • Build relationships with developers and business and technical leaders. Explain GitLab's competitive differentiation and address objections about existing tools, overlapping artificial intelligence capabilities, cost, and migration effort.
  • Create reusable proposals, architecture diagrams, proof-of-value plans, executive materials, technical content, and success stories. Present at webinars and marketing events to support pipeline development.
  • Share customer feedback and competitive insights with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing. Test GitLab, artificial intelligence, DevSecOps, and cloud technologies hands-on, and mentor team members to share best practices.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience in technical pre-sales, solutions architecture, consulting, technical sales, or a similar customer-facing role, using structured discovery, value selling, stakeholder mapping, and consensus building.
  • Practical understanding of the software development lifecycle, DevSecOps, security, and cloud technologies, with experience using GitLab or comparable source control, continuous integration and continuous delivery, and developer collaboration platforms.

  • Fluency in Japanese and professional working proficiency in English.
  • Helpful but not required: a background in software development, systems integration, or project or product management. Other useful experience includes developer productivity, cloud-native technologies, enterprise platform governance and rollout, post-sales recommendations, consumption-based models, or creating reusable technical content.

At PEMCO, we’re all about people – our customers, our employees, and the community. We’re a mutual insurance company owned by our Northwest policyholders. We provide auto, home, renters, and boat coverage. Recognized by Forbes as one of America’s Best Insurance Companies in both Auto and Home for 2026, based on customer survey feedback, and by Newsweek as one of America’s Greatest Midsize Workplaces 2025. We are consistently recognized for our outstanding customer service, employee expertise, community partnerships, and social impact programs. All of which makes PEMCO a great place to work!

Our social impact programs motivate high achievement by youth in education; build stronger and greener communities; and increase safety at home, on the road, and at play. These efforts create and cultivate an environment that builds fairness and understanding, encourages collaboration and flexibility, and celebrates all the ways in which we’re different and the same – enabling all individuals to achieve their full potential.

Why We Need You:

The Principal Product Analyst position is responsible for conducting complex quantitative analysis of property & casualty products to improve product performance and support PEMCO's and Product's initiatives. As a principal level role, this position helps to shape Product strategy through data analysis and guide product development with relevant analytical insights.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Represent the Product department in development of company data strategy; serve as catalyst of change for Product data warehousing and processes.

  • Present analysis and data visualizations to stakeholders and executives clearly and persuasively.

  • Mentor less experienced analysts, helping them improve and sharpen their skills by sharing best practices.
  • Demonstrate behaviors consistent with PEMCO's policies, values, code of ethics and business conduct.
  • Authentically support the PEMCO Brand and constantly are on the lookout for top talent to join us to achieve our Mission to Worry Less and Live More.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What You'll Bring:

  • B.A. or B.S. degree or equivalent work experience (Business, Economics, mathematics, or other quantitative fields of study) is required

  • Graduate or other professional degree or equivalent work experience is preferred

  • 10+ years of experience in corporate analytical roles with increasing scale, scope and complexity involving pricing insurance products (or similar work) including experience in integrating, managing and manipulating large data files from various corporate systems and external sources is required

  • 5 years of experience in the property and casualty insurance industry is required

  • Organized: Has excellent time management skills and easily manages multiple tasks, activities, and projects is required

  • Business Environment: Has a thorough understanding of our industry, the relevant business landscape, trends in growth and insurance environments; the ability to spot early indicators of change and apply strategies to adapt quickly is required

  • Compliance: Knowledge and understanding of relevant laws, rules, and regulations is required

  • MS Office: Skilled proficiency in Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook is required

  • Job specific: Skilled proficiency in SQL, SQL Server, and data visualization is required

  • Problem Solver: Ability to analyze, diagnose and resolve complex unstructured problems quickly, efficiently, and collaboratively is required

  • Communicator: The ability to communicate clearly and informatively, verbally and in writing, with colleagues, customers, and the community in both technical and non-technical professional language is required

  • Presenter: Organizes data visually and speaks clearly and persuasively in group presentations and meetings with multiple peer groups and senior management is required

  • Job specific: Ability to demonstrate high level of skill in quantitative modeling, knowledge of data structures and ability to write complex SQL queries is required

  • Precision: Is detail orientated and has a strong desire for accuracy and thoroughness is required

  • Independent: Is highly self-motivated and self-directed. The ability to work with limited direction and communicate relevant information to the appropriate levels during times of uncertainty is required

  • Highly Analytical: Is passionate about working with disparate datasets bringing data together to answer business questions. Collaborates to create, manage, and translate data to meaningful insights. Can work with external vendors to integrate data for analysis; knows how to build efficient and scalable infrastructure and data models is required

  • Analytical and data-driven: Thinks analytically; a structured thinker who can put complex ideas into clear frameworks; uses data to conduct root cause analysis and develops high quality, consumable, and consistent metrics that drive strategic objectives and priorities is required

  • Organizational Savvy: Interfaces cross-functionally with both technical depth and business savvy. Understands company goals and objectives; thinks critically about business challenges and resolutions. Demonstrates keen listening and observation skills

  • Job specific: Proficiency in Power BI, Tableau, and WTW Radar is preferred

  • Greater Seattle area target pay range: $140,768 - $172,050. The full pay range is $117,307 - $195,511.

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Quality Compliance Senior Manager

What you will do

Let’s do this! Let’s change the world! The Senior Manager leads the Quality Intelligence Center (QuIC) integrated quality oversight operating model and the governed signal-to-action lifecycle through which QuIC-generated signals, trends, dashboard outputs, and emerging quality insights are reviewed, contextualized, triaged, routed, monitored, and closed.

The role leads the QuIC team and establishes business standards, review routines, governance inputs, decision pathways, and cross-functional ways of working required to embed QuIC into R&D Quality oversight.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead the day-to-day operation of the QuIC function and manage a professional team responsible for portfolio-level quality monitoring.
  • Own and continuously improve the QuIC operating model, including review cadence, signal triage, documentation expectations, escalation pathways, action tracking, and governance routines.
  • Establish consistent review cadences and business standards for evaluating dashboard outputs, quality metrics, trends, anomalies, threshold breaches, and other QuIC-generated signals.
  • Lead the review and prioritization of dashboard outputs, quality metrics, trends, anomalies, and threshold breaches to identify issues requiring further assessment or follow-up.
  • Translate complex quality information, including deviations, CAPAs, audit and inspection insights, operational metrics, and related evidence, into clear, governance-ready summaries, recommendations, and escalations.
  • Ensure that significant findings are appropriately documented, escalated, and routed to accountable process owners and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Define and propose QuIC business rules, operating standards, documentation expectations, escalation pathways, and workflow requirements; ensure changes requiring controlled approval are reviewed through the appropriate accountable Quality governance.
  • Partner with R&D Quality, Global Development Operations, and other stakeholders to ensure QuIC insights are understood and acted upon.
  • Lead process improvements and provide business leadership for QuIC enhancements, including signal definitions, thresholds, business rules, data-quality expectations, training, and adoption activities.
  • Monitor the effectiveness, timeliness, quality, and capacity of oversight activities and implement practical improvements where needed.
  • Ensure activities comply with applicable GxP, quality-system, data-governance, and internal procedural requirements.

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The dynamic professional we seek is an individual with these qualifications.

We deliver transformative outcomes for our planet and its people through trusted partnerships and creative campaigns. Rooted in California and expanding across Western North America and beyond, we have a 25-year track record of supporting initiatives at every scale. We also host fiscally sponsored projects that reach across the globe, reinforcing the efforts of change makers worldwide.

Addressing three interconnected crises — climate change, biodiversity loss, and environmental injustice — requires creativity, collaboration, and fast reflexes. With deep operational expertise and the confidence of donors and partners, we enable lasting solutions to rise.

Position Summary:

The Technology Operations Director is responsible for ensuring RLF, FBF, and SAF have the technology, operations, and systems needed to support their missions.

Reporting to the Chief of Staff and Operations and serving as a member of the leadership team, the Technology Operations Director provides strategic leadership over information technology and cybersecurity, with a particular focus on building a vision for and moving large-scale technology and systems projects from concept to completion. The Director serves as a trusted advisor to the organization and its fiscally sponsored projects, bringing an operational and technology lens to organizational decision-making. They balance innovation, flexibility, and speed with security, discipline, and care, helping RLF grow and deliver complex grantmaking and fiscal sponsorship services, support a “remote-first” staff, and achieve programmatic outcomes.

This is a full-time, exempt position that can be performed remotely within the U.S. Travel is required quarterly for meetings, conferences, and staff retreats.

Duties Include:

Technology & Systems Leadership

  • Serve as the organization's lead on major technology and systems initiatives.
  • Develop and align long-term technology and operational goals and projects with organizational objectives and strategy; build the roadmaps, timelines, and change-management plans needed to deliver them.
  • Serve as a cross-functional partner to other directors and fiscally sponsored project staff in selecting and utilizing tech platforms.
  • Manage technology to support evolving business needs; maintain knowledge of emerging trends and tools to enhance productivity.
  • Identify new operational system needs, including systems and processes to support connectivity in a remote-first workplace.
  • Manage information technology contractors and support services.
  • Oversee CRM/database (Salesforce) design, maintenance, and management, in partnership with the Director of Grants Management and the Director of Development.
  • Advance the technological fluency of staff.

Cybersecurity and Risk Management

  • Devise security policies, procedures, hardware, and software solutions to mitigate cybersecurity and other enterprise risks.
  • Drive data privacy compliance and business continuity/disaster recovery planning.
  • Advise organizational leadership on technology strategy, operational risk, and resource allocation.
  • In compliance with RLF policies and procedures, perform technological tasks necessary for the protection of data.

Facilities Oversight

  • Oversee staff managing the RLF satellite office in Sacramento and approximately five additional leases.
  • Oversee staff managing co-working locations.
  • Play a supportive role on staff retreats and other in-person connections.
  • In collaboration with Human Resources, oversee RLF's health and safety programs.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Provide oversight and management of RLF's technology and operations budget.
  • Serve as a member of the organizational Leadership Team.
  • Build strong working relationships across the organization to ensure technology and operational solutions serve the varied needs of each team.
  • Act as a trusted advisor and translator between technical/operational teams and non-technical staff and leadership.

Qualifications:

Note: These qualifications are guidelines, not hard and fast rules, so if you have 75% of the qualifications listed, we encourage you to apply. Experience can include paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work and lived experiences that helped you to build the competencies, knowledge, and skills needed for this position. Applying gives you the opportunity to be considered.

  • 10+ years leading and managing technology and/or operations teams, with at least 5 years in a director-level or above role; nonprofit or mission-driven sector experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to move complex technology and systems projects from planning through implementation and adoption (e.g., ERP, CRM/Salesforce, financial systems, infrastructure migrations) at organizations of comparable size (50–200 staff) or larger.
  • Experience leading the development and implementation of an organization-wide cybersecurity/data protection policy, with direct experience managing security incidents, vendor risk assessments, and compliance with relevant data protection standards.
  • Hands-on experience evaluating and implementing enterprise software platforms, including grants management systems or other CRMs; Salesforce experience strongly preferred.
  • 3+ years experience preferred working with a fiscal sponsor organization or comparable multi-entity structure, with direct exposure to how technology, operations, and facilities needs vary across sponsored projects with distinct programs, funding sources, and compliance requirements.
  • Experience managing vendor relationships/contracts (IT, real estate, professional services) with demonstrated negotiation outcomes.
  • Experience directly supervising staff and teams.
  • Ability to handle sensitive personnel or organizational matters.
  • Experience presenting to or advising senior leadership/board-level audiences.
  • Experience operating in a remote-first or hybrid and growth-stage organization.
  • A commitment to a work environment free from discrimination, where all team members feel welcomed, valued, and respected.
  • Positive attitude and a commitment to being part of and building a positive work environment.

Commitment to Nondiscrimination:

We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination, where all team members feel valued, respected, and included. We know that our work is enriched by the varied voices and perspectives of every staff and board member, so we are committed to making an earnest effort to recruit, welcome, train, develop, and retain talented individuals from all backgrounds. We believe that a welcoming culture expands our creative capacity to do our work and achieve greater outcomes for people and the natural world.

Compensation and Benefits:

The anticipated salary range for the Technology Operations Director is $180,000 - $210,000 annually. The final offer will depend on work location, experience, and job-related qualifications.

We have an alternate Fridays off work schedule and offer a comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k plan with a 5% match, and generous paid time off. RLF also offers a technology allowance, student loan repayment assistance, the Calm app, mental health benefits and approximately 16 paid holidays per year.

Please provide a resume and cover letter explaining how your skills fit this position.

Job Description:

The Saab, Inc. Talent Acquisition team seeks a motivated, detail-oriented Senior Recruiter with a passion for identifying, engaging, and hiring high-caliber technical talent while delivering an exceptional candidate and hiring manager experience. As part of our growing HR organization, this role will support hiring with a particular focus on Engineering and Operations.


The Senior Recruiter will partner closely with hiring managers, leaders, HR Business Partners, and cross-functional stakeholders to understand workforce requirements, develop targeted talent strategies, and build strong pipelines for highly specialized and business-critical positions. The ideal candidate brings demonstrated experience recruiting for engineering, operations, and other specialized professional roles, along with the ability to effectively source both active and passive talent in competitive markets. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced recruiter who understands technical talent markets and is eager to contribute to a fast-paced, purpose-driven environment supporting Saab, Inc.’s mission of keeping people and society safe.


This is a remote position, with a preference for candidates located within the Eastern or Central Time Zone. This role requires the ability to travel up to 15%.


Responsibilities:


  • Partner closely with hiring managers and leaders to understand workforce plans, role requirements, organizational priorities, and talent needs.
  • Develop and execute targeted recruiting and sourcing strategies predominantly but not limited to engineering, technical, program management, and specialized professional positions.
  • Identify, engage, and cultivate passive candidates using LinkedIn, internal talent databases, search techniques, market research, professional networks, and other sourcing tools.
  • Build and maintain high-quality technical talent pipelines for current and anticipated hiring needs, including hard-to-fill and specialized positions.
  • Conduct market research and talent mapping to understand technical skill availability, competitive talent markets, compensation trends, and sourcing opportunities.
  • Partner with hiring managers to establish effective assessment strategies, interview approaches, candidate profiles, and selection criteria.
  • Review resumes and conducts initial candidate screens to assess technical qualifications and alignment with role and organizational requirements.
  • Serve as a trusted talent advisor to hiring managers, providing insight into talent availability, candidate quality, compensation considerations, competitive hiring conditions, and recruiting strategy.
  • Manage candidate activity throughout the recruiting lifecycle, ensuring timely communication and a high-quality candidate experience.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date candidate information, activity, disposition, and recruiting documentation within Workday.
  • Partner with HR Business Partners and compensation team to support compensation analysis and offer development and negotiation.
  • Assist with recruiting events, technical networking initiatives, employer branding activities, university/campus outreach, and other programs designed to strengthen Saab, Inc.’s technical talent pipeline.
  • Contribute to broader Talent Acquisition initiatives, process improvements, and programs that enhance the organization's ability to attract and retain high-performing technical talent.

Compensation Range: $92,000 - $115,000


The compensation range provided is a general guideline. When extending an offer, Saab, Inc. considers factors including (but not limited to) the role and associated responsibilities, location, and market and business considerations, as well as the candidate's work experience, key skills, and education/training.

Skills and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree required with 8+ years of experience preferred in recruiting and sourcing, or a master’s degree with 6+ years of relevant experience.
  • Significant recruiting experience within complex corporate environments, with a strong preference for experience recruiting engineering and operations talent. Experience within defense, aerospace, technology, engineering, manufacturing, or other highly regulated or specialized industries is preferred.
  • Demonstrated strength in sourcing and recruiting passive talent, with a proven ability to identify, engage, and close highly sought-after talent through Boolean search, strategic sourcing, market research, talent mapping, networking, and other targeted recruiting strategies.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with engineering leaders, hiring managers, HR Business Partners, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Proficiency with applicant tracking systems and recruiting technology; Workday experience preferred, not required.
  • Strong interpersonal, relationship-building, influencing, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple requisitions and competing priorities while maintaining attention to detail and delivering against deadlines.
  • Strong sense of ownership, accountability, discretion, and professionalism.

Citizenship Requirements:

Must be a U.S. citizen, Permanent Resident (green card holder), or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Drug-Free Workplaces:

Saab is a federal government contractor and adheres to policies and programs necessary for sustaining drug-free workplaces. As a condition of employment, candidates will be required to pass a pre-employment drug screen.

Benefits:

Saab provides an excellent working environment offering professional growth opportunities, competitive wages, work-life balance, a business casual atmosphere and comprehensive benefits.

Highlights include:

  • Medical, vision, and dental insurance for employees and dependents

  • Generous paid time off, including 8 designated holidays

  • 401(k) with employer contributions

  • Tuition assistance and student loan assistance

  • Wellness and employee assistance resources

  • Employee stock purchase opportunities

  • Short-term and long-term disability coverage

About Us:

Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world. In the U.S., Saab delivers advanced technology and systems, supporting the U.S. Armed Forces and the Federal Aviation Administration, as well as international and commercial partners. Headquartered in Syracuse, New York, the company has business units and local employees in ten U.S. locations.

Saab is a company where we see diversity as an asset and offer unlimited opportunities for advancing in your career. We are also a company that respects each person’s needs and encourage employees to lead a balanced, rewarding life beyond work. Saab values diversity and is an Affirmative Action employer for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. Saab is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, all qualified individuals are encouraged to apply and will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, age, veteran, disability status, or any other federal, state, or locally protected category.
