VP, Product Management, Profitability


AI is changing how professional firms price, staff, deliver, and get paid for their work. As the VP, Product Management, Profitability, you will own the product portfolio behind Intapp Time, Intapp Billstream, and the Intapp Celeste capabilities applied to profitability. Your mandate is to move these products from systems that record and review work to agentic systems that govern revenue from capture through invoice. You will report to the General Manager of the Profitability Business Unit.

Day to day, you will set the roadmap, lead and develop a team of product managers, and partner with Engineering, Services, Product Marketing, and Sales to ship product and own the outcomes it produces after launch. This role calls for deep work-to-cash product leadership, AI product management, and the credibility to represent the product with clients, analysts, and partners.


What you will do

As a VP, Product Management, Profitability, you can expect to:

  • Own the product roadmap across Intapp Time, Intapp Billstream, and Celeste-powered profitability capabilities, with deep ownership of the work-to-cash domain from pricing and scoping through time capture, work in process, pre-bill review, and collections. Sequence the roadmap against revenue commitments and launch milestones, and defend tradeoffs with evidence.
  • Build and lead the product management team. Hire, level, coach, and develop product managers against a clear standard for discovery, problem statements, pricing and packaging input, launch readiness, and post-launch outcome ownership.
  • Make AI-native product judgment a repeatable discipline. Establish how the team specifies agent behavior, sets confidence and escalation thresholds, instruments quality, and meets the governance and auditability standards professional firms expect of AI.
  • Run execution across functions. Partner with Engineering on velocity, quality, and release commitments, with Services on deployment and migration, and with Product Marketing and Sales on launch and field readiness. Own product health and the monthly product review for the business unit.
  • Serve as the senior product voice with clients, prospects, analysts, and partners, and bring what you learn in those conversations back into the roadmap as evidence.

What you will need

Intapp is looking for intellectually curious, self-motivated professionals who like to get hands-on to contribute to the overall success of the business and their team. To apply for this VP, Product Management, Profitability role, you will ideally have:

  • Product management leadership in B2B enterprise software, including leading a team through a platform or architectural transition and owning the roadmap for products with a large installed base, such as migration, end-of-life, and modernization programs.
  • Direct product ownership of billing, invoicing, revenue capture, pricing, or order-to-cash and work-to-cash systems, with commercial fluency in pricing, packaging, and the economics of professional firms.
  • A track record of building the product management function itself: hiring, leveling, coaching, and raising the standard of practice across a team.
  • Experience taking AI or machine learning products from concept to adoption, including specifying agent behavior and designing for governance, auditability, and human oversight.
  • Technical fluency across data platforms, APIs, integrations, and enterprise architecture, enough to hold your position in build-versus-integrate decisions.
  • Credibility with clients, analysts, and partners, and the ability to carry a product narrative in front of firm leadership. Experience in a regulated industry or professional services firm is preferred, and legal tech or law firm experience is a strong plus.

jobs.excerpt: Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners.
jobs.description:
Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners.
We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.
Since launching publicly in September 2023, Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue, with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.
Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved.
Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.
- Mission-critical problems: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale.
- High bar, low ego: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership.
- Speed over comfort: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results.
- Enduring impact: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses.

Team & Locations

We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote.

Flex Fuels Ambition.

About the role

Flex is hiring its first KYC Analysts, and you'll help shape a function that's still taking form.

This is a net-new function. As one of the first members of the KYC team, you'll own how Flex decides who gets in the door: the gatekeeper for every new account application, and the reviewer whenever an existing account is flagged. You'll report directly to the Head of Financial Crimes, work side by side with the people who built our financial crime program, and have real say in how it grows.

Every business owner who opens a Flex account passes through work you do. When an application is rated high or moderate risk, you'll check that the details hold up, collect documentation for every flag, and make the call on whether the customer is safe to onboard. Accuracy and speed both matter, and you'll be the one who figures out how to deliver both at once.

The scope here is bigger than a typical analyst role, because the function is still being built. Your first priority will be working through our review backlog and keeping onboarding moving. As you get your footing, you'll have the chance to improve our procedures and help shape how the team operates.

This is a strong fit if you have a few years in KYC, onboarding, or customer due diligence and want to grow from running a process into helping design one, with a path into broader program responsibilities as the team grows.

What you'll own

You'll own KYC decisions at Flex end to end, and over time you'll help shape how the function runs.

  • The function itself. Own onboarding and review decisions from application through approval, and help set the standard for what a strong KYC file looks like here.

  • The process. Improve our procedures as you go: flag what's clunky and help document and simplify it.

  • The queue and its quality. Work the manual-review queue with an eye on both quality and speed, so good customers get onboarded fast and risk gets the scrutiny it deserves.

  • The feedback loop. Spot patterns across the cases you see, bring them to Risk, Operations, and leadership, and help turn them into better detection and faster reviews.

What you'll do

Make the call on who we onboard

  • Review new applications that our risk rating sends to manual review, and validate answers against documents and public sources

  • Gather documentation for every flag, so each high-risk answer is backed by a valid explanation before we onboard the customer

  • Run KYC and KYB reviews: verify identity documents, and identify beneficial owners and control persons through registry and public records

  • Work flagged accounts after opening, plus periodic refresh and event-driven reviews, and decide whether to clear, request more information, or escalate

  • Identify customers who warrant enhanced due diligence (EDD) and escalate them to supervisory review

Investigate and document

  • Research customers using public sources, including adverse media, sanctions lists, and politically exposed person (PEP) databases

  • Resolve screening hits by separating true matches from false positives, and document your reasoning

  • Write case notes so clear and well supported that a reviewer or bank partner can follow your decision without a call

  • Keep accurate, complete records in our case management system

Support the program

  • Partner with Support, Risk, and Operations to close open documentation requests and keep onboarding moving

  • Support quality assurance and file reviews, including for our bank partner program

  • Find process gaps and patterns that slow reviews or limit detection coverage, and turn them into simpler procedures

  • Stay current on evolving AML typologies and regulatory guidance, and bring what you learn back to the team

What we're looking for

You're comfortable with ambiguity, make sound business decisions with incomplete information, and want to help bring order to a function that's still taking shape.

You have

  • 1–3+ years in KYC, customer due diligence, onboarding, or a related financial crimes role at a financial institution, fintech, or payments company, with exposure to business (KYB) onboarding or BaaS program compliance

  • Working knowledge of KYC/CDD requirements and BSA/AML obligations

  • Experience researching entities and individuals from public sources, and screening for adverse media, sanctions, and PEP exposure, using KYC or screening tools (for example, Sardine, Alloy, Unit21, or similar)

  • Strong written communication: you can explain a risk decision in plain language and summarize complex findings concisely

  • High attention to detail and real comfort with ambiguous or incomplete information

  • The ability to manage a queue, juggle multiple priorities, and prioritize well

  • A growth mindset and a self-driven approach: you don't wait to be handed the next problem, and when you see a clunky step you fix it and write down the better way

Bonus points

  • CAMS or another AML certification, completed or in progress

Why Join Us

Build something generational — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners.
Work on real money, real risk — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale.
Solve hard problems — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles.
True ownership — Small teams, high trust, real accountability.
Founder-level exposure — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors.
High bar, high taste — Move fast without cutting corners.
Elite peers — People here are builders, not tourists.
Real upside — Meaningful equity if you help build something big.

Enterprise SaaS Account Executive – US Food & Multi-Solution Sales

Remote | Full-Time | Base Salary: $120,000 | OTE: $240,000 (Uncapped Commission)

Join a mission-driven team that's transforming global compliance to promote consumer health and safety by providing over 30,000+ food, cosmetic, medical device, and drug companies in 190+ countries with compliance software and services. We are growing fast and seeking a high-performing Enterprise Account Executive to join our team.

We are looking for a driven, strategic, and results-oriented Enterprise SaaS Account Executive to join our growing US Sales organization.

Position Summary:

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced enterprise sales professional who thrives on developing new business, building relationships with executive decision-makers, and selling a broad portfolio of software and technology-enabled services.

While the primary focus will be on enterprise customers within the Food & Beverage industry, this role requires the ability to identify, position, and sell multiple Registrar Corp solutions across different product offerings and lines of business.

Our flagship compliance platform, ComplyHub, has experienced 60% year-over-year growth and is transforming how regulatory, quality, and procurement teams manage food safety and supplier compliance.

The ideal candidate is a proven new-logo hunter who can navigate complex enterprise sales cycles, uncover customer challenges, and position the right combination of SaaS, compliance technology, and professional services to deliver meaningful business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Sales & New Business Development

  • Own the complete enterprise sales cycle, from strategic prospecting and initial discovery through product demonstrations, proposal development, negotiation, and close.
  • Develop and execute a comprehensive territory and account strategy focused on acquiring new enterprise customers and consistently exceeding revenue targets.
  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline through proactive outbound prospecting, account-based selling, industry networking, referral partnerships, and targeted campaigns.
  • Engage senior executives and key stakeholders across regulatory affairs, quality assurance, procurement, operations, IT, and executive leadership.

Multi-Product & Solution Selling

  • Develop a strong understanding of Registrar Corp's portfolio of SaaS platforms, technology-enabled compliance solutions, regulatory services, and professional services.
  • Demonstrate the ability to sell multiple products and solutions across different lines of business, identifying opportunities where customers can benefit from a broader relationship with Registrar Corp.
  • Lead with customer business challenges rather than individual product features, positioning integrated solutions that address regulatory, operational, and technology needs.
  • Identify opportunities to bundle software and services to create greater customer value and increase overall deal size.

Consultative Selling & Customer Engagement

  • Build relationships with enterprise decision-makers and position Registrar Corp as a trusted strategic partner.
  • Understand competitive alternatives and effectively differentiate Registrar Corp's solutions.
  • Work closely with Product and Marketing teams to share customer feedback, identify emerging needs, and influence future solution development.
  • Negotiate complex commercial agreements while maintaining a strong focus on customer value and profitable growth.

Pipeline Management & Sales Execution

  • Maintain a consistent and healthy pipeline sufficient to achieve assigned sales quotas.
  • Execute disciplined outbound prospecting activities to continuously generate new enterprise opportunities.
  • Develop strategic account plans that identify key stakeholders, business challenges, competitive positioning, and opportunities for multiple solution offerings.

  • Demonstrate strong sales process discipline, including qualification, opportunity management, deal progression, and forecasting accuracy.
  • Collaborate with Sales Development, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, and Sales Leadership to accelerate opportunities and improve conversion rates.
  • Consistently meet or exceed individual activity, pipeline-generation, new-logo acquisition, and revenue objectives.

Required Qualifications:

Enterprise SaaS Sales Experience

  • 5+ years of successful B2B enterprise SaaS or technology-enabled solutions sales experience, with a demonstrated record of achieving or exceeding quota.
  • Proven ability to independently source, develop, and close complex enterprise opportunities.
  • Experience managing multistakeholder sales cycles involving executive decision-makers and cross-functional buying committees.

Multi-Solution Selling Experience

  • Demonstrated ability to sell multiple software products, technology solutions, or professional services rather than relying on a single-product sales approach.
  • Experience identifying customer needs across different departments and positioning complementary products or integrated solutions.
  • Strong ability to communicate the value of both SaaS subscriptions and service-based offerings.

New Business Development

  • Strong prospecting and new-logo acquisition capabilities, including cold outreach, account-based prospecting, networking, and strategic pipeline development.
  • Experience using sales intelligence and prospecting tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot, Salesforce, Salesloft, or similar platforms.

Consultative & Strategic Selling

  • Ability to translate complex software capabilities and regulatory requirements into clear business outcomes.

Operational Excellence

Preferred Qualifications:

Role Purpose:

The Senior Customer Success Manager will own a portfolio of enterprise and mid-market accounts across EMEA. This is not a relationship management role — it is a value consulting role. You will bring deep expertise in fraud, identity, and compliance to help customers design optimal identity strategies and realize measurable risk reduction outcomes. You will be expected to understand your customers’ business deeply, make the value Jumio delivers visible and quantifiable, and act as the connective tissue between the value that was promised during the sale and the value the customer achieves.

You will work closely with Account Managers on renewal and expansion, with the implementation team during the critical customer onboarding and adoption stages, and with Product and Support to close the loop on customer feedback. You will be a named owner of customer health — accountable for knowing which accounts are at risk, why, and what you are doing about it.

This role is well-suited to someone who is commercially-minded, data-fluent, and energized by the complexity of enterprise customer relationships. You will be joining at a moment of intentional transformation — there is a significant opportunity to shape how Jumio’s customer success motion operates going forward.

Responsibilities:Customer Health & Retention

  • Own the health of a portfolio of EMEA enterprise and mid-market accounts — you are accountable for knowing which are green, yellow, or red and why

  • Own escalation when product gaps or recurring issues are impacting customer outcomes — and close the feedback loop by communicating back to the customer what Jumio is doing

  • Advise customer risk and fraud teams on emerging fraud vectors, industry best practices, and regulatory developments relevant to their business
  • Evaluate customer risk profiles and provide expert recommendations on verification workflow optimization, risk mitigation, and user friction tradeoffs
  • Identify compliance and regulatory hurdles that may impact product adoption and coordinate with internal teams to resolve them.

Value Realization & ROI

  • Confirm customers are seeing the outcomes they expected — pass rates, conversion improvement, fraud reduction, compliance — and make that value visible and quantifiable
  • Own the business outcomes scorecard for each account: track the metrics that matter to the customer and report on them proactively
  • Prepare and lead regular business reviews (EBRs) that drive decisions — not just report on usage
  • Connect Jumio’s performance back to the customer’s original business goals and make the ROI case clearly before the AM enters a commercial conversation
  • Address gaps between what was promised during the sale and what the customer is experiencing — proactively, not reactive

Adoption & Platform Success

  • Monitor feature adoption — ensure customers are using everything they paid for and that underutilized capabilities are proactively introduced
  • Train new users as the customer’s team grows or changes, and keep the customer current on new features and product updates relevant to their use case
  • Build a joint success plan aligned to the customer’s evolving business goals — a living document, not a one-time exercise

Relationships & Executive Engagement

  • Build and maintain multi-threaded relationships across the customer organization — not just the day-to-day contact
  • Expand relationships to business leaders and executives: a single-threaded account is a renewal risk
  • Identify and nurture champions within each account who will advocate for Jumio internally
  • Invite engaged customers into the Jumio community — user groups, advisory boards, reference programs

Expansion & Commercial Partnership

  • Spot signals that a customer is ready for more — new use cases, new geographies, increased volume, new compliance requirements
  • Surface expansion opportunities to the Account Manager with a clear business case grounded in the customer’s current deployment and proven value
  • Support the AM in building the commercial case for expansion — you have the customer relationship and the data; the AM has the commercial motion
  • Identify satisfied customers who could become references, case studies, or advisory board members

Skills, Experience and Qualifications:

  • Multiple years of practitioner experience in Fraud, Identity, AML, or Digital Risk Management — you have worked inside a fraud or compliance function, not just sold to one
  • Strong consultative and analytical thinking with a focus on risk strategy and workflow design
  • Ability to distill complex fraud and compliance concepts into clear, value-driven narratives for executive stakeholders
  • Proven track record managing enterprise accounts with $500K+ ARR — you have owned renewal conversations and have GRR/NRR data to support your candidacy
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct executive-level business reviews that drive outcomes, not just report activity
  • Experience building and maintaining customer health frameworks and success plans
  • Commercial acumen: you understand the connection between customer health and revenue, and you can have credible conversations with economic buyers
  • Data fluency: you are comfortable working with product usage data, building ROI narratives, and using a CS platform (Planhat, Gainsight, Totango, or equivalent)
  • Strong communication and executive presence — you are as comfortable presenting to the C-Suite as you are troubleshooting with a technical team
    Proactive by nature: you identify risks before customers do and you act without waiting to be asked

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with API-based or technically complex SaaS products — you do not need to be an engineer, but you need to be comfortable in technical conversations
  • Experience working in a PE-backed or high-growth transformation environment
  • Prior experience building or contributing to CS playbooks, health score models, or QBR frameworks

What Success Looks Like:

In your first 90 days:

  • You have a clear health rating for every account in your portfolio and a plan for every yellow and red account
  • You have met the key stakeholders at each account and established a regular operating cadence
  • You understand the business outcomes each customer is trying to achieve and whether Jumio is delivering them
  • You have identified the top 3 accounts at renewal risk and have an active plan in place

By end of year one:

  • GRR across your portfolio is at or above target
  • Every account has a current success plan, a health score, and an EBR cadence
  • You have surfaced expansion opportunities to the AM team with qualified business cases

Equal Opportunities:

About Jumio:

Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders.

jobs.excerpt: About Accelerant Accelerant is a data-driven risk exchange connecting underwriters of specialty insurance risk with risk capital providers.
jobs.description:
About Accelerant

Accelerant is a data-driven risk exchange connecting underwriters of specialty insurance risk with risk capital providers. Accelerant was founded in 2018 by a group of longtime insurance industry executives and technology experts who shared a vision of rebuilding the way risk is exchanged – so that it works better, for everyone. The Accelerant risk exchange does business across more than 20 different countries and 250 specialty products, and we are proud that our insurers have been awarded an AM Best A- (Excellent) rating. For more information, please visit .

We're looking for a Data Scientist to develop machine learning and AI systems that improve decisions across pricing, underwriting, portfolio management, operations, and claims. You'll work across structured data, text, documents, and external data sources, applying statistical modeling, modern machine learning, AI and agentic workflows to solve challenging real-world problems.

The foundation of this role is serious quantitative modelling. We care about calibration, not just discrimination. We validate out of time and worry about leakage and drift. We quantify uncertainty and can tell you when a model should be trusted, when it shouldn't, and why. LLMs and agentic systems are a force multiplier on all of that and we measure those systems the way we'd measure any other model: on data they haven't seen, against a sensible baseline, with honest uncertainty around the result. You don't need an AI background to join us; you do need genuine enthusiasm for working this way.

This is not a reporting or dashboard role. You'll work on ambiguous, high-impact problems where you'll be expected to identify the right approach, build production-ready solutions, and measure the business impact of your work.

If you enjoy messy data, difficult prediction problems, and building intelligent systems that make real-world decisions better, you will be a good fit.

What You'll Work On

Our team tackles a broad range of machine learning and AI problems. Depending on business priorities, you may work on projects such as:

  • Predictive modeling for pricing, underwriting, claims, catastrophe risk, and portfolio management
  • Classification, ranking, matching, recommendation, and anomaly detection systems that improve business decision-making
  • Information extraction from documents, emails, forms, and other unstructured data using modern AI techniques
  • Entity resolution, data enrichment, and building high-quality datasets from noisy or incomplete information
  • Design AI systems that automate analytical and decision-making workflows end to end. Build the measurement that tells us whether they genuinely outperform what they replace
  • Building production feature pipelines, model inference services, and evaluation frameworks
  • Collaborating with engineers, actuaries, underwriters, product managers, and business leaders to turn ambiguous questions into scalable machine learning solutions

What We're Looking For

You likely have experience with many of the following:

  • A strong quantitative foundation: statistics, probability, optimisation, or applied mathematics
  • Sound modelling judgement - you know what it takes for a model to hold up in the real world, not just on a validation set
  • Strong programming skills
  • Real willingness to work with LLMs and agentic AI as everyday tools, wherever your background sits today
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical audiences - you can explain a lift curve to an underwriter and a shrinkage prior to a statistician

Bonus Points

Experience in one or more of the following is especially valuable:

  • Track record with LLM-powered applications or AI agents, especially if you've done the unglamorous work of proving they perform
  • Depth in the statistical toolkit beyond supervised prediction: hierarchical models and shrinkage estimation, causal inference and experimentation, survival analysis, extreme value theory, or demand and elasticity modelling
  • Insurance domain knowledge: pricing, reserving, claims, underwriting, or distribution
  • Actuarial background or qualifications (partially or fully qualified)
  • Experience in regulated industries where model governance and explainability matter
  • ML engineering experience: taking models from research code to production services, or building the tooling and frameworks that help others deploy
  • Cloud and infrastructure skills: AWS, Azure, or GCP; containers and orchestration; APIs and data pipelines built with cost, latency, and reliability in mind
  • MLOps in practice: experiment tracking, model monitoring, automated retraining, and CI/CD for models and agent

Team Context

You'll join a lean, senior team with low bureaucracy and high autonomy. We're investing heavily in agentic AI as the next evolution of how a quantitative team operates, and you'll help shape that direction from the start.

Why Accelerant?

You'll have the opportunity to work on technically challenging problems that span the insurance value chain.

Here you'll find:

  • Diverse quantitative challenges across various domains
  • The freedom to explore the rapidly evolving ML & AI landscapes from gradient boosting and deep learning to foundation models and agentic systems, while remaining grounded in rigorous experimentation and measurable business impact

Job Summary

Ready to build sleek, enterprise-grade cloud applications that blend high-performance UI, cloud-native backends, and modern search architectures? RevStar is an AI-first innovation shop and AWS Advanced Tier Partner delivering end-to-end cloud, data, and AI solutions for forward-thinking clients. We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to build responsive React frontends, architect secure Node.js microservices, and integrate modern AWS search and data pipelines. In this role, you will work in an agile, client-facing environment where you turn complex business problems into production-grade digital products. Above all, the ideal candidate embodies RevStar’s core values:

  • Self-Mastery: We hold a high bar for how we think, communicate, and improve.
  • Ownership: We own outcomes, not just effort.
  • Shared Destiny: We rise or fall together.

Your Impact Pillars

Your engineering contribution is organized into four core pillars:

1. Frontend Architecture & UI Delivery

  • Build performant, accessible, and responsive web applications in ReactJS using modern JavaScript and TypeScript patterns.
  • Translate Figma mockups into reusable component libraries that drive consistent user experiences across client products.
  • Optimize client-side performance, state management, and user interaction flows.

2. Backend Engineering & AWS Integration

  • Design and deploy secure, scalable RESTful APIs and backend microservices using Node.js, Express, and AWS serverless tooling (Lambda, API Gateway, ECS).
  • Model and manage structured and unstructured data using SQL and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, RDS, S3).
  • Maintain robust CI/CD pipelines, GitHub workflows, and automated testing suites to ensure production-grade code quality.

3. Advanced Search & Data Workflows

  • Implement enterprise search, indexing, and data retrieval capabilities using Amazon OpenSearch and Kendra.
  • Collaborate with data engineers to build ETL pipelines that unify disparate client data sources into searchable, actionable architectures.
  • Integrate identity management and authentication best practices using AWS Cognito.

4. Agile Client Delivery & Collaboration

  • Partner directly with Product Managers, UX Designers, and client stakeholders to refine requirements and demo completed features.
  • Active participant in architecture reviews, sprint ceremonies, and team code reviews to elevate engineering standards across projects.

Requirements

What You Bring

  • Experience: 3–5+ years of professional full-stack engineering experience utilizing JavaScript and TypeScript.
  • Core Stack: Deep expertise in ReactJS, Node.js, Express, RESTful APIs, and database design (SQL & NoSQL).
  • AWS Cloud Depth: Proven track record building and deploying cloud-native applications on AWS infrastructure (Lambda, API Gateway, ECS, S3).
  • Consulting Mindset: Excellent written and verbal communication habits with experience (or strong desire) working in client-facing agile teams.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in client-facing roles or consulting environments
  • Expertise with OpenSearch, Kendra, or similar search/indexing services
  • Experience implementing semantic search or working with LLMs in search pipelines
  • Familiarity with AWS Glue, Athena, Step Functions, or other ETL tooling
  • Working knowledge of Cognito and identity management best practices
  • Experience with React Native or mobile-focused frontends
  • Exposure to HIPAA, SOC2, or other compliance environments

Benefits

  • Remote-First Working Environment – Collaborate from anywhere while staying connected with our global team.
  • Collaborative, Innovative Culture – Work alongside top talent in a fast-paced, supportive environment that values curiosity and initiative.

Since 2014, they have been helping organisations turn complex information into practical, memorable and enjoyable digital learning through a combination of instructional design, interactive technology, video, animation and custom software.

The business is currently expanding its development team to support the continued growth of its software products, including a digital learning marketplace and a learning creation platform.

Role Overview: Our client is looking for a hands-on Marketing Lead to build and execute the company's growth marketing strategy across website conversion, lead generation, email automation, and paid advertising.

This is an execution-focused role for someone who can build landing pages, write compelling copy, launch campaigns, configure tracking, and analyse performance independently. Rather than managing agencies or relying on developers for day-to-day marketing execution, you will own the full marketing funnel—from attracting the right audience to converting prospects into active users and paying customers.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you will initially focus on attracting course creators to the company's course-building platform, while preparing the marketing foundations and audience for the subsequent launch of its learning marketplace. You will have the opportunity to shape the marketing function, test ideas quickly, and build a measurable acquisition engine from the ground up.

Key Responsibilities:

Website & Conversion Optimisation

  • Own and continuously improve the company's Webflow website, including site structure, messaging, landing pages, pricing pages, and basic SEO.
  • Build and launch landing pages for different audiences, campaigns, product editions, and course showcases without relying on a developer.
  • Run ongoing conversion tests on headlines, offers, page layouts, and calls to action to improve visitor-to-sign-up rates.
  • Implement and maintain website analytics, conversion events, advertising pixels, and UTM tracking to measure performance accurately.

Lead Generation & Email Marketing

  • Build lead capture pathways through free sign-ups, waitlists, course previews, webinars, and other relevant lead magnets.
  • Set up and optimise CRM workflows, audience segmentation, lead scoring, and automated email sequences.
  • Develop onboarding and nurture campaigns to convert new course creators into active users and prepare learners for the marketplace launch.
  • Identify and qualify business, university, and other enterprise enquiries, passing relevant opportunities to the CEO with appropriate context.

Paid Advertising & Campaign Management

  • Plan, launch, and manage paid campaigns across Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), Google Ads (Search and YouTube), and other relevant platforms such as LinkedIn and TikTok.
  • Develop and test ad copy, creative concepts, audience targeting, and campaign structures to generate qualified sign-ups at an efficient cost.
  • Create short-form videos and visual assets using existing product content and course demonstrations to support paid and organic campaigns.
  • Monitor campaign performance and manage advertising spend against acquisition costs, paying-user conversion, and return on ad spend.
  • Regularly review campaign results, pause underperforming activities, and scale campaigns that demonstrate sustainable returns.

Analytics, Reporting & Growth

  • Build and maintain a weekly marketing dashboard connecting advertising spend, website traffic, lead generation, sign-ups, and revenue.
  • Analyse funnel performance to identify drop-off points, acquisition opportunities, and areas for improvement.
  • Run structured experiments across messaging, offers, channels, and audiences, documenting findings and applying them to future campaigns.
  • Establish baseline performance metrics and work with the CEO to set realistic growth targets and marketing budgets.
  • Prepare the marketing strategy and launch campaigns for the company's upcoming learning marketplace.

Requirements

Required Skills and Qualifications:

Must Have:

  • At least 4 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing, growth marketing, or a closely related digital marketing role.
  • Demonstrated experience independently planning, building, and optimising paid advertising campaigns on both Meta Ads and Google Ads.
  • Able to demonstrate campaign performance using actual metrics, such as advertising spend, cost per lead, cost per sign-up, customer acquisition cost, or return on ad spend.
  • Experience building and optimising websites and landing pages using Webflow or similar platforms, with the ability to execute changes independently.
  • Practical experience with email marketing, CRM platforms, and marketing automation, such as HubSpot, Klaviyo, ActiveCampaign, or equivalent tools.
  • Strong working knowledge of GA4, conversion tracking, advertising pixels, UTM parameters, and marketing performance reporting.
  • Strong copywriting skills, with the ability to write clear, persuasive messaging for different audiences and stages of the customer journey.
  • Comfortable using AI tools regularly to accelerate copywriting, creative development, research, campaign optimisation, and performance analysis.
  • Analytical and commercially minded, with the ability to connect marketing activity to sign-ups, customer acquisition costs, and revenue.
  • Highly autonomous and comfortable building marketing systems from scratch, testing ideas, and taking ownership of results.

Nice to Have

  • Experience marketing SaaS products, ed-tech platforms, creator tools, online learning products, or subscription-based services.
  • Experience building acquisition funnels for free-to-paid conversions, trials, subscriptions, or digital marketplaces.
  • Short-form video editing and creative production skills for paid social and organic content.
  • Experience with LinkedIn Ads, B2B lead generation, or marketing to business and institutional audiences.
  • Experience marketing platforms that serve two audiences, such as creators and learners, sellers and buyers, or service providers and customers.

Description

Ledgebrook is an AI-native specialty insurance platform. When a business needs coverage that is custom and complex, its broker comes to us, and our underwriters give them an answer, often in hours rather than weeks.

We built our technology from scratch, with AI in it from the first line of code. The technology helps price the risk; the underwriter uses their judgment to decide. There are always two hands on the wheel.

We are insurance industry insiders, and we eat our own cooking: Ledgebrook writes the policy and shares the risk through our own carrier, Ledgebrook Specialty, rated A- (Excellent) by AM Best. We work exclusively through wholesale brokers.

Our vision: to make the wheels of insurance spin faster.

At Ledgebrook, everything we do is driven by our culture: Care, Strive, Thrive Together. To succeed in modernizing the industry, we must first succeed in changing the way we do business. Talent density is our north star—fewer, better people working together as one. To that end we’ve replaced all individual incentives with generous equity packages—we play as a team, we win as a team. Ledgebrook is seeking a Data Associate, Data Excellence to join our Product & Data team. On this team, you’ll lead analytical efforts to drive data informed decision-making across the entire organization by gathering, analyzing, and visualizing / presenting technical insurance data.

As a Data Associate, Data Excellence, you will collaborate with data engineering, insurance product, claims, finance and operations teams to improve data integrity and automate reporting capabilities using VBA, SQL and Python. A key part of your role will be transforming complex insurance data into clear, compelling insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders through required reporting and data visualization. Beyond reporting, you’ll conduct deep-dive data analysis, develop analytical tools, deliver dedicated solutions to help other departments automate their workflows, and identify opportunities to enhance business performance and operational effectiveness. You will also provide ad hoc analytical support and research as needed to ensure Ledgebrook continues to operate with data-driven precision.

About you

Here at Ledgebrook we are passionate about creating a team that is on a continuous learning journey and that shares our excitement about building a company from the ground up. Some of the characteristics we hold dear are:

  • A passion to deliver a world-class customer service experience to both internal and external customers

Requirements

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills to collaborate with stakeholders across the organization.

jobs.title: Business Analytics Manager
jobs.excerpt: At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality.
jobs.description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

We combine data-driven content, rigorous product comparisons and user-first design, supported by a modern, scalable technology and data platform. Our global teams bring together expertise across performance marketing, product, commercial operations, data and analytics.

Our Data & Analytics organisation builds the products, platforms and intelligence that support commercial decision making across the business.

Overview

We're looking for a Business Analytics Manager who can turn complex business performance data into clear insights, recommendations and better commercial decisions.

You'll lead a small team of Analysts working directly with our business verticals, acting as a trusted analytics partner to General Managers and their commercial teams. Your focus will be on helping the business understand its performance, identify opportunities for growth and make better decisions through accurate, actionable data.

This is a hands-on leadership role that combines commercial understanding, analytical expertise and stakeholder management. You'll help your team move beyond reporting what happened to explaining why it happened, what it means for the business and what we should do next.

The Opportunity

Our Business Analytics team works directly with General Managers and their teams to understand commercial performance and identify opportunities to improve profitability.

You'll manage a small team of Analysts aligned to different business verticals, helping them become trusted partners to their stakeholders while maintaining a consistent standard of analytical quality across the organisation.

A significant part of the role involves understanding how the business makes money, from traffic acquisition and customer journeys through to conversions, partner performance, revenue and profitability. You'll help ensure that commercial and financial reporting is accurate, explainable and trusted, working closely with Finance and other Data teams to investigate discrepancies and improve the underlying information.

You'll also work with senior stakeholders to translate business questions into clear analytical requirements, prioritise opportunities and turn complex findings into compelling stories and practical recommendations.

This is an opportunity to shape how Analytics supports the business, developing a team that proactively identifies opportunities rather than simply responding to reporting requests.

What You'll Do

Commercial Performance & Business Partnership

  • Act as a trusted analytics partner to General Managers and senior commercial stakeholders, helping them understand the drivers of revenue, profitability and business performance. You'll work with your team to identify trends, investigate changes in performance and recommend opportunities for growth, ensuring analysis is grounded in a strong understanding of how each business operates.

Financial Accuracy & Data Confidence

  • Help establish confidence in the commercial data used to manage the business. You'll work closely with Finance, Revenue Operations and Data Engineering to understand revenue, costs, partner performance and profitability, investigate discrepancies and ensure reporting is accurate and explainable. You'll champion analytical rigour while recognising the importance of delivering timely, practical information to stakeholders.

Business Insight & Storytelling

  • Guide your team in translating complex datasets into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences. You'll help Analysts move beyond dashboards and descriptive reporting to explain the underlying drivers of performance, challenge assumptions and communicate what the business should do next. You'll also help identify opportunities for deeper analysis, forecasting and experimentation.

Analytics Products & Business Requirements

  • Translate commercial questions into clear analytical requirements, working with Analytics, BI, Engineering and Data Science teams to develop scalable reporting and insight products. You'll help identify where reusable datasets, dashboards and analytical approaches can replace repetitive work, improve consistency and enabling stakeholders to access trusted information more independently.

Team Leadership & Prioritisation

  • Lead and develop a small team of vertical-aligned Analysts, supporting their technical development, commercial understanding and stakeholder relationships. You'll help prioritise work across business areas, balance immediate commercial needs with longer-term improvements, and ensure the team's capacity is focused on delivering the greatest value. You'll remain technically involved, reviewing analytical approaches and helping the team tackle complex problems.

What You'll Bring

We're looking for someone who combines strong analytical expertise with commercial judgement, excellent communication skills and the ability to lead a team.

You'll likely bring:

  • Experience in business analytics, commercial analytics or performance analytics, including experience managing or mentoring Analysts.
  • Strong commercial understanding, with experience analysing revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, sales performance or other key business drivers.
  • Experience working directly with senior business stakeholders, translating complex questions into analytical requirements and actionable recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to explain complex findings clearly and influence commercial decisions.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large, complex datasets.
  • Experience with BI and visualisation platforms such as Tableau, Power BI or Looker.
  • A strong understanding of data quality, reporting accuracy and the importance of reconciling commercial information with financial outcomes.
  • Experience prioritising analytical work across multiple stakeholders, balancing commercial urgency with analytical quality.
  • Experience coaching and developing Analysts, helping them build both technical capability and commercial confidence.
  • A proactive, curious approach to problem solving, with the ability to identify opportunities rather than simply respond to requests.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in performance marketing, affiliate marketing, lead generation or digital publishing.
  • Familiarity with marketing and acquisition data from platforms such as GA4, Google Ads, Meta or other advertising platforms.
  • Experience working with Finance, Revenue Operations or commercial reporting teams.
  • Experience analysing sales performance, partner economics, conversion funnels or customer profitability.
  • Python experience for statistical analysis, forecasting or more advanced analytical work.
  • Experience collaborating with Data Scientists on predictive modelling, experimentation or customer analytics.
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform, particularly BigQuery.
  • Experience developing reusable analytical products or self-service reporting capabilities.
  • Experience working with distributed teams and agile delivery processes.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to help shape how Analytics influences commercial decisions across a growing, data-driven business.

You'll work directly with senior business leaders on meaningful commercial challenges, lead a talented team of Analysts and collaborate with specialists across Engineering, BI, Data Science and Revenue Operations.

You'll have the opportunity to develop a Business Analytics function that goes beyond reporting, building trusted relationships, improving the quality of business information and helping our teams make better, faster and more profitable decisions.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Planning and Execution

· Ensures timely availability of high-quality study documents to allow study submission to regulatory authorities and ECs/IRBs

· Provides oversight to study start up and site activation plans

· Ensures study plans (eg project management plan, monitoring plan, Trial Master File plan, data monitoring plan, ...) are created, updated and distributed timely and implemented appropriately

· Ensures study systems and tools are set up timely, correctly and are functioning properly. Ensures study level information is updated on an ongoing basis in all systems

· Implements RBQM end-to-end processes on time within the allocated study (e.g., periodic reviews, centralized monitoring analyses, action items)

· Ensures relevant study specific training is developed and implemented and ensures training records are well documented and filed

Quality and Risk Management

· Regularly reviews and manages quality-related GCO metrics to be within acceptable limits

· Ensures inspection readiness at any point in time throughout the study life cycle

· Works with cross-functional study team to identify, interpret, and evaluate issues on the study and ensures corrective and preventative actions are implemented

· Ensures senior management and other key stakeholders are informed of risks and challenges and ensures risk mitigation plans are put in place and implemented

· Prepares team for quality assurance audits and inspections

· Collaborates with CST members and other colleagues to ensure cross-team, site learnings, and best practices are shared

· Leads improvements and partners with study team members to enhance the efficiency and the quality of the work performed on assigned studies

· Leads development, optimization and review of work instructions and SOPs as required

· Manages study budgets, including baseline budget evaluation, change control, study closure budget, presents study budget for senior management engagement

· Adheres to clinical study budgeting processes and provides input to finance on budget accruals and forecasts

· Identifies and manages study team resource needs and establishes contingency plans for key resources.

· Monitors Clinical Study Team resource utilization over the study life cycle

· Ensures clinical studies at a project level are executed within endorsed time, quality, and cost parameters

Computer Skills:

· Proven Project Management experience in Global Clinical Studies (Oncology experience preferred)

· Advanced knowledge of clinical operations methodologies, in depth understanding of all aspects of clinical study processes

· Able to independently lead global clinical studies

· 7+ or more years of progressive experience in clinical research within biotech, pharma or CRO industry

Travel:

Education Required:

*exceptions might be made for candidates with relevant clinical operations experience

ROLE SUMMARY:

The Application Developer plays a key role in designing, building, and maintaining our client's next-generation payments applications within the Microsoft Azure ecosystem. Working closely with the Senior Director of Application Development and Business Solutions, this role contributes to both modernization initiatives and the ongoing support of existing mission-critical systems that power Canada's credit union payments infrastructure.

Developers will work with modern technologies across React, .NET, and Azure cloud-native services to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performance solutions supporting five main payment streams (e-Transfer, Bill Pay, Cheque, Wires, Automated Funds Transfer (AFT)) and emerging payment innovations such as Open Banking, Digital ID, and Real-Time Rail.

This is a hands-on, collaborative role that values craftsmanship, clean design, and iterative development in an agile environment. Developers will be part of a growing team driving modernization and innovation across Canada's financial landscape.

This is a mostly remote role with occasional travel to the office when needed in Calgary or Toronto.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Software Development: Design, develop, test, and maintain cloud-native applications using C# and the .NET framework. Architect microservices-based solutions that leverage Azure services such as App Service, Azure Functions, AKS, Azure Blob Storage, and more.

Front-end Development: Build modern, responsive web applications using React or Angular. Integrate front-end components with backend services to create seamless user experiences.

Database Management: Design and optimize databases using Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL) for transactional data, along with developing efficient stored procedures, views, and queries to support application performance, scalability, and reporting needs.

Automated Testing: Implement and maintain automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines to ensure high-quality, secure, and performant applications

Code Review: Participate in and lead code reviews to maintain high code quality, enforce coding standards, and ensure best practices are followed throughout the development lifecycle

System Integration: Integrate cloud and on-premises services via RESTful APIs, messaging queues, and other integration patterns. Work with third-party services and libraries while minimizing unnecessary dependencies

Documentation: Write clear and concise technical documentation for reference and reporting purposes

Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, and other developers to deliver high-quality software that meets business requirements.

Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve application issues, bottlenecks, and performance problems in a timely manner

Support: Provide support for production environments, including 24/7 on-call support as needed, to ensure seamless operations and rapid incident resolution in alignment with established SLAs

EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

Minimum of 5 years experience developing in C# with a strong background in .NET and building cloud-native applications.

Practical experience deploying, monitoring, and maintaining applications in Microsoft Azure, with an understanding of scalability, performance, and security best practices.

Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks (such as React or Angular) is considered an asset.

Knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server, including complex query optimization, stored procedures, schema decision, and performance tuning.

Experience designing and developing reports and dashboards using Power BI, including data modeling, DAX, and integration with Azure-based data sources

Experience implementing automated testing frameworks (unit, integration, UI tests).

Strong understanding of OOP principles and design patterns

Experience with RESTful API design and implementation

Proficient in version control systems, particularly Git

Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development processes using tools such as JIRA or similar

Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:


CrowdStrike is looking for highly motivated, self-driven incident response leaders dedicated to building strong consulting teams, managing high-stakes client engagements, and protecting organizations against the most advanced attackers in the world. Our CrowdStrike Services team offers opportunities to lead complex investigations for Fortune 100 clients while mentoring and developing the next generation of incident response talent.


Am I an Incident Response Manager Candidate?


  • Are you an experienced leader who excels at managing high-performing incident response teams and client engagements?
  • Do you find yourself interested in and keeping up with the latest vulnerabilities and breaches?
  • Are you an experienced incident response practitioner looking to leverage your technical expertise while expanding your impact as a leader?

What You'll Do:


  • Provide technical leadership and oversight throughout incident response engagements, guiding investigative strategies, evaluating findings, ensuring effective execution and consistent delivery quality, and performing hands-on analysis when necessary.
  • Lead client onboarding, initial triage, and scoping for prospective clients to establish key deliverables, staffing needs, and resource allocation.
  • Effectively communicate with executives and other key stakeholders regarding investigation findings, technical considerations, and recommended actions.
  • Guide technical investigation strategies, including the development and application of threat hunting methodologies across various data sources.
  • Work under the direction of outside counsel to conduct intrusion investigations and support the preparation of accurate, defensible investigative findings.
  • Recruit, mentor, and develop consultants across technical forensics, analysis, and client engagement disciplines, providing ongoing performance feedback and supporting career progression.
  • Provide strategic, applicable, and feasible recommendations to help mature the security posture of organizations during and after an incident.
  • Produce and review high-quality written and verbal reports, presentations, recommendations, and findings to key stakeholders including customer management, regulators, and legal counsel.
  • Demonstrate industry thought leadership through blog posts, webinars, and other public speaking events.

What You'll Need:


Successful candidates must demonstrate the following technical, leadership, and consulting capabilities:

  • Proven leadership and people management experience in a cybersecurity consulting or incident response setting, with demonstrated ability to foster a collaborative, high-performing team environment.
  • Substantial hands-on incident response experience, with the technical depth to independently perform forensic analysis and other investigative tasks when necessary.
  • Experience leading complex incident response investigations, developing investigative strategies, and guiding technical teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and develop technical consultants, including providing performance feedback and supporting professional growth.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to balance competing priorities, staffing requirements, and client expectations.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly and effectively to executive leadership, legal counsel, and other stakeholders.
  • Experience managing client engagements, including coordinating technical resources, overseeing deliverables, and maintaining effective client relationships.
  • Cloud Incident Response: knowledge in any of the following areas: AWS, Azure, GCP incident response methodologies
  • Ability to independently assess technical findings, guide investigative decisions, and provide appropriate technical oversight.

Successful candidates must demonstrate substantial incident response experience and expertise in one or more of the following technical disciplines::

  • Incident Response: Experience conducting or managing incident response investigations involving targeted threats, including advanced persistent threats, organized cybercrime, and other malicious activity.
  • Computer Forensic Analysis: Experience using forensic analysis tools and methodologies in incident response investigations to determine the extent and scope of compromise.
  • Network Forensic Analysis: Strong understanding of network protocols and experience analyzing network traffic and associated logs using tools such as Bro/Zeek or Suricata.
  • Reverse Engineering: Knowledge of static and dynamic malware analysis techniques and their application to incident response investigations.
  • Incident Remediation: Experience developing customized tactical and strategic remediation recommendations for compromised organizations.
  • Network Operations and Architecture: Strong understanding of secure network architecture, infrastructure, and network operations.
  • Cloud Incident Response: Knowledge of incident response methodologies and investigative techniques across: AWS, Azure, and/or GCP environments.

jobs.description:
The Procurement Manager is responsible for managing and coordinating all procurement, subcontracting, and logistics activities for an offshore EPC project. The role ensures that materials, equipment, and services are procured in line with project requirements, technical specifications, schedule, cost objectives, and quality standards.
The position demands strong commercial acumen, supplier management expertise, and hands-on experience in sourcing for offshore engineering, fabrication, and construction scopes.

This role reports to the Project Director / Project Control & Services Manager and works closely with engineering, planning, construction, logistics, and QA/QC teams.

Key Responsibilities

1. Procurement Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and implement the Project Procurement Execution Plan (PEP) in alignment with EPC project milestones and client procedures.
  • Define procurement strategies for long-lead items, critical packages, and offshore construction materials.
  • Ensure procurement schedules are integrated into the overall project plan; track key material and vendor delivery milestones.
  • Develop and maintain supplier databases specific to offshore and marine supply chains.

2. Sourcing & Tendering

  • Prepare and issue Request for Quotation (RFQ) packages, ensuring clarity in scope, specifications, and delivery requirements.
  • Evaluate commercial bids in coordination with engineering (for technical compliance) and contracts (for commercial risk).
  • Lead technical-commercial alignment (TBE/CBE) and final negotiations with vendors and subcontractors.
  • Prepare and issue Purchase Orders (POs), Subcontracts, and Service Agreements in compliance with project terms and company policies.

3. Supplier & Subcontractor Management

  • Identify, prequalify, and manage suppliers and subcontractors for fabrication, coating, offshore installation, and marine equipment.
  • Monitor supplier performance in terms of delivery, quality, and documentation compliance.
  • Coordinate vendor data submittals, inspection test plans (ITPs), and shipping documentation with QA/QC and expediting teams.
  • Manage vendor kick-off meetings, progress reviews, and inspections (FATs/SATs).

4. Offshore Logistics & Materials Coordination

  • Interface with logistics and marine teams for the transport of heavy equipment, spools, and structures to offshore sites.
  • Ensure compliance with QatarEnergy and port authority regulations for import/export and offshore delivery documentation.
  • Monitor fabrication yard material receipts, storage, preservation, and issuance.
  • Coordinate with construction to ensure readiness of materials for offshore load-out and sail-away.

5. Contract & Cost Control

  • Ensure procurement activities are aligned with project budget and cash flow forecasts.
  • Maintain transparency and traceability in all procurement transactions.
  • Support claims, variations, and change order management from a procurement perspective.
  • Ensure cost optimization and timely reconciliation of purchase orders and commitments.

6. Leadership & Governance

  • Lead a team of buyers, expeditors, logistics coordinators, and procurement engineers.
  • Establish procurement KPIs and performance dashboards.
  • Ensure adherence to ISO 9001 and company procurement policies.
  • Report procurement status and material readiness to project management and client representatives.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelors degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or Business Administration.
  • Minimum 12 years procurement experience in EPC oil & gas projects, including 4 years in offshore environments (platforms, jackets, topsides, or subsea).
  • Proven track record in procurement and subcontract management for large EPC contracts.
  • Sound understanding of offshore fabrication, marine logistics, and installation supply chains.
  • Proficient in ERP systems (SAP / Oracle / IFS) and procurement modules.
  • Familiarity with QatarEnergy / ADNOC / ARAMCO procurement standards.
  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and leadership skills.

Preferred Certifications

  • CIPS / ISM or equivalent professional procurement certification.
  • PMP® or CCP (Certified Cost Professional) an advantage.
  • Offshore survival (BOSIET/HUET) & H2S certification (preferred).

Key Competencies

  • Strategic sourcing and supplier development.
  • Strong negotiation and contract management.
  • Knowledge of offshore material specifications and logistics.
  • Leadership and team management.
  • Excellent communication, reporting, and stakeholder coordination.

Job Description:

Transactional Accountant (VSG HU)

ABOUT VESTA SOFTWARE GROUP

The Vesta Software Group acquires, manages, and builds software companies in a variety of vertical markets, enabling them to be clear leaders in their industries. Our companies provide mission-critical enterprise solutions for vertical industries across the entire industry value chain.

Being a portfolio group of Jonas Software (within Constellation Software Inc.), the Vesta Software Group is all about strengthening businesses within the markets in which we compete and enabling them to grow – whether through organic measures such as new initiatives and product development, day-to-day business, or through acquisitions.

POSITION

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Transactional Accountant to support the finance operations of Ceres Software Group’s Hungarian business units. This full-time role will be responsible for day-to-day transactional accounting activities, including supplier invoice processing, bank reconciliations, customer and supplier account reconciliations, VAT support, and month-end close activities.

Reporting to the Transactional and Credit Control Manager (based in UK), the successful candidate will play an important role in ensuring accurate and timely accounting for our Hungarian entities, while also supporting the integration of newly acquired businesses into Vesta’s finance processes and systems. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with Hungarian accounting experience who would like to develop within an international, fast-growing software portfolio.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

This is a multi-faceted role across multiple Vesta companies, where the post holder will be expected (but is not limited) to:

Accounts Payable

  • Review, verify and post supplier invoices in the ERP system, ensuring appropriate matching to purchase orders, goods receipt documentation and approved authorization workflows

  • Resolve discrepancies and deal with supplier queries

  • Prepare supplier payments for authorization and subsequent processing

  • Reconcile supplier statements and investigate outstanding items.

Banking and Cash Management

  • Reconcile bank accounts, including foreign currency accounts

  • Process and post daily bank transactions, including foreign currency transactions

  • Carry out sales invoicing and cash allocation activities where required

  • Monitor customer balances and assist with collection activities where required.

Account Reconciliations

  • Reconcile customer and supplier accounts

  • Update Excel-based reconciliation and support schedules.

Financial Reporting and Month-End Close

  • Assist with the preparation and reconciliation of VAT returns, EC Sales Lists and other statutory tax reports as required

  • Support month-end close activities, including reconciliations and preparation of supporting schedules

Process Improvement and Business Support

  • Implement improvements to existing processes and systems as required

  • Contribute to integration activities for newly acquired business units

  • Create and maintain strong working relationships with finance and business stakeholders

  • Undertake ad hoc finance duties as required

  • Contribute to the success of the overall corporate strategy.

Compliance

  • Ensure accounting transactions are recorded in compliance with Hungarian accounting and tax requirements

  • Stay informed of relevant accounting, tax and regulatory changes applicable to the role and support the implementation of required process updates.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS

  • Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or accounting qualification (e.g. Hungarian Chartered Accountant) would be advantageous

  • Previous experience in an Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Bookkeeping or Transactional Accounting role

  • Experience performing bank, supplier and customer account reconciliations

  • Experience preparing Hungarian VAT returns and supporting reconciliations would be advantageous

  • Experience with local statutory requirements, supplier invoice processing, bank reconciliation, and local bookkeeping practices

  • Commercial awareness and analytical mindset

  • Strong Excel skills

You’ll be joining an environment where you’ll have room to shape how these partnerships grow, but you’ll also be expected to create momentum without waiting for a fully formed playbook.

  • The ability to move between strategy and hands-on execution.

jobs.excerpt: Who We Are:Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Platform team, you will build and own the frameworks, tooling, and CI/CD infrastructure that let Alpaca’s engineers ship new features quickly and reliably. This is a software engineering role at its core: you will spend most of your time writing Go, designing automated test frameworks, and digging into application code and Kubernetes when needed. Just as importantly, you will help redefine how we use AI to raise the bar on quality - leveraging LLMs and AI-driven tooling to generate tests, catch regressions before they ship, and turn every incident into durable, automated coverage. We are looking for engineers who treat quality as an engineering discipline and see AI as a force multiplier for it - people who build the systems that make testing fast, reliable, and effortless for the teams that depend on them.

Things You Get To Do

  • Design and build automated test frameworks across our REST and gRPC API surface.
  • Leverage AI and LLM-based tooling to accelerate test generation, harden regression coverage, and turn production incidents into automated tests - embedding these practices into the frameworks the whole engineering org relies on.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines - we use a mix of GitHub Actions and Google Cloud Build.
  • Design and execute load, stress, and scalability tests to ensure our platform can handle growing demand.
  • Introduce chaos engineering practices - designing fault-injection and resilience experiments that surface failure modes before our customers do.
  • Standardize tooling and infrastructure to improve the day-to-day developer experience.
  • Partner with other teams to raise test coverage, reliability, and speed across services.
  • Dig into application code to root-cause failures and drive fixes to completion.
  • Mentor and guide product engineers, fostering a culture of quality and continuous improvement.

Who You Are (Must-Haves)

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a software engineer building and maintaining production systems.
  • You have written code in strongly typed languages and have at least 1 year of experience with Go.
  • You are fluent with AI-assisted engineering - you actively use LLM-based tools in your workflow and have a clear point of view on where they elevate quality (and where they don’t).
  • You have built and maintained CI pipelines before - ideally with GitHub Actions or Google Cloud Build.
  • You have designed and built automated test frameworks, and you understand the challenges microservices pose for reliable integration and end-to-end testing.
  • You are familiar with Kubernetes beyond the basics - you can write a Helm chart for a new service with relative ease, you understand best practices around security, and you have prior job experience or certifications to prove this.
  • You have worked at a startup before - you understand that things don’t always go according to plan, that there is significant technical debt, that some tasks just need to be done, and that sometimes there are no processes or documentation to guide your hand.
  • You are not afraid of taking a task from start to finish - gathering requirements, figuring out and implementing the best technical solution, then deploying and monitoring the results.

Who You Might Be (Bonus Points)

  • You have used AI/LLM tooling to build QA automation - test generation, flaky-test triage, or incident-to-regression pipelines - and can speak to what worked and what didn’t.
  • You have written code in Python or TypeScript, and can build efficient Dockerfiles and secure container images.
  • You have implemented load tests with k6 (REST) and ghz (gRPC) and have experience analyzing pprof/trace output.
  • You have done IaC deployments with Argo CD or Terraform, or have used Google Cloud Platform and Google Kubernetes Engine before. You are familiar with Tilt and have written a Kubernetes Operator before.
  • You have practiced chaos engineering - running fault-injection or resilience experiments with tools like Chaos Mesh, LitmusChaos, or Gremlin.
  • You are familiar with testing event-driven systems using Kafka (or even better, Redpanda).

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

6-month assignment
100% Remote
